publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: The inverse Weibull distribution has the ability to model failure rates which are quite common in reliability studies. In this paper, the three-parameter generalized inverse Weibull distribution for electrical components reliability analysis is studied. With the limited data, it is difficult to estimate the accurate parameters of the generalized inverse Weibull model, but we can use gamma distribution as prior distribution to get the imprecise ones. According to the Bayesian theory and the limited lifetime data, this paper proposes a new imprecise reliability method called Gamma-generalized inverse Weibull model, which can obtain the upper and lower bound of reliability function.

articleTitle: Fault Detection of High Voltage Circuit Breaker Based on Moving Window Variational Mode Decomposition and Fuzzy Entropy
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Vibration analysis has been recently proven to be a powerful and reliable treatment for noninvasive mechanical fault diagnosis of high-voltage circuit breakers. The computation intensity makes conventional methods based on the traditional variational mode decomposition (VMD) invalid for the case of real-time scenario. This paper presents a moving window strategy for real-time VMD implementation, which is suitable for decomposition of long signals with high sampling frequency. The similarity of the reconstructed signal in the segments can be calculated by fuzzy entropy through the soft and continuous boundaries of fuzzy functions, which earns stronger relative consistency and less dependence on data length. A case study of three different faults simulated on a real vacuum breaker yields that the results are more efficient than the other traditional methods for the different size of moving window.

articleTitle: Research on identification and calculation method of harmonic active power responsibility
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: The key of harmonic pollution control in power grid lies in the identification of harmonic pollution responsibility. According to the traditional harmonic voltage responsibility index to implement economic accounting to the defects, puts forward a definition to the true value of the harmonic active power, as the responsibility of the harmonic measure, and the calculation methods were also discussed. In the discussion process according to the equivalent circuit principle and the superposition theorem theory, and with the relative phase angle difference double leading method based on wave impedance, finally sorted out the complete definition and calculation method of harmonic active power responsibility. Through the measured case calculation, harmonic active power responsibility index can not only rational attention responsibility side harmonic pollution of harmonic sources, but also has the advantages of simple calculation, is conducive to economic accounting.

articleTitle: Comparative analysis of technology and economy on echelon battery energy storage
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: China is one of the largest consuming country of power battery in the world. Large-scale of power battery decommissioning occurs every year. It is of great significance to do well in recycling and echelon utilization of such batteries. In this paper, by analyzing the cost composition of echelon battery energy storage and using the method of LCOE to compare and analysis the technology and economy of conventional and echelon utilization on lead-acid and lithium battery energy storage, so as to provide preliminary suggestions for the further construction of echelon battery energy storage.

articleTitle: Analysis of Half-Wavelength Transmission Lines System State in Operation
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: As a long distance and large capacity AC transmission method, half-wavelength transmission technology has its unique economic and technological advantages. However, there are few previous studies and no corresponding engineering experience for reference. As a new transmission scheme, the characteristics of half-wavelength transmission lines and its influence on the system after operation need to be emphatically studied. In this paper, the mathematical model and no-load characteristics of half-wavelength transmission lines are analyzed, and a method for calculating the impact power of the half-wavelength transmission line in different voltage difference is proposed under coordinate and closed loop, and it is verified by simulation. The research results further clarify and improve the characteristics of UHV semi-wavelength transmission line accessing into system, which will provide theoretical reserve and technical guarantee for the new transmission technology of large power grid.

articleTitle: A Very Short-term Forecasting Approach for Virtual Power Plant Using a Self-adaptive Hybrid Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Virtual power plant (VPP) emerges as a new concept to promote the efficient utilization of renewable energy resources (RES) and flexible loads. RES forecasting approach is an important item to ensure the stability and economy in VPP dispatching and bidding. In this paper, considering multienvironmental factors, a very short-term photovoltaic (PV) forecasting approach based on a self-adaptive simulated annealing hybrid genetic algorithm (SA-GA) and backpropagation neural network (BP) algorithm is proposed. Numerical studies illustrate that the proposed approach achieves a satisfactory forecasting accuracy and offers a high computation efficiency, which indicates its promising application value in RES forecasting for VPP.

articleTitle: Structural Dynamics Simulation and Engineering Application Analysis of 550kV GIL
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: GIL is a gas-insulated power device with high voltage level, large transmission capacity and long transmission distance. GIL can be co-constructed with telecom cables, oil and gas pipelines and other equipment. It will have significant optimization significance for the future construction of national energy transmission channels and urban infrastructure layout. Increase of voltage level and transmission capacity have resulted in a higher design parameters level and a larger structural size.The 550kV GIL has a large structure size and high carrying current parameters. These brings problems of transportation vibration and seismic performance and electrodynamic load performance, which must be studied in engineering applications.In this paper, modal analysis, power spectral density analysis, response spectrum analysis and transient analysis are combined with engineering practice to analyze the structural dynamics of 550kV GIL. Structural response characteristics under transport load and seismic load conditions are analyzed. The response characteristics of GIL under rated current and short-circuit load are studied. The similarities and differences of the influence of AC component maximum value Im and DC component attenuation coefficient α of short-circuit current are analyzed.

articleTitle: Study of Smart Condition Monitoring using Deep Neural Networks with Dropouts and Cross-Validation
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: The main focus of this paper to develop and analyse computational intelligence algorithm for smart condition monitoring. Smart condition monitoring is important and helps to solve some of the difficulties faced in terms of maintaining types of mechanical or electrical machines. This paper focuses on the ability to predict if a particular machine is in working condition or not based on a dataset provided. The dataset would consist of the actual data output that the smart condition algorithm can predict, and that there would be an accuracy based on the number of correct predictions. The implementation of the proposed work will be based on using deep neural network (DNN) with programming software Python. The algorithm will be trained on some of the parameters, while the remaining would be used for the testing process.

articleTitle: Demand for Energy Storage: Case Studies for Chinese Power System in 2035 and 2050
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: It is an inevitable trend that renewable energy source will dominate the future power supply. Large-scale energy storage (ES) has proven to be the most feasible solution for system reliability reduction caused by extensive renewable integration. Therefore, the prediction of storage scale for future power systems attracts great attention in recent years. In this paper, the demand of ES for two assumed scenarios of the power system in China are analyzed with delicate modeling and time series simulation. The two scenarios correspond to the power systems of China in 2035 and 2050, respectively. In the study, the system is simplified and a commercial software, namely Hybrid Optimization of Multiple Energy Resources (HOMER), is adopted for the system modeling. The simulation results are illustrated and analyzed to verify the reasonability of the estimation.

articleTitle: Influence Analysis of Voltage Loss on Similarity Calculation
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: The operation data, such as voltage data whose similarity has been analyzed to verify distribution network connectivity. However, many influence factors will affect voltage data, such as voltage loss, measuring errors, clocks asynchrony and so on. This will result in the inaccuracy of similarity calculation and make trouble to verify Distribution network topology (DNT). This paper mainly focuses on the influence of voltage loss on similarity calculation. Correlation analysis, morphology similarity distance and dynamic time warping are used to calculate similarity. The results of the three methods which used to calculate similarity have been analyzed and compared. Results show that in order to avoid obtaining wrong similarity calculation results, the correlation analysis is recommended compared with morphology similarity distance (MSD) and dynamic time warping (DTW).

articleTitle: Siting of Electric Vehicle Charging Stations Based on Weighted Voronoi Diagram: A Graphic User Interface Design
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Electric vehicle charging station is the infrastructure to provide electric energy for electric vehicles (EV). Reasonable location of charging station is of great significance to promote the popularization of EVs. Firstly, the ownership of EVs in the selected area is forecasted. According to the ownership and driving characteristics of various types of EVs, the total charging demand of EVs and the charging demand of each network node are obtained. Secondly, the location model of charging station is established to minimize the sum of operation and maintenance costs of charging station and user loss costs. Finally, weighted Voronoi diagram and adaptive particle swarm optimization are used. The results show that this method can optimize the annual average comprehensive cost of charging station. Graphic user interface (GUI) is designed to display the result of location, which makes the location scheme more intuitive.

articleTitle: Supraharmonics measurement algorithm based on CS-SAMP
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: In recent years, with more and more electrical equipment employed in the power system, the content of supraharmonics in distribution networks has gradually increased, which has become one of the new power quality problems in power grid. This paper proposed a supraharmonics measurement method based on compressed sensing (CS) with sparsity adaptive matching pursuit (SAMP),to solve existing supraharmonics measurement algorithm cannot accurately predict the sparseness of harmonic signals. The method is based on fast Fourier transform (FFT) coefficients and Dirichlet kernel function, combined with an interpolation factor, constructs a high-precision compressed sensing model. At the same time, this paper introduces the concept of sparsity adaptive, and proposes the frequency and amplitude of supraharmonics in the signal can be detected by the SAMP algorithm. The improved algorithm improves the accuracy of the supraharmonics reconstruction amplitude and reduces the error caused by the inability to estimate the sparseness of the signal to be detected. The simulation results demonstrate the accuracy and effectiveness of the improved algorithm.

articleTitle: MMC New Type Sub Module Toplogy and Control
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: High-voltage direct current transmission technology based on modular multi-level converter (MMC-HVDC) has been widely used in power grid applications presently, and plays an important role in enhancing the power grid stability and improving the intelligence and controllability of the power grid. Dc line fault suppression is still an unavoidable problem, based on the review of dc line fault current suppression technologies, the paper studies a new sub-module topology composed of clamp circuits to realize the arm capacitor bidirectional current cascade charging after system blocking, and achieve dc fault suppression. At the same time, the voltage output characteristics of the new topology are analyzed, and its voltage balance control strategy and non-blocking dc fault suppression strategy are also studied. Finally, the two-end simulation model is built in PSCAD/EMTDC, and the new sub module dc fault suppression characteristics are simulated and verified.

articleTitle: Research on Establishment and Method of Performance Evaluation Index System of smart grid Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: It is an important requirement for the operators to control the power grid to evaluate the operation performance of the smart power distribution network reasonably and accurately. This paper from the perspective of the smart grid efficiency, effect and benefit, build up a set of evaluation index of the performance of the smart grid distribution network state system. First, through the expert method, experts from the perspective of three index system screen the center index and the non-central index, next using the improved fuzzy clustering method to correct the center index and the non-central index again, and then using the analytic hierarchy process (AHP) to improve the group gray correlation method to correct the rest of the center again and eliminate redundant indicators. The mixed weight obtained by analytic hierarchy process and entropy weight method is used to evaluate the final determined evaluation system. Finally, an example of a regional power grid is used to verify that the evaluation system and method proposed in this paper can easily and accurately reflect the smart power grid efficiency status.

articleTitle: Simulation Study on the Transient Characteristics of HVDC Voltage Divider and Their Effects on undervoltage sensing protection
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: In order to analyze the transient characteristic of voltage dividers in HVDC systems, the transfer function of DC voltage divider is derived. Analysis results show that the characteristics of DC voltage divider are determined by both two-stage resistor-capacitor voltage bleeder circuit and isolation amplifier circuit. Especially, if the parameters of the resistors and capacitors in two-stage bleeder circuits are all match well, cutoff frequency of the isolation amplifier will become the most key parameter, which determines the transmission characteristics of divider. When the cutoff frequency of isolation amplifier decreases, the rise time of the step response of DC voltage divider increases significantly. Furthermore, the effects of the transient characteristics of DC voltage divider on undervoltage sensing protection are also analyzed by simulation. Simulation results indicate that the fault component of the voltage at the secondary side of divider is much smaller than that in the first side, when the short fault occurs. Therefore, the sensitivity and the anti-resistant capacity of the protection are also decreased. Increasing the cut-off frequency may be an effective way to increase the sensitivity of such protection.

articleTitle: Feasibility Study to Install a 1 MW Grid Connected Solar Plant in Wairoa-Mahia Peninsular, New Zealand
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: This study intends to investigate the voltage drop issue along the Mahia distribution network (11kV line) and further assess the feasibility of developing a grid tied 1MW solar farm in Wairoa District, New Zealand. The objective is to provide the solution for Wairoa's local distribution Company to mitigate Voltage drops and increasing summer load demand arising due to the influx of visitors (est. spike of 800 to 3-5000 visitor's over a 2-week period) to Mahia Peninsular. Furthermore, a solution to avoid transmission charges, increase supply security, reducing peak load demand and aim at substituting the non-environmental friendly operated 1MW diesel generator in Mahia.

articleTitle: Power System Transient Stability Assessment Method Based on CapsNet
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: This paper addresses the need to make judgments quickly and accurately after a transient stability failure in the power system. A method for transient stability assessment of power systems based on CapsNet is proposed. This method does not require manual calculation and is based directly on simulation data. Using the self-learning ability of the CapsNet and strong feature extraction ability, the offline training model is used to find the mapping relationship between the input data set and the transient stability, and then online evaluation. This paper effectively improves the accuracy of the evaluation by constructing the input data matrix; By improving the parameters in the network, the calculation speed is effectively improved, and the robustness and generalization ability of the model are enhanced. The idea of "fast measurement, fast resolution, fast control" has been achieved. The simulation results of IEEE-39 node system verify the effectiveness of the proposed method, and the proposed method is superior to the evaluation model of other machine learning methods.

articleTitle: Distributed Interactive Reactive Power and Voltage Control for AC/DC Hybrid Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: In this study, a distributed interactive reactive power and voltage control (RPVC) using finite time consensus is proposed to enhance the efficiency and reliability of an AC/DC hybrid distribution network (HDN). By using the disturbed secondary voltage control with finite time consensus, the reactive power interaction between AC and DC subnets is reached, and also the coordination among multiple droop-controlled inverters in AC subnet is realized. Additionally, the proposed control ensures an accurate reactive power sharing, avoiding the problem of reactive power circulation among multiple inverters, and further improves the voltage quality. An AC/DC HDN with multiple distributed generators (DGs) is established in PSCAD/EMTDC, and the effectiveness and adaptability of distributed interactive voltage control and reactive power sharing strategy between AC and DC subnets are verified under various operating conditions.

articleTitle: A Novel Method of Contingency Screening and Ranking in Distribution Network Based on PMU
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Contingency screening and ranking is a particularly important part of power system security analysis. In order to improve the speed and accuracy of screening and sorting of fault set in distribution network, this paper proposes a novel method of contingency screening and ranking in distribution network based on Phasor Measurement Unit (PMU). Based on PMU measurement data and historical fault data, the is used to calculate the weight relationship between voltage, short-circuit current, active power and reactive power loss under fault conditions, and pre-screening the expected fault set by constructing the branch parameter screening index to narrow the fault screening range. Due to the PMU-π branch model, the calculation method of active load margin and voltage threshold in view of PMU is proposed. The active load margin fault screening index and voltage stability ranking index are constructed to realize the rapid screening and sequencing of severe faults. Finally, this method proved to be fast, comprehensive and effective when applied to IEEE33 system.

articleTitle: Feasibility Analysis of Pumped Storage Integration for PV Fluctuation Mitigation
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: This paper proposes a method for feasibility analysis of pumped storage integration for smoothing fluctuation in a Hydro-PV hybrid energy system based on the operational optimization. To simplify the calculation, a design of multi-time scale temporal scenario reduction is presented first. Case studies shows the various generated scenarios which reflects different time scales and different power characteristics. Furthermore, hourly and minutely time-scale feasibility analysis indicates that a reasonable capacity pumped storage such as 5MW can effectively smooth fluctuation and reduce the safety risks of grid operation. In addition, the research can provide a reference for planning of pumped storage in Hydro-PV hybrid energy system.

articleTitle: Dispatching Strategy of Combined Heat and Power System Based on Additional Heat Source for Wind Power Accommodation
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: In order to decouple the traditional `heat-set' constraint in heating period and promote the consumption of wind power. Based on the analysis of the operation mode of `heat-set' of the combined heat and power(CHP) unit with additional heat source to promote the realization of wind power consumption, the specific scheduling strategy of the combined heat and power system with additional heat source to promoted wind power absorption is proposed. consider electric coupling characteristics of combined heat and power generation unit, heat storage tank and electric boiler operation constraints, a scheduling model is established to solve. Case studies shows that the strategy proposed in this paper can effectively promote the consumption of wind power and save scheduling costs.

articleTitle: Simulation Implementation of Embedded Protection Control Platform
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Embedded protection control platform is built on the embedded real-time operating system (RTOS), so as to ensure real-time, but the design and debugging of device are more complex, needed the cross-compiled debugging, it also based on external test instrument to add the digital value and analog quantity, to be able to simulate the actual environment for debugging. The simulation design and implementation method of NPS, which is a new generation of embedded protection and control platform of SAC. It can simulate all the plugins of whole device and the test instruments, and complete the configuration, development and simulation of the whole device on the PC, making the application of research and development are independent of the device hardware, which improved efficiency greatly.

articleTitle: Fixed Change-Rate Matrix Correction Algorithm for Processing PV Nodes in Active Distribution Network Power Flow Calculation
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Aiming at the traditional forward-backward method not processing PV nodes of active distribution network power flow calculation, a correction algorithm based on a fixed change-rate matrix is proposed. The change-rate matrix is used to solve the reactive power compensations of PV nodes, thereby indirectly transforming PV nodes into PQ nodes. The derivation and solution of the fixed change-rate matrix are studied. Theory proves that there are linear relationships between the voltage corrections and the reactive compensations of PV nodes. The elements of the change-rate matrix are constant and are not related to values of the reactive compensation. The muliple power flow calculation method is used to solve the fixed change-rate matrix, which overcomes the error caused by the direct calculation of transfer reactance, thus improving the convergence of the algorithm. The proposed algorithm is validated by the IEEE 33-node system with PV-type DGs. The simulation results show that the proposed algorithm has good convergence, and the convergence of the algorithm is weakly sensitive to the number and the initial reactive power values of PV-type DGs.

articleTitle: Study on Lightning Intruding Overvoltage on DC Side of ±1100kV Converter Station
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: The Ultra-High Voltage (UHV) converter station is the hub of DC transmission system. If the converter station is damaged by lightning strikes, the safe and stable state of the DC transmission system will be greatly threatened. Relying on Zhundong-Wannan ±1100kV UHV project, this paper simulates and analyzes the overvoltage level on the DC side of the converter station by lightning. Firstly, the non-uniform transmission line model is built, and then the whole transient simulation model of the converter station is built. Secondly, the overvoltage under the non-uniform transmission line model and the multi-surge impendence model is compared to verify its applicability. Finally, under the suitable operation mode of the converter station, the overvoltage of the converter station is calculated. Besides, the protection level of the converter station equipment is checked so as to provide a basis for the arrester arrangement and insulation level of the converter station.

articleTitle: Critical Bus Voltage Support in Islanded Microgrids with Consensus Algorithm of Distributed Generators
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: This paper proposes a method to support the voltage of remote (critical) buses in islanded microgrids based on the consensus control of distributed generations (DG) output reactive power. In addition to primary droop control which ensures equal load sharing among DGs, secondary distributed control is employed to mitigate voltage drop/rise of remote buses. Consensus is reached when all DGs agree on their reactive power contribution, proportional to their capacity. The amount of the required reactive power is obtained from Backward Forward Sweep (BFS) power flow analysis, which has been modified to calculate the power flow of unbalanced islanded microgrids more accurately. The proposed algorithm's performance is evaluated on several case studies. It proves to be accurate and effective in regulating voltage level of remote (critical) buses in islanded microgrids.

articleTitle: Smart Substation Secondary Equipment Defect Diagnosis Method Based on Information Flow
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: After a secondary equipment in a smart substation has defects, the monitoring signals, SV, GOOSE and other information of the smart substation will change. Defect diagnosis is to use the information to find out the cause and source of the defects of the smart substation. In order to solve the problem of low efficiency and low accuracy of secondary equipment defect in smart substation, this paper proposes a fault diagnosis method for secondary equipment of smart substation based on information flow. First, the target of defect diagnosis and the information that can be used it sorted out. For the diagnosis of secondary equipment defects, the smart substation secondary equipment defect information flow is defined, and its construction method is described in detail. Finally, based on the above key information, a method for diagnosing the secondary equipment defects of smart substation is proposed. The method can be used for on-site elimination of samart substation, and the method is universal.

articleTitle: Research on repairing technology of a slit on shield
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: The lead wire, ventilation and heat dissipation of the electrical equipment need to be opened on the surface of the shield. At the same time, the high-temperature superconductor is mainly ceramic, which is brittle, and it is not easy to make a large-sized shield, and there is also a slit. Therefore, the shield is likely to result in electromagnetic wave leakage and affect the shielding effect of the shield. The purpose of this paper is to identify a suitable repair solution for shields of different materials. First, the iron, copper and YBCO shields with a slit on the bottom surface of the shield were repaired with three materials: iron, copper and YBCO. Then, by comparing their shielding effectiveness and repairing efficiency, it is found that the frequency of the excitation source, the location of the crack and the repairing method all affect the repair effect of the magnetic shielding. The results demonstrate that the best effect can be obtained by repairing the Fe material at the low frequency and the repairing with the Cu material at high frequencies, regardless of the material. Therefore, it provides a certain theoretical and experimental basis for the repair design of electromagnetic shielding slit magnetic shield.

articleTitle: An optimal capacity planning method for multiple types of renewable energy in combined operation considering different peak-shaving demands
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Most of the areas with rich renewable energy are located far away from load center, in which the generated power should be transmitted to load center through Ultra-High Voltage Direct Current (UHVDC) lines. The combined operation of multiple types of renewable energy can improve operation safety and reliability, through making full use of their power output smoothing characteristic and the regulation capability of hydropower stations. In this paper, an capacity optimal planning method for multiple types of renewable in combined operation is proposed here. This model can consider the power output characteristic constraints of each type of renewable energy in sending-end power system and the regulation capacity for runoff, seasonal regulation and annual regulation hydro power stations. Besides, this model can adapt to the different peak-shaving demand of receiving-end power system. The effectiveness of proposed model is verified through simulation cases in one real planning power grid in Southwest China.

articleTitle: Reliability analysis of centralized protection system considering the impact of messages under multi-operating states
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: The operation of centralized protection system highly depends on reliable communication messages. A method was proposed to quantitatively evaluate reliability of messages under the redundancy check mechanism in smart substation. Subsequently, corresponding reliability models were established based on detailed analysis of different centralized protection strategies under normal and fault states of power grids, as well as message loss and message error. Finally, contrastive analysis was carried out to demonstrate the impact of messages on centralized and distributed protection systems. Results indicate that the influence of communication messages on the reliability of centralized protection systems is lower.

articleTitle: A Rapid Method for Voltage Sag Detection Based on Adaptive Order Morphology
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Aiming at the shortcomings of current voltage sag detection methods, such as unsatisfactory real-time performance, difficult to implementation and poor anti- interference ability, this paper proposes a new method of voltage sag detection that combines improved dq transform and adaptive order morphology. The algorithm principle of improved single-phase dq transform is discussed. Based on the original mathematical morphology, an adaptive order morphology is designed. In view of the harmonics and external noise interference of the power distribution system under actual conditions, this paper sets up a form of voltage sag to test the performance of the proposed method and compare with the direct monitoring. Through the simulation, it is proved that the new method can timely and accurately detect the occurrence of voltage sag with good anti-interference ability.

articleTitle: Optimization Operation of Multi-energy Complementary System based on Interval Model
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: It has become an inevitable choice for the development of the energy industry to build a distributed multienergy flow co-generation system. It forms a multi-energy complementary co-generation system by coupling cold, heat, gas and electricity through energy production, transmission, conversion, supply, storage, energy using equipment and protection, measurement and control equipment. This paper is based on interval theory to describe the uncertainties of cold, hot and electric load, distributed energy output and operating conditions, using the transfer matrix to construct the relationship between the input and output of multiple energy sources, and the coupling modeling of the multi-energy complementary system. Considering the impact environment, economy and other factors, multi-objective optimization is carried out for the system. The interval linear programming based on affine operation is used to solve the model, which can effectively solve the problem that the interval operation is too conservative, and simulated verify the validity and rationality of the model and method.

articleTitle: Household Energy Consumption Behaviors Analysis Based on Chicken Swarm Optimization and PrefixSpan Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the traditional analysis method of household energy consumption can't effectively analyze the usage rules of electrical equipment, this paper proposes a new method based on Chicken Swarm Optimization and PrefixSpan algorithm to resolve it. By introducing the metric function of the normal distribution, the current harmonic characteristics and power characteristics are merged to construct an improved target function of the optimization algorithm which improved the accuracy of the load decomposition result. Thus, we can get the using sequences of electrical equipment. Then, combined with the advantages of PrefixSpan algorithm in sequence pattern mining, the frequent sequences in the using sequences of electrical equipment are analyzed to obtain the user electricity consumption model. The experimental results show that the proposed method has high accuracy of load decomposition and the user electricity consumption model is consistent with the actual situation.

articleTitle: Optimization of Entering Path for Equipotential Live Work on ± 800 kV UHV DC Line
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Equipotential operation is the main way of live operation for ±800 kV UHV DC lines. In this paper, the numerical simulation method is used to study the optimum path to enter the equipotential in live operation of ±800 kV UHV DC lines. Firstly, according to the actual situation of live operation of typical straight-line towers in ±800 kV DC lines, a simulation model is established in the finite element analysis software ANSYS. Then, the dynamic distribution of electric field intensity on the human body surface is calculated when the operator enters the equipotential process along all possible paths and is located at several different points. The results show that the maximum electric field intensity of human body surface is different when it enters the equipotential along different paths, and the difference of the maximum electric field intensity between different paths can reach 1.7 times. The most reasonable entry path is from the tower level.

articleTitle: Influence Analysis of Droop Coefficients on Load Margins for AC/DC Hybrid Microgrids
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: When operating in islanded mode, an AC/DC hybrid microgrid usually adopts droop control methods. The droop control coefficients of interconnected converters and distributed inverters have a great influence on load stability margin of the system. Droop control coefficients are used to be determined by capacity ratio of the inverters, frequency and voltage regulation range, however, the influence of droop coefficients of multiple inverters on overall voltage stability of the system is not fully considered. For this issue, a new method for calculating load stability margin of the hybrid microgrid considering droop control parameters is proposed. Through further traversal of the droop parameter space, the optimal range of droop control parameters which maximize the load margin of the microgrid is obtained from the overall perspective. The system is more stable in the optimal parameter space. The results are verified based on a 12-node AC/DC hybrid microgrid.

articleTitle: Research on Protection for the Flexible Substation
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: The equipment composition, networking form and functional characteristics of the flexible substation are different from the conventional substation and intelligent substation, and its protection has special characteristics. Based on the project of flexible substation, this paper proposes a three-layer protection system framework of in-situ protection, substation-area protection and wide-area protection for flexible substation, and analyzes the basic performance of protection reliability, selectivity and speed. The research results show that the proposed flexible substation protection system framework is reasonable and feasible, and it can be used as reference for the future design of the protection system structure in the smart grid and global energy Internet construction.

articleTitle: A optimal algorithm for DC breakers configuration in multi-terminal DC systems
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: When the multi-terminal DC system fails, the fault current is hard to isolate, which poses a challenge to DC fault protection. The hybrid DC circuit breaker has a good effect on isolating the DC current, but the DC breaker is not economical when each line equip with DC breaker, and the circuit breaker has the risk of malfunction. Partition protection for multi-terminal DC systems and DC breaks configuration at regional boundaries is a planning scheme that takes into account the economics and reliability of DC construction. This paper proposes a traversal-based optimization algorithm to search the multi-terminal DC system partitioning scheme that meets the required conditions. The simulation scheme is verified in PSCAD platform. The simulation results show that the partitioning scheme can isolate the DC fault within its own area and ensure the economical and reliability of the DC partition.

articleTitle: Control Strategy Analysis of Grid-connected Energy Storage Converter Based on Harmonic Decomposition
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: The three-phase grid-connected converter control strategy, which applies to the battery energy storage system, generally ignores the interference of harmonic components in the grid voltage. As a result, it is difficult to meet the practical application requirements. To deal with this problem, it is necessary to optimize and improve the traditional control strategy, taking harmonics into consideration. And its bases are analysis of the harmonic characteristics and study of its control mechanism in the grid-connected converter. This paper proposes a method of harmonic decomposition, classifies the grid voltage harmonics and explores the control mechanism in the grid-connected converter. With the help of the simulation model built by Matlab/Simulink, the comparative simulation of the energy storage control system carried out under the control of the ideal grid voltage input and the actual one, verifies the correctness of the analytical method proposed in the article.

articleTitle: The investigation of dimensionality reduction method for state evaluation of oil-immersed transformer in 220kV substation
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: The state evaluation of power equipment is an important basis for maintenance scheduling. This paper starts from the performance state data of power transformer and aims to study the matrix model and mathematical analysis method that is applicable to the state evaluation parameter system of power equipment in 220 kV substations. Different from the traditional threshold deduction method, this paper is more inclined to propose a closed loop model by finding the correlation among the internal key parameters of the system by reducing the dimension of the state matrix and increasing the dimension of iterations. This paper presents the basic state evaluation parameter system from various aspects which are based on the multi-source information of 220 kV substations. The dimensionality reduction of the matrix is carried out for the criterion matrix of the nature.

articleTitle: A Robust Operation Strategy for Energy Storage Considering Uncertainty in Electricity Price
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Inaccurate price prediction may cause improper charging/discharging schedules of battery energy storage (BES) in electricity market, which further leads to less or even negative market profits of BES. On this condition, uncertainty in market prices should be fully considered when making operation strategies. In this paper, focusing on an independently operated BES in day-ahead and hour-ahead markets, a multi-stage robust optimal operation strategy is formulated considering uncertainty in multi-periods market prices. The robust optimization model is formulated seeking to maximize market revenues of BES within a given confidence level of price deviation. The max-min model can be converted into a mixed-integer linear programming (MILP) problem which can be easily computable. Case study results demonstrated the validity of the presented robust operation strategy of BES.

articleTitle: Dynamic Reactive Power Robust Allocation Based on Linear Power Flow for Large-Scale Wind Farm Integration
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Voltage security problem hinders the development of wind power. Sufficient dynamic reactive power (DRP) resources are of great importance to support wind power integration and guarantee the safety. To ensure the robustness under high uncertainty of wind power, this paper proposes a DRP allocation scheme utilizing two-stage robust optimization (TSRO). Moreover, a warm-start linear power flow model is employed to approximate the nonconvex and nonlinear AC power flow model. Numerical tests based on Monte Carlo simulation show the proposed scheme decreases more voltage deviations than other heuristic manners. Moreover, the proposed scheme offers a tool to determine requisite DRP resources under a certain standard of wind power integration.

articleTitle: A Pricing Mechanism for BESS in Frequency Regulation Considering Penetration of the Renewables
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: With the increasing penetration of the renewables, power system is with the challenge of the frequency stability. Battery energy storage systems (BESS) are regarded as an effective way providing frequency regulation. At present, BESS mainly make profit by the energy arbitrage, and cannot get much by frequency regulation. Beside executive orders, economic stimulation is another more reasonable method to encourage BESS providing frequency regulation. Therefore, a pricing mechanism for BESS in frequency regulation (FR) considering the penetration level of the renewables is proposed in this paper. In detail, the proposed mechanism sets the minimum tracking accuracy of the BESS in frequency regulation according to the renewables penetration level, and decides the optimal regulation price of BESS which encourages BESS to achieve the setting tracking accuracy. The dynamic programming method is used to decide the way that BESS follow the frequency regulation signals. At last, the promising results shows the proposed pricing mechanism can stimulate BESS in frequency regulation, benefiting to the power system frequency stability.

articleTitle: Load Flow Calculation Considering Droop Control in Distribution Networks: A Convex Optimization Approach
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Load flow (LF) calculation is a crucial module in modern energy management systems. Departing from the conventional Newton-Raphson iterative method, this paper shows that LF solutions can be obtained by solving a second-order conic programming (SOCP) problem. To consider droop characteristics of distributed generators (DGs), convexiflcation of LF equations embedded with approximation of droop equations is investigated. The implications are twofold. On one hand, LF solutions can be obtained efficiently by directly applying existing commercial solvers into the SOCP problem. On the other hand, transforming the original system of nonlinear LF equations into a convex optimization problem facilitates the subsequent spatial decomposition, where state-of-the-art distributed optimization algorithms can be readily deployed. Numerical tests on four different benchmark systems demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Coordinated Optimal Planning of Generation and Storage in Hybrid AC/DC Micro-grid
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: The hybrid AC/DC micro-grid that integrates AC and DC micro-grid, including a variety of distributed generation, energy storage devices, load, lead the trend of micro-grid. To improve the operation economic efficiency and acceptance of renewable energy source of the hybrid AC/DC micro-grid, it is necessary to configure battery energy storage system for distributed generation. In this paper, a mix integer optimization model of generation and storage is proposed for the hybrid AC/DC micro-grid to determine the optimal configuration of generation and storage. Taking the minimum cost of generation and storage investment as well as the minimum operation cost of power generation and purchase and sale of electricity, the dynamic characteristics of generators and storage devices are taken into consideration, and the power loss through AC/DC converter is taken into account. The model is solved as a mixed integer optimization based on Benders Decomposition algorithm. The numerical study shows that the optimal configuration of coordinated generation and storage can effectively save the investment cost of AC/DC hybrid micro-grid, which verifies the validity of the proposed model.

articleTitle: Research on Retrofitting Scheme of Merging Unit and Intelligent Terminal in 500kV Smart Substation
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: At present, many of the merging units and intelligent terminals used in smart substations that in operation in China are defective and unqualified products, bringing security hidden troubles to power grid. So It is urgently needed to replace them with qualified equipments which through professional testing. Nowadays, power users are demanding higher and higher reliability of power supply, so it is quite necessary to carry out retrofitting under the minimum outage mode, 500kV substation in particular, the retrofitting by large area outage is nearly impossible. Regarding this, the article combines the retrofitting situation of merging unit and intelligent terminal in 500kV smart substation, and studies the safe and feasible minimum blackout mode and the security risk under this mode, meanwhile, puts forward the principles and schemes of implementing security measures for these security risks.

articleTitle: Dual-Channel Subsynchronous Damping Control based on Voltage Source Converter Excitation System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: A novel dual-channel damping control based on voltage source converter (VSC) excitation system is put forward in this paper to suppress subsynchronous oscillation for turbine generators. The proposed control is a combination of both supplementary excitation damping control (SEDC) and supplementary subsynchronous damping control (SSDC) but only implemented in one device. A small perturbation linearized model considering the dual-channel damping is built and the complex torque coefficients method is adopted to analyze the damping characteristic of the proposed control. Based on the analytical analysis, a decoupling tuning method for the dual-channel damping control is proposed. The effectiveness and superiority of the proposed subsynchronous damping control are verified through PSCAD simulation.

articleTitle: Condition-Based Maintenance of Protection Systems Based on Hierachical Fuzzy Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: With the development of power grids, the disadvantages of traditional periodic maintenance of relays are increasingly obvious. Condition-based maintenance has become the reform trend of maintenance modes. An index set of relaying state based on the analysis of operational characteristics and data of condition monitoring is proposed firstly. The guard bay is taken as a unit and the status of protection device and the secondary loop are taken into account respectively. Secondly, aiming at the improvement of maintenance efficiency and quality, a state evaluation model of protection systems based on multi-level fuzzy comprehensive evaluation is built to form a maintenance strategy through data analysis. The case study shows that the method proposed is helpful for effectively assessing the operational status of relays, forming pertinent maintenance strategies and promoting the application of condition-based maintenance in protection systems.

articleTitle: Numerical calculation of electric field safety area of 10 kV transformer based on Maxwell
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: There is alternating electromagnetic field around 10 kV transformer when it is live. When the worker enters the electric field during live maintenance, the distribution of electric field will change unevenly. When the electric field of human body reaches a certain intensity, it will bring personal injury to the worker. In order to avoid this situation, the finite element method is used to establish the transformer and human body model for numerical calculation of the working area. The distribution of electromagnetic field around the transformer and the change of electromagnetic field after joining the human body model are obtained. The safe distance is obtained by measuring the distance, so as to determine whether the corresponding protection needs to be taken. Protection measures. This paper provides technical and theoretical basis for the safe operation of live working of 10 kV high voltage transformer.

articleTitle: Research on Distribution Network Planning Containing Micro-grids
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: A two-phase distribution network planning approach with a substation planning model and a network planning model is proposed for distribution network with micro-grids as prosumers. The two sub-tasks are modeled as mixed-integer programs and solved by multi-source continuous location method and modified genetic algorithm respectively. Critical issue imposed by micro-grids, namely bi-directional power flow, is explicitly modeled via AC power flow constraints. An example is presented to verify the proposed approach. The case study shows that micro-grids can benefit distribution network planning in terms of improving network structure and reliability.

articleTitle: Operating Overvoltage Simulation Research of ±800kV UHVDC Transmission Converter DC Yard Caused by Typical Grounding Fault
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: The simulation model of the power system is established according to the parameters of the main equipment of Xiangjiaba-Shanghai 800kV UHVDC transmission project. The operating overvoltage generating mechanism and distributing law caused by typical grounding fault at the top of high-voltage valve and the valve side of high-voltage transformer is analyzed. According to the simulation results, it is found that the absorb energy of the neutral bus arrester exceeds the designed maximum. Therefore, the measures by increasing the number of the neutral bus arresters to control the arrester absorb energy is presented and verified by simulation. This study is of guiding significance to the optimization design of arrester configuration scheme in UHVDC project.

articleTitle: A Transmission System Planning Method Considering Risk Volatility and Capability of Accommodating Wind Power
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: The ever-increasing penetration of wind power has resulted in new problems and challenges to the secure and economic operation of the power system concerned. Given this background, a bi-level transmission system planning model for this purpose is proposed. In the upper level, the objective is to maximize the generating quantity from wind farms by per unit transmission investment within a given time period, the attained transmission planning scheme will be transferred to the lower level. In the lower level, the objective is to minimize the sum of load shedding energy and abandoned wind energy within a given time period, the load shedding punishment, abandoned wind punishment and wind farm energy are transferred to the upper level as feedback. These two levels are implemented interactively and iteratively. Finally, the essential features of the developed model and adopted algorithms are demonstrated by a modified 18-bus test system.

articleTitle: Research on seamless switching control strategy of VSC-MTDC based on OPF
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: With the continuous promotion of the electricity market reforming and the aggravation of global climate changing, users' requirements on power quality are gradually improving, the research on smart grid technology has great theoretical significance. The VSC-MTDC is an important way to build smart grid. This paper puts forward a seamless switching control strategy for VSC-MTDC considering optimal power flow. By selecting the control coefficient, it can not only realize the system operation under the optimal conditions, but also realize the seamless switching of the three control modes. It avoids the shortcomings of traditional control strategy. Finally, build the RT-LAB simulation model of the five-terminal HVDC system, which connected with wind power, to verify the effectiveness of the proposed control strategy.

articleTitle: Study on a Novel Fully Automatic Transformer Calibrator Overall Test Device
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: The existing transformer calibrator has many problems such as, low accurate, poor stability, error interference of frequency conversion, small range of working circuit, etc., this paper focus on those problems, adopting adjustment technology of rectangular coordinate system and polar coordinate system, automatic measurement feedback technology with high accurate, designs an adoptable digital program-control standard signal source with two channels of phase and amplitude, realizing automatic feedback of phase and amplitude after the frequency and load changing, realizing the automatic verification and calibration of transformer calibrator and PT secondary drop test instrument. The device designed in this paper has already passed the test of third-party detection mechanism, all of the technical indexes and function meet the demand.

articleTitle: The Application of Latent Feature Model in Power Equipment Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Healthy running of power equipment is an important guarantee of stable operation of power system. To ensure the healthy operation of electrical equipment, periodic assessment of equipment status is required. Traditional neural network method has high evaluation accuracy and parallel processing capability. However the algorithm takes a long time to train and is difficult to converge. Latent Feature Model is an important evaluation method of e-commerce. It has the advantages of fast online calculation and high evaluation accuracy. The shortcoming of the model is that personal preferences have an impact on the assessment results. In this paper, smart meter is selected as the experimental object, and the Latent Feature Model is used to evaluate the health status of smart meter. In order to remove the influence of personal preference, this article adopts the k-means algorithm to cluster the influence factors which eliminate the assessment bias caused by personal preferences. Through the experiment of 1573 smart meters, the elapsed time of the Latent Feature Model is reduced by 29.34% compared with the traditional artificial neural network method, and the evaluation accuracy is only lowered by only 1.94%.

articleTitle: Transient Voltage of Hybrid DCCB for MVDC Distribution grids and Its Mitigation
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Medium voltage direct current (MVDC) distribution grids, that is proposed to improve power quality, enable high penetration of renewable sources, decrease operating losses, has drawn more and more attraction. However, dc faults ride-through remains to be a technical bottleneck constraining the extensive industry application of MVDC distribution grids, and the method based on DC circuit breaker (DCCB) is one of the most promising solution to deal with this problem. With features of no operating losses, low cost and free maintenance, the hybrid DCCB with current commutation drive circuit (CCDC) could be widely used in MVDC distribution system to interrupt DC fault current. During the current interruption process of DCCB with CCDC, circuit switching occurs twice, so the transient voltages are inevitable. In this paper, a simulation model of DCCB with CCDC is established by PSCAD, and the transient voltages are calculated. According to the simulation results, the transient voltages should be suppressed. Then, based on the mechanisms of the transient voltages, mitigation ways are proposed. In the end, the simulation results show that the transient voltages have been effectively suppressed and the reliability of DCCB with CCDC has been improved.

articleTitle: Robust Islanding Identification Technique for single DG Distribution Networks and Rank Based Load Shedding
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: With the development of Distributed Generation (DG) systems, there are new challenges in the operation of modern power systems. The identification and islanded operation of the system has become complex. Failure to detect islanding might result in decline of the system performance. This paper presents a technique for identifying the bus vulnerable for islanding (RIIT) in the presence of a single large DG unit. In the identified islands, power mismatch is alleviated by a Rank Based Load Shedding scheme. Investigations on standard IEEE radial bus systems have been carried out to evaluate the validity of the proposed schemes.

articleTitle: Analysis and Design of Half-Bridge LCC Resonant Converter with Buck-Boost Integration Adopting Dual Carrier Modulation
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: A half-bridge (HB) LCC resonant converter with Buck-Boost integration adopting dual carrier modulation is proposed in this paper. By integrating forestage buck-boost circuit with post-stage HB LCC converter, advantages of low cost and high power density can be easily achieved. Furthermore, the dual carrier modulation technique is adopted in the proposed converter, benefiting from wide zero-voltage-switching (ZVS) operation range, low conduction loss and reduced switching frequency variation. The proposed converter can effectively deal with the wide input voltage and/or wide output power, which is the common situation in applications like renewable energy interface and data center power supply. The working principle and detailed analysis of proposed converter are discussed in this paper. And a 500W prototype with 100-200V input voltage is provided to verify the theoretical analysis. The maximum efficiency of prototype reaches 93.9%.

articleTitle: Integrated Energy Collaborative Optimal Dispatch Considering Energy Flexible Building in Smart grid
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Based on the energy Internet framework, considering energy flexible building in smart grid, an integrated energy collaborative optimal dispatch is proposed. Firstly, the energy usage characteristics are studied from the perspective of the user demand, the flexible energy is divided into transferable energy, reducible energy and convertible energy, mathematical models are established according to these loads respectively, and the economic benefit is analyzed. Secondly, a thermal resistance model is constructed according to the thermal properties of the building to analyze the relationship between cold/heat power and human comfort. Finally, considering the human comfort and flexible energy building, the maximum operating revenue of integrated energy service providers is taken as the objective function, and the results of the park-level comprehensive energy collaborative optimization scheduling are obtained. The results show that the proposed model can improve economic efficiency and promote local consumption of new energy sources.

articleTitle: Optimization Strategy for Generator Excitation System Adjustment Coefficient based on High Energy Consumption Load accessed to the Power Grid
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: The high energy consumption load has the characteristics of nonlinearity and time-varying,which causes large-scale reactive power shortage in the grid industry. In this paper, the optimal setting strategy of excitation system adjustment coefficient of generator set is proposed to improve the adverse effect of high energy consumption point load access. Aiming at reducing the network losses and voltage fluctuation, a multi-objective function considering the network losses and the central node and the high energy consumption point is established, and the excitation adjustment coefficient is adjusted according to the power flow constraints. The improved particle swarm optimization algorithm has been studied for this problem. Optimization for the IEEE 39-bus system proves that the situation of the low voltage exceeds the limit can be avoided, the network losses are effectively reduced, and the economic and reliability of the power grid operation is improved.

articleTitle: A Two-steps Splitting Strategy Based On Laplacian Eigenmap Algorothm For Large Power Grid With Power Wind Connected
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: This paper proposes a two-steps splitting strategy for large power grid with high wind power permeability. In the first phase, the wind power is processed by modifying the shrinkage admittance matrix of the system. Then the classification result of the coupling degree of the generators can be calculated off-line, according to which the power angle Laplacian matrix is corrected online. After that, the current homology clustering results are obtained. In the second phase, the problem of determining the splitting surfaces is transformed into the problem of solving generalized eigenvalues by using constrained spectrum clustering algorithm based on graph theory. And the real-time optimal splitting surfaces will be quickly obtained using the improved k-means algorithm. Finally, the strategy is proved to be correct, rapid and effective through the simulation of IEEE-39 bus system.

articleTitle: Comparison between Two LCL DC Transformer Topologies: SCR-LCL and IGBT-LCL
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: The rise of HVDC use in power transmission is driven mainly by its increased efficiency and reduced cost when compared to conventional HVAC power transmission. However, HVAC power system are flexible regarding voltage level change, using AC transformers, when compared to HVDC systems. This paper will review two DC-DC transformer topologies, SCR-LCL, and IGBT-LCL. Those topologies show promise in accommodating high powers and voltages present in HVDC systems. In the review, the paper will consider the operational principles, design processes, and main types of power losses concerning each of the two topologies. In addition, it will mention other DC-DC topologies that are present in the literature.

articleTitle: A New Distributed Control Strategy for DC Microgrids with Droop Coefficient Correction and DC Bus Voltage Restoration
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Droop control is a commonly used control strategy in DC microgrids. However, traditional droop control has two main problems. Firstly, the output voltage is lower than the reference voltage. Secondly, due to the unequal line impedance, the accuracy of power sharing is greatly reduced. In order to solve these two problems, this paper proposes a new control strategy, which improves the output voltage, greatly reduces the error between output voltage and the voltage reference, and improves current distribution accuracy. In this control method, the output voltage is compensated by voltage compensation controller. The droop coefficient of converter is compensated by the droop coefficient compensator to adapt line impedance of each converter, thereby the current distribution accuracy of DC converters is improved. In this method, only local controllers are utilized, and each DC converter exchanges information with the remaining DC converters through low bandwidth communication (LBC) network. The simulation model based on PLECS verifies the feasibility of this control strategy. Finally, a hardware platform consisting of two buck converters and one boost converter is built, and the experimental results reconfirm the effectiveness of the proposed control algorithm.

articleTitle: The applications of XGBoost in Fault Diagnosis of Power Networks
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: The fault of power transmission and distribution system for the power grid usually could lead to huge losses to the power supply companies and the users, so the effective power system fault diagnosis plays an important role in the protection of the power grid. For quickly and accurately locating the fault components, we respectively use the neural network and the XGBoost which are two different kinds of machine learning method to present a comparative research. We find that compared with BP neural network, XGBoost has obvious advantages in the prediction accuracy and the cost of time for training models in different concrete case.

articleTitle: Impacts of Zero Net Energy Buildings on Customer Energy Savings and Distribution System Planning
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: This paper presents a customer-oriented, data-driven distribution system planning method for quantifying impacts of Zero-Net-Energy (ZNE) buildings on customer energy savings and distribution system operation. A ZNE building refers to a building whose total amount of energy consumed is roughly equal to self-generated energy on an annual basis. By replacing old appliances with new energy efficient appliances, a retrofit building is called “ZNE ready”. By installing rooftop photovoltaics (PV) systems together with energy storage devices, a building can be converted to “ZNE”. Smart meter data collected from 5000 buildings at 30-minute resolution in 2016 are used as the baseline energy consumption. To create “ZNE ready” load profiles, water heater and air conditioning loads are first separated from the total building energy consumption so they can be replaced by energy efficient water heaters and air conditioner load profiles. To create “ZNE” load profiles, the size of the PV system is calculated and the PV outputs are subtracted from the “ZNE ready” load profile. By studying the power flow changes before and after ZNE technology is implemented, impacts of ZNE buildings on customer payments and on distribution system operation are quantified using the actual feeder topology and network data in Duke Energy North Carolina service areas.

articleTitle: Planning of Central Energy Station in Community Integrated Energy System with Electrical and Heat Storage Devices
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Under the pressure of energy crisis and environmental pollution, the construction of community integrated energy systems (CIES) has caused widespread concern worldwide. To realize the optimal configuration of central energy station in a CIES, this paper presents an optimal configuration method for CIES considering electrical and heat storage devices. The system considers four energy conversion equipment, two energy storage devices and two types of distributed generator, which can simultaneously meet the load requirements of cooling, heat and electricity in the system and ensure economic efficiency. First, the model of energy station in CIES is established based on the type of optional devices and the form of input energy. Then, taking minimum annual total cost as the objective function, the mix-integer linear programming (MILP) method is adopted to optimize the type and capacity of the equipment. Finally, case studies are conducted under different scenarios to verify the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Real-Time Economic Dispatch and Subinterval Coordination Strategy to Benefit System Operations
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: This paper proposes a real-time economic dispatch method and a subinterval coordination strategy, which are able to minimize the generation cost of power systems and benefit system operations with large-scale renewable power integration. First, renewable power (wind and concentrated solar photovoltaic power) is modeled using versatile mixture distribution model. Second, a real-time economic dispatch model with renewable power integration is established. Using the equal incremental fuel costs of renewable power and conventional power, the real-time dispatch scheme is obtained. A subinterval coordination strategy of conventional power plants is presented to cope with potential frequency risks caused by the stochastic nature of renewable power. At last, a case study on IEEE 39-bus system and its numerical experiments in RTDS are used to demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: The Day-ahead Optimization Scheduling of CCHP Energy System with Multi-mode Energy Storages
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: The continuous development of society and economy has accelerated the energy crisis and environmental pollution. As a typical representative of energy ladder utilization, CCHP energy system can cooperate with energy storage facilities to play a comprehensive role in energy utilization. This paper first establishes a CCHP energy system model with P2G-based Storage System (P2GSS) and heat storage (HS). Then, with the goal of system operation cost and energy consumption minimum, a CCHP pre-optimization scheduling model considering the uncertainty of renewable energy was established. Finally, an example was used to compare the effects of different energy storage modes on the system. The results prove that the reasonable setting of energy storage can effectively reduce the system cost. P2GSS is conducive to the rational use of resources by the CCHP system and reducing energy waste.

articleTitle: The Bidirectional DC/DC Converter Operation Mode Control Algorithm Based on RBF Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: As the main force of new energy generation, photovoltaic power generation is widely used in microgrid. Considering the coordinated operation of photovoltaic and energy storage system (ESS) in the island operation mode, the control strategy of voltage stability and power balance was studied for the low-voltage DC microgrid composed of the distributed generations. When the loads of DC microgrid system change abruptly, the DC bus power will be excessive or deficient, which will affect the stability of bus voltage. In this paper, a parallel structure of ESS and photovoltaic cell was used, and a bidirectional DC/DC converter was used to connect the energy storage battery with the DC bus. Based on RBF neural network tuning PID control, an improved bidirectional DC/DC converter operation mode control algorithm was proposed. When the system load changed suddenly, the voltage stability and power balance of DC bus were realized simultaneously. The effectiveness of the proposed algorithm was verified by simulation.

articleTitle: Simulation and Analysis of Centralized Bidding Market Clearing Method Based on Intelligent Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: The simulation experiment is an effective means to verify the market rules. Based on the monthly centralized bidding rules in the China's electricity market, the corresponding MCP (market clearing price) and high-low matching clearing price are compared and analyzed in the co-evolutionary algorithm. Firstly, a cooperative evolutionary mechanism based on strategy set is proposed to simulate the game competition between buyers and sellers in real market. Secondly, the monthly centralized bidding rules are studied. Based on the maximization of the respective interests of buyers and sellers, the market clearing price and high-low matching algorithm are compared and analyzed, and the game process in the market is quantitatively analyzed, so as to solve the market simulation equilibrium. The simulation analysis shows that MCP is more volatile than the high-low matching algorithm, and the clearing situation of the market is related to the cost and benefit function of buyers and sellers.

articleTitle: Single-stage Grid-connected Photovoltaic Generation Takes Part in Grid Frequency Regulation for Electromechanical Transient Analysis
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of insufficient frequency regulation capacity caused by the large-scale grid-connected photovoltaic (PV) generation, the active power-frequency droop control strategy and virtual inertia control strategy are proposed for single-stage grid-connected PV generation for electromechanical transient analysis. By modifying the control structure of the inverter, PV generation actively got involved in frequency regulation. The simulation results indicate that: the inverter can control the PV array to increase or decrease the active power generated according to the set droop control and virtual inertia control, so as to suppress the drop or rise of the grid frequency; in the dynamic process of frequency, the incremental power of PV generation induced by the dynamic action of the voltage vector of grid connection point is dependent on its virtual inertia control.

articleTitle: Research on Multi-objective Planning of Active Distribution Network Considering Energy Storage Operation Strategy
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: With the reform of the power market, the distribution network side is gradually released, and the investment on the distribution network side has a huge impact on the distribution network planning. In particular, investment in energy storage has become the focus of investment in distribution networks in recent years. This paper establishes a comprehensive evaluation system for active distribution network planning considering economic, environmental protection, power supply quality and safety assessment. The grid companies and third-party companies are used as different investment entities to analyze the energy storage operation strategy. Based on the comprehensive evaluation system and energy storage operation strategy, a multi-objective optimization model for distribution energy resource in active distribution networks was established. Finally, the example is simulated by using the "2 supply and 1 standby" medium voltage distribution network topology. The simulation results verify the feasibility ADN effectiveness of the model.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Distance Protection Responses in AC Power System With Converter Interface
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
