abstract: Converter interface is essential for asynchronous interconnection and renewable energy integration to the power grid. The deployment of power electronics converters in the AC power system raises some significant technical challenges. One of these challenges is the potential impact of converters on the performance of AC distance protection relays during abnormal conditions. This paper evaluates the distance protection relays' performance on an AC network where the converter is interfaced. A case study based on AL-FADHLI substation (back-to-back converters) with three different scenarios is examined. The converter model is developed using MATLAB Simulink in order to investigate its effect on the distance protection relays. The outcomes of the paper emphasize that when the converters at the interfacing point were the dominant source of power, the distance relay operation will be affected during fault conditions. Other than that, there was no technical problem noticed on the performance of the distance protection relays.

articleTitle: Cost Management Evaluation of Power Grid Engineering: A Life Cycle Theory
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: In the 13th Five-Year Plan, China’s power grid has gradually developed to a high quality, and there is still huge space for power grid construction and investment. The investment scale of power grid project is huge, which needs to occupy a large amount of funds. Therefore, it is of great significance to make a reasonable evaluation of the cost management level for improving the cost management. Based on the whole process cost management, this paper introduces the whole life cycle theory and establishes the evaluation index system of the whole life cycle cost management. And fuzzy comprehensive evaluation theory is used to establish the evaluation model. Finally, a practical engineering case is selected for example analysis, and the evaluation results are compared with the whole process cost management evaluation results. The results show that the method proposed in this paper can reasonably and effectively evaluate the cost management level of power grid project.

articleTitle: Stochastic Security Constraint Unit Commitment Considering the Correlation of Electric Vehicles’ Driving
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Considering the correlation characteristics of electric vehicles' driving, a stochastic security constraint unit commitment (SSCUC) model is established. To depict the correlation of the departure time, arrival time and daily mileage of EV, the Copula function is employed to generate relevant vehicle driving data for various types EVs. And the network constraint is introduced in this model, so that the charging and discharging scheduling plan of electric vehicle (EV) in each period can be reasonably distributed to the network nodes, and the system security is guaranteed. To deal with the complexity and non-linearity of the stochastic characteristics model with EVs, this issue is transformed into a mixed integer linear programming model and then solved by using CPLEX. Results show that there is a correlation of the stochastic characteristics of EV's driving, and the system reliability is improved by adding network power flow constraint to the model.

articleTitle: Impedance Model of MMC With CCSC and Sampling Delays
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Due to the implementation of a large number of renewable energy systems, the oscillations related to the Modular Multilevel Converter (MMC) have caused serious damages to the HVDC systems. Therefore, in this paper the impedance model of the MMC in a wide frequency range has been proposed to identify the impedance characteristics of the MMC. The impedance model proposed not only takes into account the outer and inner control loops, but also considers the effects of the Circulating Current Suppressing Control (CCSC) and sampling delays in the control system. The consistency between the theoretical result and simulation result has also approved the efficiency and accuracy of the proposed impedance model of the MMC.

articleTitle: A Control Methodology of Inverter-Based Battery Energy Storage System for AC Microgrid
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Control Methodology of inverter-based Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) is a key issue for the operation of AC microgird. In this paper, the voltage-mode control of inverter is considered and the control scheme of inverter for BESS is presented. Virtual synchronous generator is a core function and the frequency droop control and Automatic Voltage Regulator (AVR) form the outer cascade loops. The resynchronization of microgrid is rigorously studied, the concept of vector Phase-Locked-Loop (PLL) is adopted and formed as the outside cascade loop. Simulation is conducted by a pilot-site microgird at Mae Hong Son, Thailand, where a 4 MW/1 MWh BESS is designed. During the grid-connected mode, the default function of BESS is spinning reserve operation, while BESS can help forming the grid throughout the islanding mode. In addition, the proposed control technique of BESS can make the transition between grid-connected and islanding modes seamlessly.

articleTitle: Integrated Demand Response in Multi-Energy Market Based on Flexible Loads Classification
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Rapidly growing load demand brings challenges for secure and stable operation of energy systems. In the context of integrated energy system, integrated demand response (IDR) can achieve peak-valley complementation among different energy resources via multi-energy conversion. Accordingly, multi-energy market will be built for integrated energy companies (IECs) to realize the trade among multiple energy resources simultaneously. Focusing on the maximum profit of an IEC in a day-ahead multi-energy market, IDR model using flexible load classification is proposed, where flexible loads are divided into three categories according to the corresponding characteristics: reducible loads, shiftable loads, convertible loads. Simulation results demonstrate that the IEC can earn more profit in multi-energy market via coordinating three kinds of flexible loads to participate in IDR.

articleTitle: The Characteristics Analysis of Controllable Reactor of Transformer Type
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: In order to realize the accurate control of the reactor in the smart grid, the research on the characteristics of the reactor is essential. In this paper, a field-circuit coupled multi-physics joint simulation method is adopted to analyze the working characteristics of controllable reactor of transformer type(CRT). The software ANSYS Mawell is used to establish the two-dimensional model of three-phase CRT, and Maxwell is combined with Simplorer to build a complete circuit in the simulation platform. The simulation results show that CRT meets the requirement of continuous and smooth output of inductive reactive power, and the joint simulation method makes up for the shortcomings of ignoring their own structure and material settings in the simulation software Matlab/simulink or PSCAD, the model is more similar to the real reactor, the working state of CRT is simulated more accurately. The method of joint simulation is feasible and reliable, which can provide more effective reference for engineering application and the design of reactor.

articleTitle: A Three-Phase Hybrid Four-Level Rectifier
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: This paper proposes a three-phase hybrid four-level rectifier. It is a hybrid configuration where each phase consists of a three-level half-bridge circuit and a two-level half-bridge circuit. It provides a new solution to developing a four-level rectifier with small quantity of components and low voltage stresses. A level-shifted carrier modulation scheme and voltage-balance circuit are also introduced. Simulation results have been presented and analyzed to verify the propose topology and modulation scheme.

articleTitle: Research and application of distributed storage technology in power grid enterprise database
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: At present, the physically independent database servers of power grid enterprises are connected through the network to form a logical cluster system. Then they can continue to provide services even if some servers crash because of various accidents. This paper firstly discussed the application of distributed storage technology in power grid enterprise database cluster system, and then presented the active-active architecture based on distributed consistent state machine. Furthermore, a solution of Oracle real application cluster without shared storage is proposed. The schemes are applied to an experimental system of a power grid enterprise. Experimental results show that the schemes have good reusability and scalability, and improve the operation efficiency and high reliability of the system.

articleTitle: An Optimized Control Model of Battery Energy Storage Systems for Primary Frequency Response
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: This paper proposes an optimal model of output power of battery energy storage systems (BESS) in the primary frequency response. A good level of state of charge (SOC) of BESS can extend the lifetime of BESS. This model can not only maintain a good level of SOC, but also optimize the output power of BESS. In addition, this paper presents a new method to confirm coefficients of the model in terms of types of BESS, which can optimal the output power and extend the lifetime. The model is applied in the primary frequency response under the condition of a single area power system. The simulation can prove validity of the model in the primary frequency response.

articleTitle: The realized forms of power electronics technology in new generation distribution power system
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: In order to protect the environment, save energy resource, and reduce carbon dioxide emissions, the global energy transmission is accelerating. As the user's demands for various clean energy and high quality, the application power electronics technology in power system is becoming extensive especially with the support of the continuous improvement of computer information technology, semiconductor technology and control theory. The power grid went into its new generation era. As the overall electricity consumption is increasing sharply today, the power supply system has been effectively supported under the action of power electronics. Based on these reasons, the main research topic of this paper is the power electronics technology realized forms in new generation distributed power system.

articleTitle: Power System Real Time Reliability Monitoring and Security Assessment in Short-term and on-line Mode
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Maintaining the reliability and security of bulk power system is of critical importance, the operation of real time power systems is more difficult and complex due to the increasing structure, more load demands and other issues, implementation of the dynamic security assessment (DSA) based on smart dispatching system and the calculation analysis based on the real-time data collected by the energy management system plays an important role in ensuring the security and stability of power system. The overview of DSA system including architecture, hardware configuration, functional components, computation flow chart are briefly introduced in this paper. An operating experience case in practical that a generator need emergency shutdown due to fault show that the dynamic security assessment system can quickly and efficiently assess and find the weak part in power system, playing an important role in the decision-making for the actual operation of power system.

articleTitle: Research on Predicting the Short-term Output of Photovoltaic (PV) Based on Extreme Learning Machine Model and Improved Similar Day
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: In this paper, an extreme learning machine model based on the improved similar day to predict the short-term output of photovoltaic (PV) is presented. The Pearson correlation coefficient is used to analyze the influence of various meteorological factors on the output of photovoltaic power generation, so as to find out the meteorological factors that have a greater impact on photovoltaic output. And then the prediction model is to be established with combining the fuzzy clustering method by improving the similar day selection method. The multi-day photovoltaic output data with the highest correlation about the day to be tested is used to train the extreme learning machine neural network which is then used to predict the PV output of the day to be measured. Finally, the experimental results show that the proposed method has higher prediction accuracy and shorter calculation time than the traditional prediction method, and what's more, the algorithm is simple and the prediction cost is low. It has a wide application value and research space.

articleTitle: A Multi Objective Framework for Optimal Installation of Distributed Generator Units Using Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: The Distributed Generator (DG) improves the voltage stability and reduces the power losses when integrated in a Distribution Network (DN). This paper offers a multi-objective framework for integration of Distributed Generator (DG) for different configurations of a distribution network. An investigation has been performed for multiple objectives like reduction of real power losses and voltage deviation at the point of integration of type-I DG. The location for integration of DG is determined by using Voltage Sensitivity Index (VSI). Genetic Algorithm (GA) has been used for optimizing the size of DG at the point of integration. This helps in improving the stability of the voltage sensitive buses. The tests have been performed on standard IEEE radial distribution test systems and the results obtained are promising.

articleTitle: Simulation Research on Switching Process of Reactive Power Equipment in DC Converter Station
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Determining the reasonable reactive power balance and switching strategy of converter station is the basis for the safe and stable operation of HVDC transmission system. The reactive power demand of AC/DC systems and the capacity determination of reactive power compensation equipment are described in this paper. The pseudo-steady state DC model CDC6 is established in the PSS/E software, and its user-defined function is used to simulate the reactive power switching process of the converter station with both inductive and capacitive reactive power compensation equipment, from the two aspects of start-up and outage of the DC system. Finally, through the simulation example, the reactive power exchange amount between the converter station and the AC system is always within the limited range, which verifies the effectiveness of the method.

articleTitle: Robust Reconfiguration of Distribution Network Considering the Access of Photovoltaic Electric Vehicle Charging Tower
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: The large-scale application of electric vehicles has led to an increase in the number of charging piles. Charging piles are gradually emerging as charging towers containing new energy sources. The charging load of electric vehicles has brought great uncertainty to the distribution network, and has brought impact to the operation of the distribution network. Considering the uncertainties of charging load of EV, a scene-based multi-period robust reconfiguration model is established in this paper. By defining new variables, the dual transformation process of conventional robust optimization is simplified, and the model is solved by CPLEX solver in GAMS platform. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed method is verified by an IEEE-33 node example.

articleTitle: Fractional Phase Lead Compensation for PIMR-type Repetitive Control on a Grid-tied Inverter
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Phase lead compensation proportional integral multi-resonant type repetitive control (PLC PIMR-type RC) can improve RC control accuracy and error convergence rate. However, when the sampling frequency is reduced, integer lead phase compensation may result in instability of RC system. To solve these problems, a fractional phase lead compensation PIMR-type RC (FPLC PIMR-type RC) is proposed to improve the steady-state performance and dynamic response. FPLC PIMR-type RC is approximately realized by finite impulse response (FIR) filter. Furthermore, simulation results demonstrate the performance of the proposed control scheme.

articleTitle: Numerical Stability and Compensation Method for Equivalent Controlled Source in Electromagnetic Transient Simulation
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: In electromagnetic transient simulation, equivalent controlled source is usually used as an alternative of the original circuit element, such as a controlled voltage source to replace the modular multilevel converter(MMC). Since a time-step delay between the control and circuit system solution, there may be numerical stability problem. By deducing the delay differential equation and calculating its characteristic values, the causes of numerical instability are explained. Finally the numeric compensation method to solve the numerical stability problem is proposed by studying the delay function through Taylor's series and Laplace transformation.

articleTitle: The Study and Application of Field Test Technology of UHVDC Protection System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: In order to implement field test of the functions and performance of UHVDC protection system during the construction and maintenance of the UHVDC transmission project, the field test technology is studied in the paper. Moreover, the corresponding field test device is developed, and the field application is carried out. With the proposed field test technology and device, the external interface devices of the tested UHVDC protection system can be equivalently replaced, and adequate signals can be generated and sent to the tested UHVDC protection system, to meet the function and performance test requirements of UHVDC protection system. The field application indicates that the proposed field test technology can effectively test the functions and performance of UHVDC protection system, which is of great significance to the stable and safe operation of the UHVDC transmission project.

articleTitle: The Role of Pumped Hydro Storage in Supporting Modern Power Systems: A Review of the Practices in China
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Modern power systems are experiencing an increasing penetration of renewables, along with reduced system inertia, reliability, and fault recovery ability. Large-scale energy storage (ES) technologies have been proven to be the most effective measure to mitigate this situation. Pumped hydro storage (PHS) is one of the most well-established and commercially-acceptable utility-scale ES technology nowadays, with the very low unit cost. It can offer ancillary services (AS), including peak shaving, voltage support, fast-response reserve, and black-start capability. This paper aims at reviewing the role and practices of PHS in supporting the modern power system in China. The current status and potential of PHS are illustrated. The functions with different application scenarios are investigated. Moreover, the practices of PHS in different regional power systems in China are studied case by case.

articleTitle: Optimal Dispatch Model of Wind Power Accommodation in Combined Heat and Power System Based on Unit Commitment
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: The principle of power determined by heat and the anti-peak-regulation characteristics of wind power output cause the difficulty of peak regulation in the power grid along with the production of the abandon wind. By analyzing the topological differences between power system and thermal system, establishing positive and negative spinning reserve constraints of the district heating network, and considering both the hot and the cold start-up cost of the units as well as the thermoelectric coupling of the CHP units, a unit commitment model of wind power accommodation in combined heat and power system- whose objective function is to minimize the total coal consumption and environmental cost of the units-is presented in this paper. In this model, unit commitment and optimized dispatch are combined, the electric load is shared by all the units, and the heat load is balanced by the local CHP plants respectively. Finally, the optimization results show that while meeting power and heat load demand, the model of this paper can timely start up or shut down units according to load change and spinning reserve demand, reduce total minimum technical output of operating units, and further improve wind power accommodation rate.

articleTitle: Load Flow Analysis of 132/11 KV Grid Station Bahawalpur region Pakistan and its Voltage Improvement through FACTS Devices using ETAP
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Voltage variations are resulted due to the change in the reactive power caused by the variation in the transmitted load in an electrical power system. Theses variations badly affect the power quality. Flexible AC Transmission system device i.e. SVC is used to improve the voltage. Load Flow study is done on a 132/11 kV substation of Bahawalpur region in Pakistan on ETAP simulation software, in order to determine the drop in voltage and power. Newton Raphson method is adapted for the load flow studies due to its several benefits like convergence rate, less number of iterations and fewer requirements for time. Marginal as well as critical buses are located by simulating the substation in LF module of ETAP. Best location for the placement of SVC in the distribution system is found by the Optimal Capacitor Placement (OCP) module of ETAP. Best ratings of SVC are also found in the same module. Results are obtained before and after the placement of SVC in the distribution system. Results show that the voltage levels at most of the buses are improved as a result of SVC placement. Power factor of the system is also improved from 85% to 99%. It is concluded from the results that SVC is an outstanding power electronic device to make a major contribution in the voltage improvement of a distribution system.

articleTitle: Impact of Voltage Close Loop Control on Small Signal Stability of Virtual Synchronous Generators
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Virtual Synchronous Generators (VSG), as an effective mean to improve the frequency and voltage regulation ability of the photovoltaic (PV) power generation, had aroused wide concern. Different PV-VSG control structures had been conducted in existing researches. One significant distinction between various VSG control structures was whether voltage close loop control (VCLC) was contained in VSG control system or not. To study the impact of VCLC on PV-VSG stability, this paper developed the small-signal models of PV VSGs with and without VCLC. The oscillation modes of both VSGs were calculated based on the developed models, which were applied to investigate the influence from VCLC on VSG damping characteristics as well. On the basis of that, the impact of VCLC on the adaptation and frequency regulation ability of VSG were analyzed. The results indicated that if PV VSG was connected to a low voltage or a weak power grid, the implementing of VCLC was benefit for the oscillation modal characteristics of PV VSG.

articleTitle: Influence of Generator-tripping Time on Transient Stability
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Study the influence of generator-tripping time on transient stability is of great significance for guiding the setting of the optimal generator-tripping time. Based on the extended equal area criterion (EEAC), the paper points out that the generator-tripping operation affects transient power angle stability margin of the system by changing the equivalent electromagnetic power, the equivalent mapping rotor angle and its corresponding energy accumulation interval, and clarifies accordingly the paths of generator-tripping time affects transient power angle stability margin. For the first swing of angle instability of the Hamiltonian system, the complex influences of generator-tripping time on the control effect are revealed. As generator-tripping time increases, the transient power angle stability margin may present an evolution situation that first increases and then decreases, and reaches a maximum value when generator-tripping time equals to the fault clearing time, and may also present decreases monotonically. The analysis conclusions are verified by simulation experiments.

articleTitle: Voltage Sensitivity Analysis and Demand Dispatch Option of Electric Vehicle in Smart Grid
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: The increasing integration of Electric Vehicle (EV) poses unique challenges for voltage and frequency regulation in electric distribution grids. EVs are at present the most reliable substitutes for standard fossil fuel-based cars. The mobility and variability due to EV loads exacerbates the problem of voltage regulation in distribution grids that are characterized by X/R ratios. This paper examines the effect of different operations and impact of EV on the system having voltage sensitivity analysis and choosing an appropriate time of charging and discharging cycles. Coding was done on the distributed system simulator for obtaining the results. To inspect its effectiveness and the performance of EV, IEEE-34 Nodes Test Feeder network is used. The adopted platform to perform the designed task is designed on Open Distribution System Simulator (OpenDSS).

articleTitle: An Out-of-step Splitting Strategy Based on WAMS Information for Oscillation Center Migration under Multi-Operation Mode
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: The increasing development of the large-scale southwest hydropower and the AC /DC transmission leads to power angle stability issue. Based on equivalent three machine system model, this paper deduces the function expression of voltage amplitude and position of multi-frequency oscillation center. The function is affected by power potential amplitude ratio, line impedance, frequency of power potential and initial phase of power potential. Thus, the performance of the out-of-step splitting device is influenced by the change of operating mode and migration of oscillation center affect. Therefore, the out-of-step splitting device cannot be well applied in the multi-frequency out-of-step scenario. On this basis, this paper proposes a new out-of-step splitting strategy for oscillation center migration under multi-operation mode based on WAMS information. In detail, the proposed strategy can obtain bus voltage amplitude/phase information provided by WAMS and local Ucosφ criterion to determine position of out-of-step oscillation center and out-of-step period. The simulation results show that the influence of different power system operation modes on the migration characteristics of oscillation center is correctly applied in multi-frequency out-of-step oscillation scenario, and the proposed strategy based on WAMS information has a good adaptability under different operation modes.

articleTitle: Distributed Dual-Loop Active Disturbance Rejection Control for DC Microgrids
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: To solve the problems of complicated parameter setting and poor anti-disturbance in the droop control of traditional DC microgrid, a distributed dual-loop active disturbance rejection control (ADRC) strategy for a DC microgrid is proposed. Compared with the existing traditional droop control, the ADRC strategy has strong anti-disturbance ability, which can effectively suppress the parameter fluctuation and the uncertain disturbance in the power grid. In this paper, a simulation model is built in Matlab/Simulink and the simulation results show that when disturbance occurs, the control strategy can effectively adjust the power balance in DC microgrid to ensure a constant bus voltage. Compared with the traditional PI control method, the proposed method can reduce the voltage fluctuation and improve the anti-disturbance ability of the DC microgrid.

articleTitle: An Optimal Control Strategy of Coordinated Recovery of Multi-infeed HVDC Systems
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: In order to facilitate coordinated recovery of Multi-infeed HVDC systems after inverter ac faults, a new optimal control model for the voltage-dependent current order limit (VDCOL) unit is proposed in this paper. The signal combines the advantages of DC-VDCOL and AC-VDCOL which are dependent on DC voltage and AC voltage respectively. New model first analyzes the working mechanism of CIGRE HVDC benchmark model and the problems existing in present Multi-infeed HVDC recovery researches. The parameters optimization model for the VDCOL and the extinction angle controllers is further established to improve their performance. Finally, a triple-infeed HVDC system is taken as an example to verify the effectiveness of the new optimization model in PSCAD/ EMTDC.It can be seen from the simulation results that the new optimization model can more sensitively reflect the recovery of the voltage on the commutation bus thus promote the autonomous coordinated recovery of Multi-infeed HVDC links, and the optimization of HVDC key control parameters can further improve the performance of system recovery.

articleTitle: Cooperative Control In An Islanded Microgrid Under Blockchain-Based Market Operation
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: An islanded microgrid is formed by a group of distributed generations (DGs), which operates independently from the power grid. Being unattached from the grid, it is necessary to regulate internal DGs' frequency and voltage so that normal operation within the microgrid can be properly maintained. This research is conducted in the scenario of an islanded microgrid that is hosting blockchain-based transactive energy markets. Under such assumption, this research focuses on DG's internal control schemes and cooperation in order to maintain microgrid's continuous operation. A cooperative secondary frequency controller is proposed in a hierarchical DG control structure. By sharing information between DGs, the proposed controller will generate a compensator into secondary control so that the output frequency can be restored. Moreover, simulations have been conducted in an islanded microgrid consisting of two DGs. The comparison of simulation result also demonstrates the effectiveness of our proposed cooperative control scheme.

articleTitle: Research on Estimation of Regional Distributed Photovoltaic Output Based on K-medoids Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Distributed photovoltaic (PV) power generation has been widely applied in recent years. The monitoring of distributed PV output plays an important role in the safe and stable operation of power grid. However, the current monitoring capability cannot cover all distributed PV power stations. To solve this problem, a method for estimating regional distributed PV output based on k-medoids algorithm is proposed. Firstly, the feature set of each station is constructed. Then, the phased clustering and sample station selection are realized based on k- medoids algorithm. Finally, combined with the real-time power data of sample stations, the regional distributed PV output is estimated. The experimental results show that when the number of sample stations reaches more than 22% of the number of stations in this region, estimation accuracy can reach more than 90%. The method proposed in this paper needs fewer monitoring sites, which has strong practicability.

articleTitle: Layered real-time optimization and coordinated control of active distribution network considering distributed generation
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Reasonable scheduling method is the key to realize the safety and economic operation of active distribution network. Considering the real-time volatility of new energy generation such as wind or photovoltaic, real-time control is required during the scheduling process. At present, the active distribution network optimization scheduling has less research in terms of covering various loads of cold, heat and electricity. On the basis of considering the real-time volatility of distributed generation, a layered real-time optimization and coordinated scheduling method is proposed. The power layer is responsible for the power supply of important electrical loads, the load layer regulates the output of the gas generator, and the remaining schedulable power is used to meet the cold/heat load demand, thereby realizing the refined and intensive development of the energy utilization mode. Through the simulation and analysis of the actual situation of the active distribution network in a park, the rationality and effectiveness of the layered coordination control method are verified.

articleTitle: Short-term Load Forecasting Approach with SVM and Similar Days Based on United Data Mining Technology
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: In view of the defect of support vector machine (SVM) when used for short-term load forecast such as large data amount, long training time and too much redundant information, the paper proposes a SVM forecasting model with similar days based on united data mining technology. Taking advantage of the data mining technology in processing large data and eliminating redundant information, uses a combined approach of several mehods and chooses some historical days whose characteristics is highly similar to forecasted day with the consideration of various factors such as date characteristics, weather conditions and range of average load, and then make the new data sequence as the training sample of SVM. With the comprehensively consideration of various factors, it not only simplifies the input dimension and calculation of the model, but also intensifies the regularity of historical data, thus is more convenient for application. The numerical example shows the effective and available of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Coordinated Optimal Configuration Method of Hybrid Energy Storage Systems in Energy Internet System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Energy internet is the key to achieve the energy reform goals in China, and the energy storage technology is one of the key technologies of energy internet development, which has received spread attention. There exist various kinds of energy resources in the energy internet system, and different kinds of energy storage technologies are necessary to restore energy. Based on the analysis of principles and characteristics of energy storage technologies, the goals that hybrid energy storage systems need to achieve are presented. The energy demands of energy storage system are declared, and the necessity of the hybrid energy storage configuration is presented. On the basis, the coordinated optimal configuration method of hybrid energy storage system is presented and the efficiency and accuracy are verified through the case simulation.

articleTitle: Reliability Assessment of High-Medium-Low Voltage Integrated Distribution Network Using Hybrid Method
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Distribution network is an important part of grid power supply. It is necessary to carry out an accurate reliability assessment method of distribution network, but traditional distribution network reliability assessment often lacks the assessment of low-voltage distribution network. In this paper, considering the mutual influence of high, medium and low voltage distribution networks, an integral mode of distribution network is established. The hybrid method combining quasi-sequential Monte Carlo method and analytical method is used to evaluate the reliability of the integrated distribution network topology. Finally, the IEEE RTS79 system and the modified RBTS BUS6 F4 are used to verify the effectiveness of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Impact of Time-Shiftable Traffic Demands on Coupled Transportation and Power Distribution Systems
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: With the increasing penetration of electric vehicles in modern cities, the tie between urban transportation system and power distribution system is becoming more evident. Spatial and temporal distributions of load demands in fast charging stations alter power flow patterns, raising the risk of over-low bus voltage and congestions, and thus threaten distribution system security. Similar to the flexible demand in smart grid, traffic demand in the transportation system, which is defined as the volume of vehicles travelling from one place to another in unit time, is also shiftable over time, as motorists would like to avoid rush hours and save travel time. This paper proposed a multi-period traffic assignment model with time-shiftable traffic demands. In order to capture the deliberate postponed or advanced travels, the dynamic traffic demand between each origin-destination pair nodes over time is formulated as a matrix variable. The traffic assignment model consists of several Wardrop user equilibrium problems in consecutive periods coupled by demand conservation constraints, and gives rise to a convex program with polyhedral constraints. The charging station loads are assumed to be proportional to the traffic flow in the service area. The power distribution system is operated in accordance with optimal power flow. Case studies demonstrate the benefit brought by the temporal flexibility of traffic demand.

articleTitle: Architecture Design and Evaluation of Hybrid AC/DC Power Grids Based on Power Electronic Transformer
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: This paper presents the architecture design and evaluation method of power electronic transformer (PET) based hybrid AC/DC power grids. The architecture design is carried out from two aspects: one is AC/DC hybrid substation wiring mode, and the other is PET based DC grid topology. Then the benefit evaluation of different architecture is established, including maximum power supply capacity, power supply reliability, and fault operation characteristics. Finally, all these operation performances of three typical architectures are compared and analyzed.

articleTitle: Energy Management Optimization Strategy of User Side in Smart Grid Based on Model Predictive Control
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: This paper proposes a multi-time scale coordinated optimal scheduling model based on model predictive control, which realizes energy management optimization of user side in smart grid. Firstly, the model of user side in smart grid including seven parts is constructed, which is more comprehensive and specific than previous research. Secondly, a multi-time scale optimal scheduling control strategy based on model predictive control is proposed. With the objective of minimizing the total cost in one day, a day-ahead economic optimization model has established. Then the model is solved by mixed integer non-linear programming. With the objective of minimizing the error between the daily scheduling and the actual output of the day, the intra-day rolling optimal scheduling model is established. Then the tracking of the daily schedule is realized by solving the model with rolling time-domain optimization strategy, which is based on model predictive control. Finally, the strategy is applied to a user side in smart grid in Beijing. The simulation results verify the feasibility and effectiveness of the optimization strategy. At the same time, the influence of different parameters (prediction time domain and unit climbing rate) on energy scheduling results is analyzed.

articleTitle: Improving CFI of LCC-HVDC Systems Through Voltage Compensation Using UPFC
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: This paper proposes a voltage compensation scheme (VCS) to improve the commutation failure immunity (CFI) of line-commutated converter-based high voltage direct-current transmission (LCC-HVDC) systems with an unified power flow controller (UPFC). A voltage compensation control system was designed for the UPFC, which enables the UPFC to inject three-phase voltages in series with the receiving-end ac source to compensate the distortion and magnitude drop of the inverter-side ac voltage in the cases where external disturbances occur. In this way, satisfactory commutation voltage is provided for the inverter station of a LCC-HVDC system and CFI of the LCC-HVDC system is improved. Simulation studies were undertaken on the CIGRE LCC-HVDC benchmark system in the cases where single-phase-to-ground faults occurred in the receiving-end ac grid. CFI of the test system having the proposed VCS, a commutation failure prevention method (CFPREV), and a direct-current predictive control strategy (DCPC) implemented respectively was investigated.

articleTitle: Active Distribution Network Energy Management with Cooperative Scheduling of Multi-microgrids
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: This paper focuses on the energy management of active distribution network with microgrids for the full use of the coordination and complementarity amongst microgrids. Firstly, combining the hierarchical control theory with the distribution network architecture of multiple microgrids, and taking the optimal coordination of the distribution network as the target, this paper proposes a two-step dynamic hierarchical scheduling strategy. Microgrid scheduling modes are categorized into three types, namely coordinated scheduling, separate grid-connected scheduling and islanding operation, and different modes correspond to different microgrid scheduling strategies. In addition, the dispatching mode could switch reasonably with the mode information sent to the energy management center of the distribution network. Finally, taking the IEEE33 system with four microgrids as an example, the effect of the number of microgrids participating in coordinated dispatching and switching of microgrid dispatching modes on load characteristics and the operation economy are investigated in detail.

articleTitle: The Study and Application of Security Control Plan Incorporating Frequency Stability (SCPIFS) in CPS-Featured Interconnected Asynchronous Grids
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: The CPS-featured modern asynchronous grids interconnected with HVDC tie-lines facing the hazards from bulk power imbalance shock. With the aid of cyber layer, the SCPIFS incorporates the frequency stability constrains is put forwarded. When there is bulk power imbalance caused by HVDC tie-lines block incident or unplanned loads increasing, the proposed SCPIFS ensures the safety and frequency stability of both grids at two terminals of the HVDC tie-line, also keeps the grids operate economically. To keep frequency stability, the controllable variables in security control strategy include loads, generators outputs and the power transferred in HVDC tie-lines. McCormick envelope method and ADMM are introduced to solve the proposed SCPIFS optimization model. Case studies of two-area benchmark system verify the safety and economical benefits of the SCPFS. HVDC tie-line transferred power can take the advantage of low cost generator resource of both sides utmost and avoid the load shedding via tuning the power transferred through the operating tie-lines, thus the operation of both connected asynchronous grids is within the limit of frequency stability domain.

articleTitle: Capacity Allocation Optimization of Components in Regional Integrated Micro-energy System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Through realizing the mutual supply of power, gas, heating, cooling and other energy systems, regional integrated micro-energy system (RIMS) could make full use of the absorption capacity of renewable energy, and improve the comprehensive utilization rate of energy. The capacity allocation of components is the key content of RIMS design. This paper establishes an optimization model with the objective of minimizing the cost of unit productivity and constraints of energy balance, equipment outputs and charging & discharging power of energy storage devices. A case of RIMS was studied to verify the model. Simulation results show that the proposed capacity allocation optimization model could effectively reduce the cost of unit productivity, reduce peak-valley difference of various types of loads and improve utilization efficiency of clean energy.

articleTitle: Method of Static Reactive Power Allocation Considering N-1 Failure Mode and Load Fluctuation
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Voltage stability problems in power grid require to applicable reactive power allocation method. As the main way in actual engineering construction, static reactive power allocation method is not suitable because the new serious operating conditions such as all single equipment breakdown (called "N-1 failure mode") and load fluctuation are not considered. Therefore, this paper proposes a static reactive power allocation method that considers load fluctuation and all N-1 failure modes, which uses the strategy of "selecting location as the first and determining capacity as the second". Firstly, the method analyzes the operating conditions for every sense under all N-1 failure and maximum load fluctuation, and determines preselected nodes of the allocation. Then, this method determines the basic capacity in each pre-selected node and uses the genetic algorithm to optimize the cost of allocation scheme. At last, simulation analysis on the system of IEEE-30 nodeswith are carried out. The proposed static reactive power allocation scheme can effectively resist all voltage stability problems caused by load fluctuation and equipment breakdown while the whole cost of static reactive power allocation was better.

articleTitle: Component Importance Indices of Transmission Systems Based on The Impact-increment Based State Enumeration Method
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: In view of the problem that the existing transmission system reliability assessment indices cannot determine the weak links of the system, the component importance index is put forward based on the idea of using importance measures. Furthermore, this paper proposes a method for quickly calculating the component importance index of each transmission line combined with the impact-increment based state enumeration method. The results of component importance index can be used to rank the transmission lines and put forward the most effective measures to improve the system reliability. Case studies are performed on IEEE RTS-79 test system to demonstrate the accuracy and computational efficiency of the proposed component importance indices. It also verifies the guiding role of the proposed component importance index in improving the system reliability.

articleTitle: Influence of HVDC Reactive Power Compensation Modeling Method on Short-Circuit Current Calculation
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: With the extensive application of HVDC/UHVDC projects and the continuous growth of its transmission power, the influence of reactive power compensation on calculation results of short-circuit currents can’t be ignored. At present, standards about short-circuit current calculation in three phase ac systems have not been unified and there has been no technical standard about the modeling method for HVDC reactive power compensation in short-circuit current calculation. This paper theoretically analyzes the influence of modeling methods of HVDC reactive power compensation on the amplitude of short- circuit current periodic component and the attenuation time constant of short-circuit current DC component. Based on a practical system, the above analysis about short-circuit current calculation results is verified. Finally, suggestions for HVDC reactive power compensation modeling in short-circuit current calculation are given.

articleTitle: Real-Time Dispatch of Flexible Ramping Products for Energy Storage and Demand Response
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: With the increasing share of variable generation in power systems, ramping capacities, i.e., upward and downward ramping capacities from flexible generating resources are continuously demanding in the future years. Traditionally, thermal units are designated as the primary resources to provide ramping capacities. In this paper, we aim to exploit ramping capacities from many other flexible resources including the energy storage device and the demand response resource. A real-time economic dispatch framework is established, which clears the energy and flexible ramping products (FRP) jointly for each flexible resource. The proposed model can not only maintain a power balance at the current time but also accommodate any potential uncertainties in the future time. Line congestion issue is also taken into account in the proposed model. Mathematically, the problem is formulated as a two-stage robust optimization problem that is solved using an affine decision rule. An illustrative example demonstrates the effectiveness of our proposed model.

articleTitle: Analysis of Voltage Stability Weak Nodes Location and Optimization Measures in DC Multi-infeed Receiving-end Power Grid
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: With the nationwide deployment of renewable energy power DC multi-infeed receiving-end system forms at the load center. The AC and DC system interaction increases the effects to power system security and stability. The AC system fault may lead to DC system commutation failure or even DC block. Voltage collapse may be caused by a large-scale power flow transferring subsequently. A comprehensive application method of continuation power flow, serious contingency screening and modal analysis is proposed to find static voltage stability limit and locate weak nodes. Southern Jiangsu power grid is studied to verify it. A reactive power compensation measure for voltage stability optimization installing FACTS device at weak area is given, which can improve the voltage stability limit and voltage recovery level of DC multi-infeed receiving-end power grid.

articleTitle: Voltage Control Partitioning of Wind Power Integration System Based on pilot-bus control space
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: The high penetration level of wind power will bring the stochastic and variable characteristics in power system operation. To obtain the stable network partitioning that can adapt to wind power fluctuation, and combine with the feature that pilot-bus is considered as control center of secondary voltage control. Voltage control partitioning of wind power integration system based on pilot-bus control space is proposed. Based on the expectation of voltage control sensitivity in terms of pilot-bus to load bus, pilot-bus control space is established, which can comprehensively reflect the controllability in terms of pilot bus to load bus with wind power fluctuation. Recursive algorithm is utilized to develop pilot-bus control space, representing the concept of quasi-steady-state physical response. Finally, Kohonen neural network is used to implement the network partitioning. Case study based on IEEE 39-bus is provided to illustrate effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Transient Model Integrated Power Flow and Its Application in Electromagnetic Transient Simulation Initialization
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: With the integration of numerous complex electrical devices, the increasing complexity of China's power grid has great influence on power flow calculation. In this work, a general transient model integrated power flow (TMIPF) method for complex systems is proposed, which solves the steady-state model and complex transient model by conventional power flow method and simulation method respectively, and adopts the Thevenin equivalence and fixed-point iteration to provide the power flow of the entire complex system. Then, the TMIPF results are utilized to initialize the hybrid AC-DC system electromagnetic transient (EMT) model, and the hybrid AC-DC system EMT model combining IEEE 39-bus system with the CIGRE HVDC system is built on the CloudPSS platform. Test results indicate the effectiveness and accuracy of the proposed TMIPF method, and validate the feasibility of TMIPF's application in EMT simulation initialization.

articleTitle: Influence of Nozzle Expansion Angle on the Breaking Performance of Ultra-high Voltage SF6 Circuit Breaker
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: In order to ensure that the ultra-high voltage SF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub> circuit breaker has good breaking performance, the two nozzle structures respectively using one expansion angle and two expansion angles are designed. The flow field distribution during the breaker breaking process is obtained by numerical simulation, and the influence of the two kinds of expansion angle design structures on the breaking performance are compared and analyzed. The several different design structures of one expansion angle are also researched, and the recommended interrupter structure is verified by short-circuit breaking test. The results of simulation and test show that, compared with the two expansion angle structure, the interrupter using one expansion angle structure has better breaking performance, which is of great significance to the design of ultra-high voltage SF6 circuit breaker nozzle.

articleTitle: Decentralized MPC-Based Frequency Control of Networked Microgrids
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: This paper proposes a decentralized model predictive control (MPC)-based controller to regulate the frequency of off-grid networked microgrid systems with voltage-sensitive loads. By actively utilizing the load voltage sensitivity, the proposed controller regulates the system frequency through operating voltages. Meanwhile, the MFC technique enables the controller to produce adaptive frequency control signals with voltage constraints considered based on the changing system conditions. The proposed controller provides fast frequency control without introducing batteries or causing customer dissatisfaction. Furthermore, as no communication is needed among microgrids, the communication and computation burden is greatly relieved. Simulation results on a modified IEEE benchmark system demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed controller.

articleTitle: Power Distribution Network Disconnection Fault Diagnosis Using Data Mining Method
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the 10kV distribution network branch line ungrounded disconnection fault is difficult to be detected, using the multi-source data from distribution network, the method of fault diagnosis through data mining is proposed. Firstly, based on the existing data sources, a fault diagnosis feature set with both electrical features and non- electrical features is established. Then, the Principal Component Analysis algorithm is used for feature reduction. Finally, based on the FP-Growth algorithm, the association rules are mined to determine whether the branch line ungrounded disconnection fault has happened. The case analysis using historical operation data shows that the proposed method can quickly and accurately diagnose the occurrence of the 10kV distribution network branch line ungrounded disconnection fault, and has good error tolerance.

articleTitle: Long-Term Electric Vehicle Planning in a Microgrid
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Isolated microgrids depend mainly on diesel generation and have polluting transportation. This is being addressed by the introduction of renewable energy resources and electric vehicles (EVs). Hence, this paper presents a novel long-term planning model for the introduction of EVs in isolated microgrids. This work studies the replacement of internal combustion vehicles with electric ones by analyzing their respective investment, maintenance and operation costs. Various case studies are discussed, considering different EV and solar photovoltaic (PV) penetration levels, and varying prices of diesel in the planning horizon. Results demonstrate that investing in EVs could significantly reduce net present costs.

articleTitle: Operational Optimization of Wind Farm Integrated Battery/Electrolyzer in Electricity Market Considering Fluctuation Penalty
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: With the liberalization of the electricity market and the rapid development of renewable energy technology, more and more renewable energy power stations such as wind farms participate in the electricity market. These renewable energy power stations are using the entire power systems as their storage which will eventually influence the safe and stable operation of the power grid. In order to address this problem, the electricity market considers the fluctuation penalty which can incentivize investors to take measures on fluctuation reduction. Therefore, this paper proposes two strategies on fluctuation penalty reduction which are: 1) Integrating battery into the wind farm, 2) Integrating electrolyzer into the wind farm. Based on the objective of the income, the optimal operations of the two strategies are presented and investigated on the two typical days. The results reveal that the battery performs better than the electrolyzer on mitigating fluctuation penalty but the electrolyzer can obtain more income than the battery.

articleTitle: Economic Analysis of User-end Grid Connected Energy Storage System Based on the Sensitivity Analysis of Battery Price
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: With the rapid development of the renewable energy system, distributed energy supply system, micro-grid and smart grid, the need for energy storage in the energy market has become more and more imminent. In recent years, the battery energy storage has had a rapid growth. Most of the battery energy storages are installed at the user-end. It is important for the user to evaluate the economy of the ESS systematically for the economic analysis and evaluation of the energy storage system (ESS) can provide guarantee for the profitability of investment project. In this paper, an economic analysis of user- end grid connected ESS is made, which is based on the sensitivity analysis of battery price. The cost composition and revenue model of the user-end ESS are studied systematically, and the IPP, ROI and NII are introduced into the economic analysis and evaluation of the ESS. Based on a case study, the influence of the battery price change on the cost and the economy of the user-end ESS is analyzed through a sensitivity analysis of battery price. Our researches show that the battery cost reduction has a significantly impact on the economy of the user-end ESS. It will be a principal factor to promote the development of the energy storage industry.

articleTitle: Fault Analysis and Countermeasure of Arc Suppression Coil in 66kV System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Through the diagnosis and treatment process of the 66kV arc suppression coil burning accident in 220kV substation, the main reason for the failure of the arc suppression coil of this station is that it is caused by the hidden troubles left by the manufacturer in the production process. Firstly, the performance of the arc suppression coil and the causes of the arc suppression coil failure are explained. Secondly, the main reason for the failure of the arc suppression coil is that the total current through the ground fault point is high when the single phase intermittent arc grounding occurs, and the high-frequency oscillating current is the real cause of most arc-suppression coil failures. Again, through the oil chromatographic test analysis before and after the arc-suppression coil accident of the substation, and after returning to the factory for the core inspection by the failure of the arc-suppression coil of the substation, it is further verified that the 66kV arc-suppression coil leaves hidden dangers in the production process. The high-frequency oscillating current causes an accident to expand and occur.

articleTitle: Imprecise Risk Assessment of Distribution Network Based on Evidence and Utility Theory
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: This paper introduces a novel imprecise probabilistic risk assessment method to evaluate distribution network failure probability, which is equivalent to research the opposite side of reliability. First, this paper proposes to analyze the interval probabilistic model of distribution network operation reliability using Evidence theory and Bayesian theory. Then the authors implement a novel algorithm for risk assessment combined with fault severity evaluation mode based on the utility theory. Finally, taking a simplified equivalent distribution network system as study case, the intervals results of imprecise risk assessment show that the proposed risk assessment method can effectively evaluate the quantification grading index of risk under different components combination failure within distribution network.

articleTitle: Interval Electrical Betweenness Method for Power Grid Vulnerability Assessment Considering Wind Power
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Wind energy has been integrated into power grid on a large scale. Due to its volatility and intermittency, the integration has brought new challenges to the security and vulnerability assessment of power grid. This paper proposes an interval electrical betweenness method to identify the vulnerable lines and nodes of power grid with wind power. Firstly, the wind generation is modelled as interval numbers, and the interval power flow is employed to obtain the interval power in transmission lines. Then, according to the topology and operation of the power grid lines and nodes, an interval electrical betweenness function is presented to represent the vulnerability. Furthermore, the interval number ranking method is used to rank the obtained interval electrical betweenness so as to identify vulnerable lines and nodes. The simulation results of IEEE 39-bus system verify the comprehensiveness and effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Priority Rules on the Charging of Electric Vehicles with Energy Storage
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: We study the joint scheduling of deferrable (electric vehicle charging) demands and energy storage devices in the presence of random renewable generation, electric vehicle arrivals, and electricity prices. We formulate the cost-minimizing scheduling problem as a dynamic program. We establish an index based priority rule for an optimal scheduling policy: it is optimal to serve a demand with less laxity first, and for two demands with the same laxity, the demand with a later deadline should have the priority. Numerical results show that the characterized priority rule significantly outperforms the earliest deadline first (EDF) policy.

articleTitle: Research on Virtual Synchronous Generator Control Strategy Based on the Battery State of Charge
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: The rotational inertia of the power grid is reduced due to the high penetration level of distributed generator (DG) in the system. Virtual synchronous generator (VSG) technology has a prominent advantage as an effective way to solve this problem, but it is still constrained by the energy storage system. Firstly, a virtual synchronous generator control strategy based on battery state of charge (SOC-VSG) according to the actual working conditions is proposed in this paper. The virtual inertia is adjusted according to the state of charge of the battery, and it can avoid over-charging or over-discharging and prolong the service life of the battery. Secondly, the system stable operating boundary conditions and the setting principle of control parameters are proposed in this paper. Finally, a four-terminal network model with battery VSG unit is built, and the validity of the proposed control strategy is verified by the controller-level hardware-in-the-loop experimental test platform.

articleTitle: Technical and Economic Analysis of Aluminum Conductor with Multi-stranded Composite Core and Its Application
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: It is anticipated that significant expansion of power systems will continue in next decade in China. Given constrains of limited transmission corridors, alternative augmented capacity wire is highly expected, with larger transmission capacity, excellent lower sag, lower losses, stronger corrosion and wind resistance. The paper developed an innovative overhead augmented capacity wire, aluminum conductor with multi-stranded composite core (ACMCC), based on stranded continuous carbon fiber. Its technical characteristics and cost benefit analysis were detailed, with comparison to other augmented capacity wires. ACMCC has been applied in several transmission lines in China Southern Power Grid. Field application showed that ACMCC may be one of the most promising wires because of its excellent properties, conductor structure reliability and fitting installation convenience.

Author Keywords: Aluminum conductor with multi-stranded composite core

articleTitle: Coordinated Control Strategy of Electric Vehicles and Energy Storage System for Smoothing Power Fluctuations of Photovoltaics
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: The increasing penetration of distributed photovoltaic (PV) generation causes significant power fluctuations in the distribution network. To maintain power quality and reliability, some measures must be taken to manage these fluctuations. Energy storage system (ESS) which have the advantages of high power density and fast charging and discharging switching speed are widely proposed to smooth the PV fluctuations. However, the operation cost of ESS is expensive. Dispatching charging and discharging power of EV is an economical way to solve the problem, but the dispatchable capacity of EV is not always sufficient. Therefore, we propose a real-time control strategy that the PV power fluctuations can be smoothed by EVs and ESS, in which a convex optimization model is established to solve the problem. This strategy smooths the PV power under the uncertainties of the PV output using the flexibility of the EV. The smoothing performances can be ensured by ESS output when the dispatching capacity of EV is insufficient. The smoothing error is controllable with the convex optimization model. The proposed strategy is able to reduce the total installed capacity and avoid the overcharge and overdischarge of ESS. Case studies were carried out to demonstrate the validity and application advantages of the strategy.

articleTitle: Data-Driven Short-Term Voltage Stability Prediction Based on Pre-Fault Operating State
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Voltage stability is one of the key factors to ensure the stable operation of power systems. The study of Short-Term Voltage Stability (STVS) is necessary when the complexity of the dynamic response of the power system is increased. In order to reduce the probability of short-term voltage instability and the consequences caused by short-term voltage instability, it is necessary to predict the STVS of power systems before the faults have cause serious consequences. In this paper, a STVS prediction method based on pre-fault operation status and anticipate faults is proposed. A Support Vector Machine (SVM) model is constructed and trained based on the samples generated using numerical simulation software. The effectiveness of the proposed method is presented based on an actual power grid model of China. The prediction accuracy of the SVM model can reach over than 96%, so it has the potential to use practically.

articleTitle: Abnormal Electricity Consumption Detection from Incomplete Records in Power System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Due to the limited channel bandwidth or interference signals in the advance metering infrastructures, there are usually some missing or human-revised data among the electricity consumption records of civilian customers. In order to make full use of this kind of records, machine learning techniques are introduced in this paper for electricity consumption sensitivity analysis regarding to the weather features. With the missing and revised records filtered out, each customer would have an individual regression model between weather conditions and the power demand. The importance of variables in the regression model is regarded as the sensitivity to various weather features. Then the abnormal consumption patterns are detected with a typical outlier identification algorithm based on different weather sensitivities among all the customers. The methods used in this paper show good results to identify the abnormal consumption patterns effectively regardless the quality of the original data.

articleTitle: Asymmetric Fault Propagation Mechanism on AC Side of Hybrid Microgrid And Suppression Methods
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: The analysis of asymmetric fault propagation mechanism on AC side and the study of its suppression methods are very important for the safe and stable operation of AC/DC hybrid microgrid. In this paper, the influence of asymmetric short-circuit fault on DC power and electricity is analyzed. On this basis, a compensation control strategy of negative sequence zero-sequence voltage is proposed to suppress the transmission of this type of fault. Then a hybrid micro-grid model using the control strategy of "network-network" interconnected converter is built on the simulation software PSCAD/EMTDC, which verifies the correctness of the above fault analysis and the effectiveness of the improved control strategy.

articleTitle: Peaking Compensation Mechanism for Supply and Demand Sides Union Promoting Wind Power Integration
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: A peaking compensation mechanism for supply side and demand side is proposed aiming to deal with large-scale wind power curtailment. Firstly, based on the clustering thought, the demand-side battery energy storage system (BESS) is integrated into virtual peaking plant (VPP), and thermal units are divided into several deep peaking clusters. Secondly, a two-stage coordinated optimization scheduling model is constructed based on the cooperative game theory. In the first stage, load curve is optimized according to the control strategy of VPP. On the basis of, a wind-thermal-VPP coordinated optimization operation model with considering wind power curtailment is established. Furthermore, a two-layer peaking compensation mechanism based on improved Shapley value is proposed, in which the outer layer accounts for the coefficient of peaking capability and the inner layer is allocated by peaking mileage. Results show that the proposed method is effective for promoting the supply side and demand side union peaking.

articleTitle: Method of energy station capacity configuration for residential district-level integrated energy system considering virtual energy storage
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: This paper proposes a novel energy station capacity configuration method for residential district-level integrated energy system (DIES), which can take account into virtual energy storage (VES). Firstly, the residential DIES model is established based on the energy hub. The VES is analyzed through thermal balance by differential equations. Then the optimal capacity configuration model aimed at minimizing the total cost is presented. Constraints of energy purchase, power and energy balance, converters' operation characteristics, reserve capacities and VES are all taken into consideration. Piecewise linearization is utilized to transfer the initial non-convex and non-linear problem into a mixed integer linear programming (MILP). A practical calculation example illustrates the validity of the method. Results indicate that compared to the traditional method, the capacity configuration considering VES can reduce the total cost by 5.23%.

articleTitle: Comparison of dispatch strategy in hybrid energy micro-grid with high PV penetration
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Renewable energy such as photovoltaic (PV) has undergone rapid technological development recently, and become more and more popular to be integrated in micro-grids due to its availability of less expensive space. However, such integration may bring reliability issues due to intermittency and uncertainty of its output power. As a result, back up sources such as diesel generators and energy storage are necessary in maintaining reliability of the micro-grid. Further, with all the components integrated in the hybrid energy system, a dispatch strategy which determines the component output and balances the power flow is also required in the dispatch operation. This paper firstly analyses two different dispatch strategies for the hybrid energy micro-grid with high PV penetration. Then, based on real data simulation, comparisons and conclusions are made between the two strategies regarding to their performances in the dispatch operation.

articleTitle: Energy Savings Using Direct Current (DC) from Photovoltaic (PV) System in a Residential Home
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: The conventional AC nanogrid with photovoltaic (PV) system has suffered from power loss caused by power conversion from DC to AC and back to DC for most of the end use in a typical residential home. To overcome the problem, DC nanogrid is proposed in this paper. Partial and full DC nanogrids are designed and their efficiencies are compared with a full AC nanogird. The simulation study results show that partial DC nanoogrid has 79.2% of overall efficiency while AC nanogrid has 71.87%. Furthermore, the efficiency is improved to 99.74% for a full DC nanogrid. It proves the less amount of power conditioners used in the system the higher the efficiency can be obtained. Moreover, an economic evaluation is conducted on the proposed two DC nanogrids to investigate whether they are sustainable and feasible. From the simulation studies conducted, it is shown that partial DC nanogrid saves electricity bill and capital cost but full DC nanogrid is not feasible even if it saves electricity bill spectacularly high but it needs extremely expensive capital cost.

articleTitle: An Optimal Dispatch Strategy of Distribution Networks with Electric Vehicle Charging Stations Integrated Energy Storage
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: With increased penetration of distributed energy resources and electric vehicles (EVs), EV charging stations integrated with energy storage (ES) is regarded as an important measure to mitigate the power fluctuation and support the distribution networks. Therefore, this paper works on the dispatch strategy of distribution networks with EV charging stations coupled with ES. Firstly, a within-day dispatch model of distribution network is established which consider the characteristics of EV charging load. Secondly, an optimal dispatch strategy is proposed to minimize the daily operation cost, which consider the difference of electricity price under peak and valley load curve. Finally, Case studies are conducted and the simulation results demonstrate that the proposed dispatch strategy can greatly reduce the economic operation costs and smooth the power fluctuations within the charging station.

articleTitle: MMC-HVDC Fault Ride-through Coordination Control Strategy at Both Ends
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: When the MMC-HVDC system supplying power to passive network has AC fault, the dc voltage will drop seriously or even collapse.
