This paper introduces the topological structure and decoupling control of MMC, and then analyzes the mechanism of capacitor discharge of MMC in the case of AC fault at the sending end and the correlation between dc voltage sag and the control mode. The core idea of the strategy is that, when the fault occurs, the d-axis current obtained by the original sending end control mode under the fault condition is taken as the actual measurement, and the d-axis current obtained by the original sending end control mode under the steady-state condition is taken as the reference value of the d-axis current under the fault condition. Finally, the study is carried on PSCAD platform, and the effectiveness of the strategy is verified.

articleTitle: Dynamic State Estimation of Distribution Network Base on Pseudo Measurement Modeling and UPF
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: The economic and reliable operation of distribution network relies on state variables information from state estimator. However, since the amount of distributed generation (DG) and electric vehicles connected to distribution network is steadily growing, the distribution network is full of randomness and volatility, which increases the difficulty of accurate state estimation. In this paper, a dynamic state estimation (DSE) algorithm based on unscented particle filter (UPF) is proposed. This algorithm uses the unscented Kalman filter (UKF) estimated results as the proposal distribution of particle filter (PF), and updates the latest measurements information in the process of generating predictive particles, which makes the distribution of particles much closer to the posterior probability distribution of true states. At the same time, a pseudo measurement model based on spiking neural network (SNN) is established, which outputs the pseudo measurement load at each sampling moment to enhance the accuracy of state estimation. The simulation results show that the proposed algorithm can effectively track the true value of distribution network states and is superior to the traditional DSE algorithm in estimation accuracy and noise robustness.

articleTitle: Reliability Evaluation of Distribution Power Unit Based on DG Power Contribution
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: With a large number of distributed generations connected to the distribution network, how to quantify their impacts on power supply reliability has become a new research issue. In this paper, the contribution index of distributed generation is defined based on the load point and distribution unit, the two layers of distribution Network unit, and a new method of power supply reliability evaluation of distribution network unit is put forward. This method can quantify the effect of the distributed generation on the improvement of power supply reliability of the active distribution network. Finally, an example is given to verify the effectiveness and feasibility of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Mathematical Modeling of Impedance During Power Swing as a Function of Time
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Faults and power swings are chiefly responsible for most of the grid disturbances. Power swing often causes misfiring of relays leading to blackout. This paper approached power swing by deriving a mathematical expression which would be able to track the locus of impedance in time domain. This can be used for tuning relays. The derived expression was compared with a power swing generated using matlab/simulink model and the results were analyzed in R-X plane and R-X-t space. Results indicated that the derived expressions were in agreement with simulated power swing. Usage of dynamic impedance plots (R-X-t space) gave a better insight on the instantaneous movement of both resistance and reactance.

articleTitle: Research on the load model and characteristics of inverter-fed motors for transient stability analysis
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Nowadays, the applications of inverter-fed motor (IFM) are largely increasing. Due to load characteristics of the IFM different from that of the asynchronous motor (AM), if the traditional load model based on AM is routinely used, it will challenge the credibility of the analysis of system transient stability. Therefore, this paper adopted both experimental and digital methods to study steady-state and dynamic power characteristics of IFM, and construct the dynamic model of IFM. First, the widely-used IFM based on rotor-vector control is established on MATLAB platform. An actual IFM is tested in a self-designed physical system accordingly. Finally, the steady-state model and the multi-stage mathematical model in dynamic process are built for IFM. The simulation results show that the IFM will not produce power rush after system shocks, which is more beneficial to system voltage recovery. The proposed dynamic load model of IFM could help the transient stability analysis task.

articleTitle: A Dual Inverter Based Grid Connected Solar Power Conditioning System With Coordinated Closed Loop Control
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: In grid connected parallel solar inverter configuration, the power sharing between the inverter modules are achieved by sharing the current at identical AC output operating voltage across each inverter module. In conventional parallel configuration, high DC potentials are required to synthesize the identical AC output voltage across the inverter modules. Due to high DC voltages, the DC capacitor and switching devices would experience high dv/dt during inverter operation that would affect the performance of the solar power conditioning system (PCS). In this work, a method of reducing DC potentials across the individual inverter module is evaluated using dual two level inverter configuration. In the dual two level inverter configuration, the DC bus voltage would be shared between the inverter modules to synthesize the full AC voltage across the grid terminals. For appropriate sharing of the DC potential between the inverter modules based on the maximum available power point of the solar farm, a coordinated closed loop control is implemented based on the small signal analysis aiming to track not only the maximum power point but also grid voltage. The proposed configuration along with the closed loop control is evaluated analytically and results are validated by simulating circuit in MATLAB simulink.

articleTitle: A Non-Iterative Switching Status Combination Judgement Algorithm for Half-Bridge Sub-Circuit Based Voltage-Source Converters in EMTP-type Simulation Program
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: The large number of switching devices in high-frequency power conversion systems have lead to a computational challenge for electromagnetic transients (EMT) simulation programs, as it can significantly increase the simulation time. Based on the half-bridge sub-circuit, this paper analyses the possible parasitic switching events of adjacent switches on the same bridge arm, and a fast switching status combination judgement algorithm is proposed. This algorithm does not have the process of iterative detection when searching for stable switch combination, thus it can effectively reduce the simulation time. Different testing cases are simulated in both the proposed-algorithm-embedded cloud power system simulation platform (CloudPSS) and the PSCAD, which shows a desirable accuracy of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Research of MMC-UPFC Control Strategy
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: The unified power flow controller (UPFC) as the intelligent power grid energy controller is a more comprehensive flexible ac device that can improve power grid operation, transmission levels and power quality. The differences in UPFC topology and its control strategies have an important impact on its output characteristics. Firstly, the UPFC topology and its control strategy are summarized in the paper, and then the power flow regulation mechanism is also analyzed. The mathematical models of series and parallel side converters are established in the three phase stationary coordinate, the UPFC model and its control characteristics are analyzed in the two- phase rotating(d q) and stationary (α β) coordinate system, and design the control strategies under the a P coordinate system to realize decoupling control. Finally, the UPFC simulation model based on MMC is built in the PSCAD/EMTDC simulation environment to simulate and analyze the adjustment characteristics of active and reactive power flow.

articleTitle: Comparative analysis of external characteristics of nuclear power units and thermal power units
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: In recent years, nuclear power units in China begin to participate in peak regulation and have a certain capacity of load tracking. These nuclear power units show different characteristics from those running with fixed load and share some similarities with thermal power units. The matured experience of thermal power units can be used on the operation of nuclear power units, so the quantitative comparison between both units is of great significance. For this purpose, modellings of both nuclear power units and thermal power units are established based on Power System Analysis Software Package (PSASP). After being connected to the same power grid, the response characteristics of the two units are tested respectively. The simulation results show that the load tracking speed of nuclear power units is lower than that of thermal power units, and their responses to external failure are almost the same. Furthermore, it is verified by comparison that the steam pressure is the main cause of the difference between nuclear and thermal power. Finally, it is proved that when analyzing the electromechanical transient process of large-scale power grid, a thermal power unit with the same output can replace the nuclear power unit for analysis due to their similar external characteristics.

articleTitle: Optimal Scheme of Energy Storage System with Wind Power Integration Considering Negative Peak Load Regulation Capacity
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Interference caused by wind power integration has aggravated peak load regulation difficulty of power systems, especially, for the negative peak load regulation capacity. The energy storage system (ESS) is regarded as a desirable alternative for peak load regulation due to its good properties in flexibility. In order to fully exploit the advantages of ESS in peak load regulation, an optimization model aiming at maximizing the negative peak load regulation capacity is proposed in this paper. The impact of wind power uncertainty and the assistance of participated ESS on the peak shaving are considered. Then, the optimal scheme of ESS is obtained which can reduce the negative peak load regulation pressure obviously. Finally, the performance and effectiveness of the proposed method are demonstrated with actual power system in North China.

articleTitle: Power Flow Optimization of Intelligent Distribution Network with Distributed Energy Resources
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: With the increasing penetration of distributed energy resources in distribution network, it is necessary to strengthen the research on optimal power flow control of intelligent distribution network. Aiming at the characteristics of distributed energy resources decentralized access in intelligent distribution network, a zonal collaborative control structure of intelligent distribution network based on multi-agent system (MAS) theory is designed. An optimal power flow model of the intelligent distribution network is established, which aims at minimizing the cost of power consumers, voltage deviation and power losses. The intelligent single particle algorithm is used to optimize power flow in the intelligent distribution network. The distribution system of the intelligent distribution network laboratory is analyzed to verify the effectiveness of the model and the algorithm.

articleTitle: Available Inertia Estimation of Induction Machine and Its Effect on Frequency Response of Power Systems with Wind Penetration
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: The increasing penetration of wind power generation displaces a major portion of conventional generating plant reducing system inertia and deteriorating system frequency dynamic characteristics. In this sense, the induction machines (IMs) including induction motor loads and induction generators, which occupy a fair proportion in power consumption and generation, should be viewed with some concern in frequency response. Therefore, this paper firstly estimates IMs available inertia. It is shown that the IMs available inertia is affected by both rotor inertia and slip frequency regulation and presents a time-varied property. Besides, the frequency response model of a power system constituted of a SG, an aggregate Type 3 WTs and an IM load is established. The effect of IMs available inertia on frequency dynamics is analyzed based on this system. Time-domain simulation results of the system verify the analyses.

articleTitle: Internal state estimation for distribution network with PMU measurement information
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Due to more and more intelligent devices such as phasor measurement unit (PMU) access to the distribution network, state estimation for distribution network need to consider more and more uncertainty and the great difference in accuracy of different measurement information may lead to non-convergence of weighted least square (WLS) methods. Aiming at the situation of only knowing the upper and lower limits of uncertainties, an interval state estimation for distribution system is proposed, which describes these uncertainties of system measurements are quantitatively d by the interval numbers and affine arithmetic. In order to accurately obtain the results of DSSE, an algorithm based on the combination of interval arithmetic and affine arithmetic is proposed. In this method, the interval numbers and affine arithmetic are transformed into each other in the iterative process to reducing the conservatism of interval state estimation. The estimation results in interval form are used to provide upper and lower bound information of DSSE results for dispatchers more intuitively.

articleTitle: Effect of Temporary DC Fault of FB-MMC-HVDC on Offshore Wind Farm Based on DFIGs
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Temporary islanding of offshore wind farm will happen owing to the HVDC (High Voltage Direct Current system) blocking while transient DC-fault occurs in the connected FB-MMC (Full Bridge Modular Multilevel Converter) HVDC system. As the mainstream of offshore wind farm, DFIG (Doubly Fed Induction Generator) has defects under islanding conditions in control strategy, which causes the phenomena of overvoltage and instantaneous impulse current in PCC (Point of Common Coupling) node, threating to security of both HVDC and wind-farm. This paper analyzes response of DFIG under temporary islanding in detail and proposes a solution of transient DC FRT (Fault Ride Through) for DFIG, which is verified by simulation on PSCAD/EMTDC.

articleTitle: Research on Power Capacitor Insulation State Detection Based on Polarization Depolarization Current Method
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Few effective insulation state detection methods for power capacitor can be used in field. In this paper, a power capacitor insulation state detection method based on polarization-depolarization current is proposed. Firstly, the basic principles of the method are discussed. Then, two characterized parameters are conducted based on polarization and depolarization currents, which are DC conductivity and 0.1Hz dielectric loss. A test device based on this method is developed to evaluate the insulation state of power capacitor with different aging conditions. The test results showed that the polarization and depolarization currents increased along with the aging conditions. The DC conductance and 0.1Hz dielectric loss also increased along with the aging conditions. The test indicated the polarization-depolarization current method is suitable for power capacitor insulation state detection.

articleTitle: STATCOM Based Network Voltage Unbalance Mitigation for Sub-Transmission Networks
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Network voltage unbalance (VU) is a potentially damaging power quality phenomenon for both utility and end consumer equipment. With the increased penetration of disturbing loads such as electrified railways, single phase distributed generators and line-to-line connected industrial loads, VU levels can be exacerbated. Consequently, network operators are increasingly diligent in maintaining the network-wide VU within stipulated limits. VU management in general, is a synergy of a number of tasks covering proper planning, operation and application of active VU mitigation techniques. Application of power quality conditioning equipment such as static compensators (STATCOMs) at appropriate locations is one such unbalance mitigation technique, which can be seen in practical networks. This paper gives a comprehensive analysis of STATCOM based VU mitigation taking into account the influence made by location and the impedance of STATCOM and comparatively evaluates the management and mitigation techniques of VU with respect to a practical 66 kV sub-transmission network.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic Transient Simulation Analysis for the 500 kV Saturated Iron-Core Superconducting Fault Current Limiter
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: This paper focuses on the electromagnetic transient process of the 500 kV saturated iron-core superconducting fault current limiter (SFCL) in power grid operation. Based on the single-phase three-column iron-core structure of the SFCL, the electromagnetic transient simulation model is established using the magnetic circuit decomposition method on PSCAD/EMTDC. Combined with the parameters of the 500 kV Guangdong power grid and the design scheme of the 500 kV SFCL prototype, transient impedance characteristics of the SFCL under the normal and different current-limiting conditions are analyzed through an example, and transient processes for the DC excitation system of the SFCL during the excitation and demagnetization process are analyzed.

articleTitle: Analysis of 10kV Non-technical Loss Detection with Data-driven Approaches
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Users' abnormal power consumption behaviors are the main cause of non-technical loss. The non-technical loss can be divided into three types, electricity stealing bypassing meters, electricity stealing by meters and non-stealing management fault. This paper employs and analyzes different types of clustering algorithms for detecting the 10kV non-technical loss. The centroid-based, density-based, spectral-based and distribution-based clustering algorithms are utilized to detect the Type I and II non-technical line loss data. Three features are extracted from the initial data, including the average line loss, coefficient of variation of line loss and opening records of ammeters. The comparison experiments validate the distribution-based clustering algorithm are more suitable to detect the 10kV non-technical loss and their types.

articleTitle: Air Conditioning Cooling Power Prediction of Provincial Residents Based on Regional Comprehensive Temperature
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: With the improvement of residents' living standards, the demand for air-conditioning cooling power in summer is increasing. This paper first analyzes the correlation between the cooling power of residents and the daily maximum temperature, daily minimum temperature and daily average temperature, then decomposes the province according to the region, and builds the comprehensive temperature of the province according to the principle of certain weight selection. The prediction model of the provincial air-conditioning cooling power is constructed, and the model is predicted and verified by taking the province A as an example.

articleTitle: Short-term Photovoltaic Output Prediction Method Based on Similar Day Selection with Grey Relational Theory
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: With the rapid growth of Photovoltaic (PV) power capacity, how to improve the accuracy of PV output prediction becomes an intensive problem. This paper proposes a prediction model to reduce the error of prediction by combining gray correlation theory to select similar days with BP neural network. Firstly, the factors of weather between sample days selected as similar days and forecast days are calculated to find three similar days which have the highest relevance. After that, different weights are assigned to historical data of similar days according to the degree of relevance from large to small and back propagation (BP) neural network is combined to predict the output of PV. Finally, based on the actual measurement data of a photovoltaic power station in Northeast China, this paper validates the positive effects of this model on MATLAB simulation platform. Results show that selecting similar days by grey correlation and combining BP neural network can effectively improve the prediction accuracy of short-term PV output.

articleTitle: The Application of M3C Based on Optimized Sorting in Fractional Frequency Transmission System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: This paper focuses on the application of modular multilevel matrix converter (M<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>C) in fractional frequency transmission system (FFTS). In this paper, the structure and working principle of M<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>C are introduced, and the voltage-current cascade control and the nearest level modulation (NLM) strategy are used to control M<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>C. Aiming at the capacitor voltage sorting algorithm of M<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>C, this paper proposes an optimized sorting method, which reduces the computational complexity and improves the computational efficiency without affecting the switching frequency of the sub-module (SM). Finally, the simulation model of FFTS based on M<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>C is built in MATLAB/SIMULINK, and the effectiveness of the proposed optimization sorting method is verified.

articleTitle: New Performance Indicators for Evaluating the Power System Static Security with STATCOM/BESS
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Due to the shortage of the performance indicators for evaluating the impact of STATCOM/BESS on the static security of the power system, an indicator system is established to evaluate the static security of system by considering the operational principle of the STATCOM/BESS. The reliability model is also established based on STATCOM/BESS, which can be controlled in both active power injection mode and reactive power injection mode. Then, a probabilistic evaluation algorithm is proposed, which aims at minimizing the over-limit of voltage and power flow. The simulation verification is implemented using IEEE-RTS79 system, and the simulation results show that the performance indicators and algorithm are effective.

articleTitle: Application of Current-transferring Submodule in Modular Multilevel Converter
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: In order to solve the problem that the traditional half-bridge module cannot clear the DC fault, a current-transferring submodule based on the parallel thyristor and the reverse-blocking IGBT is proposed. The topology and operating principle of the current-transferring submodule are introduced in detail, and its steady state control strategy is the same as the half-bridge submodule. Then, according to its current limiting principle, the DC fault control protection strategy of MMC based on the current-transferring submodule is proposed. At last, the simulation model is built in PSCAD/EMTDC, and the effectiveness of the proposed submodule topology and the control and protection strategy in DC fault clearing has been verified by the simulation results.

articleTitle: Fault Location of Distribution Network Based on Multi-method Fusion
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: For the fault location problem of a radial distribution network, the existing method is single, and the accuracy in practical applications is low, which is difficult to meet on-site needs. A fault location method of a distribution network based on multi-method fusion is proposed. After the fault occurs, the initial fault location is first obtained by the matrix method, probability estimation method and artificial intelligence method. Then the initial fault location result is processed and integrated through improved evidence theory. Finally, the final fault location result is obtained according to the decision criteria. This method is less affected by information missing and information false positive, and is adaptable to the situation of multiple faults, and gives alternatives. Finally, the feasibility of the method is proved by simulation analysis.

articleTitle: A Two-Stage Improved Droop Control Method for Economic Operation of Islanded DC Microgrids
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: The traditional droop control method applied to DC microgrids causes undesirable steady voltage deviations and it does not consider the economic operation. To overcome these drawbacks, this paper proposes a two-stage improved droop control method for the economic operation of islanded DC microgrids in the light of equal incremental cost principle. A time-delay feedforward path of cost incremental value is deployed in the droop control strategy, which can eliminate the steady voltage deviation while ensuring efficient power sharing. In addition, a plug-and-play strategy based on the proposed control is presented to enhance the system reliability. Simulation results verify the effectiveness of the proposed control method.

articleTitle: Visual Power Line Inspection Via Multi-direction Transform
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Aiming at the quality degradation problem of image captured on foggy day in visual power line inspection, which will affect the accurate analysis of power line operating state, an image defogging algorithm based on dark channel prior hypothesis and multi-directional transform is proposed. The traditional dark channel prior algorithm can achieve good results, but it will cause a certain degree of image color distortion of the highlight component. In order to improve the performance of dark channel defogging, this paper utilizes multi-directional transform to extract low-frequency images for transmission estimation, which can effectively alleviate the color distortion caused by traditional dark channel processing. The experimental results show that the overall performance of the proposed algorithm is better than other algorithms in objective evaluation indicators, which can provide support for further obtaining accurate information of power line operation.

articleTitle: Power Transmission Network Expansion Planning Research Considering System Weak Connection Recognition
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Splitting is the last line of defense to protect the power system. In the initial stage of transmission grid planning, reducing weakly connected lines can reduce the search candidate of active splitting and increase the effectiveness of active splitting. Firstly, a bi-level transmission network programming model is proposed in this paper. In this bi-level model, the upper-level model takes the minimum number of weakly connected lines in the system as the optimization objective. And in the lower layer model, the objective is to minimize the sum of the construction cost of the new lines and the system operation cost. Then the improved double-layer particle swarm optimization algorithm is used to solve the bi-level model. Finally, the results of the IEEE Graver 6-bus test system show that the model and algorithm are effective.

articleTitle: Reliability Improvement in Radial Distribution System through Reconfiguration
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: The distribution system is characterized by radial topology in which failure of a component would lead to service interruptions and may lead to disconnection of a handful of load points. In this paper a feeder reconfiguration method is presented for minimization of reliability indices. The Binary Particle Swarm Optimization is used to handle the reconfiguration which identifies the optimal tie switches for minimizing the duration and frequency of interruptions. The influence of various parameters in Binary Particle Swarm Optimization on the rate of convergence of the optimal solution is derived. The proposed algorithm is tested in 33 and 69 bus system and the results show the optimum value of the reliability indices.

articleTitle: Noise suppression in compressive imaging for power internet of things
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: As a critical acquisition end-device in power internet of things (IoT), camera plays an important role in electric power video surveillance for security protection. There is a conflict between the collected information by camera and the transmission bandwidth in IoT system. This paper proposes a uniform compressive imaging scheme of camera to remit this conflict by improving the imaging quality with lower transmission bandwidth. According to the structure of compressing imaging, a non-uniform measuring strategy, which reduces the ratio of -1 element in the uniform measurement matrix, is proposed to suppress Gaussian noise. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed scheme achieves a better imaging quality by suppressing noise. Lower data storage is transmitted by the network of IoT, which reduces the requirement of network bandwidth.

articleTitle: A Planning Method of Distributed Generations for Promoting Renewable Energy Utilization in the Coupled Network
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Due to the high penetration of renewable energy (RE) connected to power system, it has brought challenges to the consumption and efficient utilization of RE. This paper presents a planning method of RE distributed generations (DGs) in the coupled network to improve RE utilization. Firstly, it analyzes local consumption and power export of DGs in the distribution system, and introduces the DG planning method in the coupled network considering the transmission line construction for power export. Then, the multi-objective optimal configuration model for minimizing the annual total cost is proposed. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed method can realize the efficient consumption of RE and help enormously promote capacity of power grid to accept DGs, while the economic benefits of the system is enhanced.

articleTitle: A New Scheme of Substation Backup Protection Based on Topology Matrixes and Differential Zones
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: It is easy to access electrical information of the all substation in intelligent substation, a backup protection scheme based on topology matrixes and differential zones is proposed. Firstly, topology matrix based on circuit breaker association and the differential zone is defined. Secondly, the action scheme of the differential zone is designed, and tripping matrix is formed. When a fault occurs in the substation, selective fault isolation can be managed through coordination and cooperation of each differential zone. The result of fault case analysis of actual substation shows that this scheme solves the problem of long time-limit of traditional staged backup protection and effectively improves backup protection performance, which is simple, flexible and reliable.

articleTitle: Research on load rejection protection of PWR power plants at different power levels
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Load rejection characteristic is an important standard to measure the security and stability of a nuclear power plant. And the load rejection test is an important item before putting the PWR nuclear power plant into operation. Practically, the nuclear power plants operate at different power levels and show different load rejection characteristics. A model of PWR nuclear power plant is established based on the actual operation characteristics and the load rejection test of nuclear power plants at different power levels is simulated. Furthermore, a bypass system and a fast valve closing system are added to study the load rejection protection of PWR nuclear power plant. The simulation indicate that the higher the power level, the greater the disturbance caused by load rejection. And the nuclear power plant operating with full load is necessary to be equipped with the protection system for load rejection. In addition, the results show that the bypass system exerts a protective effect on the primary circuit of the nuclear power plant more significantly, while the fast valve closing system is more remarkable in the protection of the secondary circuit of the nuclear power plant.

articleTitle: Renewable Energy-based Micro-Grid; a Zero-Emission Option for Electricity Production in Australia
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Australia is a big country with electric power transmission and distribution lines spanning very long distances. Most of these lines are outdoor facilities, which has the impact of grid vulnerability on to Australian communities, so it is essential to manage generation, transmission, and distribution of electricity in Australia in a sustainable way. The Australia's National Electricity Market (NEM) alone incorporates more than 40,000 km of transmission and distribution lines. Currently, more than 70% of electric power in Australia is generated in central power plants using black or brown coal. Sun and wind resources are abundantly available in all Australian states that can be used as local resources for electricity production. The objectives of this paper is to present the results of a study conducted to see how micro-grids can help electricity generation using renewable sources such as solar photovoltaic and wind power combined with storage technology in a sustainable way. The study results presented here are for Queensland, chosen as an example, but the study can be applied for all other Australian states.

articleTitle: Data center visualization based on uDC-Builder
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Taking visualization for a research object, first this paper analyses the development of data center and the advantages of applying visualization technique to data center. Then a construction plan of data center visualization platform is proposed, and the novelties is expounded. This paper is for the purpose of promoting the development and application of data center visualization.

articleTitle: The Study on the Load Characteristics of the Induction Motor with Converter and their Influence on Under Voltage Load Shedding
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Induction motor is the main dynamic equipment in power system, its load characteristics have an important impact on voltage stability and under voltage load shedding results. At present, with the wide application of power electronic equipment, the load characteristics of induction motor with converter have changed greatly compared with traditional motor. In this paper, the traditional motor and the induction motor with PWM converter load models are built, and the load voltage characteristics are presented. For low voltage protection of converter, the low voltage power release characteristics of induction motor with converter are analyzed. The influences of induction motor and induction motor with converter on voltage stability and under voltage load shedding are studied.

articleTitle: Circulating Current Control for Hybrid MMCs under DC Voltage Sag
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: In this paper, a circulating current control scheme for hybrid modular multilevel converters (HMMCs) consisting of full-bridge sub-modules (FBSMs) and half-bridge sub-modules (HBSMs) under DC voltage sag is proposed, which helps the HMMC ride-through the DC voltage sag with rated power. Firstly, operation principles of HMMCs are investigated. After that, the energy imbalance mechanism under DC voltage sag is studied. Based on the theoretical analysis, a negative-sequence second-order circulating current injection method is proposed to maintain the capacitor voltage balance under DC voltage sag. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed method is validated by PSCAD/EMTDC based simulation results.

articleTitle: Notice of Violation of IEEE Publication Principles: Impact of large scale wind power with DFIG on small signal stability of the system
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract:

Future energy demand and increasing carbon emission requires an alternative source of energy. In recent few years, Use of DFIG based wind farm increased tremendously, thus effect of wind penetration on small signal stability of existing multi machine system need to be analyzed. In This paper effect of penetration of wind turbine with DFIG on stability performance of the IEEE 9 bus and 39 bus system has been investigated using DIgSILENT Powerfactory. It was observed that system with large number of buses is more stable with DFIG penetration then a small system.

articleTitle: Modeling of LCC-HVDC Stations Based on Concept of Motion Equation
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Line Commutated Converter based High Voltage Direct Current (LCC-HVDC) Transmissions are widely applied in transmitting large-capacity electricity in China. The stability of power system may be threatened due to dynamic interactions between multiple large-capacity converter stations in AC and DC power grids. Several studies have reported some stability problems caused by the dynamic interactions in AC and DC power grids, but mechanism of the dynamic interactions has not been totally understood. To analyze the dynamic interactions between multiple converter stations in AC and DC power grids, this paper presents a small-signal model to understand the external characteristic of LCC-HVDC stations based on motion equation concept. Comparison of time-domain simulation response with detailed switching model shows that the proposed model can hold the main behaviors of concern. Dynamic interactions between multiple converter stations in AC and DC power grids will be studied based on the proposed model in the future.

articleTitle: LBBF Algorithm for TDMA Time Slot Scheduling in VPLC System Based on HomePlug AV
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Power Line Communication (PLC) is an effective technology to counteract problem of wiring harness increasing in intelligent vehicle. Besides the physical layer, the Medium Access Control (MAC) layer must meet the low latency requirements for automotive control information. Therefore, a hybrid MAC protocol is introduced based on the HomePlug AV protocol, which uses different media access control methods for periodic and aperiodic signals. In particular, for periodic signals, an LBBF heuristic algorithm is proposed in this paper for scheduling problems of TDMA time slots to improve the utilization of time slots and reduce TDMA time slot waste. Finally, compared with the traditional static scheduling scheme in FlexRay, the Left-Bottom Best Fit (LBBF) algorithm can improve the utilization of time slots and greatly reduce the number of time slots occupied, thus improving the performance of automobile communication.

articleTitle: Online Identification Strategy of Synchronous generator Based on Laplacian Eigenmap Algorithm for Wind Power System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: This paper proposes a coherency identification strategy for power system under high wind power penetration. It consists of two parts: the offline classification stage and the online identification stage. In the off-line classification stage, the joint analysis of the wind farm and the synchronous unit with the closest electrical distance is performed. The equivalent power angle is obtained to calculate the Laplacian matrix of the improved generator coupling degree. And the eigenvector is solved to obtain classification results. In the online identification stage, the obtained classification results are used as constraints to modify the improved power angle Laplacian matrix under high wind power permeability, and the feature information is extracted to obtain the coherency identification results online. The simulation results show that the improved online coherency identification strategy can accurately complete online identification under different wind power penetration rates.

articleTitle: Impact of Frequency-Responsive Wind Turbines on Power System Stability
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: This paper explores the aspects that affect the inter-area mode damping of a power system, with the focus put on the integrated wind generation that installs frequency-responsive control. Some important findings are concluded from a home of simulations using a modified two-area test system. Following by setting different possible wind penetration levels and the WT placements, qualitative behaviors of the impact would be examined in a systematic way.

articleTitle: Research on Multiple Constraints of Flexible Virtual Capacitor Control for VSC
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Compared to traditional AC grids, there is no synchronization problem of frequency and phase in DC micro-grid, but it has little inertia. Therefore, when the system is disturbed, the stability of DC micro-grid cannot be guaranteed. The virtual capacitance control strategy provides a good choice for solving this problem. When the system is disturbed, the virtual capacitance inhibits the mutation of DC voltage and improves the system's transient response. And the virtual capacitance value is flexible and adjustable, which makes the virtual capacitance control have higher engineering application value. However, the flexibility needs to meet certain restrictions to ensure the safe and stable operation of the system and give full play to the flexible and controllable advantages of virtual capacitor control. Therefore, it is of great significance to study the relevant constraints of flexible virtual capacitor (FVC) control. In this paper, the main parameters affecting the virtual capacitance are analyzed, the constraints of stability and dynamic response characteristics are proposed, and the stable operation boundary of the system is calculated. The correctness of the boundary is verified by the built six-terminal DC microgrid simulation model based on MATLAB/Simulink.

articleTitle: Monthly Generation Unit Maintenance Optimization Method Considering Power Supply Capacity and Peak Regulation Capacity
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: The traditional generation unit maintenance optimization method focuses on the influence on power supply capacity. However, with the rapid development of new energy such as wind power, peak regulation capacity should be also considered. For this reason, three useful evaluation indexes are proposed including power supply abundance(PSA), electricity supply abundance(ESA) and peak regulation abundance(PRA) based on the maximum, minimum and average new energy operation schemes. Then, a monthly generation unit maintenance optimization method is put forward by taking the generation unit maintenance requirements, PSA, ESA and PRA into consideration. Finally, a case study based on IEEE-30 buses system is used to prove the validity of the method proposed.

articleTitle: Optimized operating strategy for a distribution network containing BESS and renewable energy
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: In this paper, battery energy storage system (BESS) is installed in the distribution network (DN) to realize peak shaving and valley filling. Furthermore, the reactive power capabilities of the wind turbine (WT) and BESS are utilized to reduce the power losses and improve voltage quality. The overall operating strategy is formulated as a nonlinear programming mathematical model, which consists of BESS charging/discharging power scheduling, BESS and WT reactive power dispatching as well. The formulated mathematical model is further solved by a nonlinearly decreased inertia weight particle swarm optimization (PSO) method. Finally, a modified 69-bus distribution network is selected to verify the performance of the proposed optimal operation strategy. Experimental results show that the optimal operating strategy of BESS and WT can greatly decrease the power losses of the DN and increase the profit of the DN utilities.

articleTitle: Residual Capacity Estimation of Valve-regulated Lead-acid (VRLA) Batteries for Second-use
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Valve-regulated lead-acid (VRLA) batteries widely used in substations still have large residual capacities when they are retired, so they can be used secondly in energy storage systems. To enhance the economic and technical performance of second-used VRLA batteries, the estimations of battery’s residual capacity before and during second-use are essential, which are the two main topics of this paper. First, based on the electrochemical impedance spectroscopy (EIS) of retired VRLA batteries, an equivalent circuit model is established as the basis for subsequent research. Then, the relationship between the EIS and the residual capacity of the retired VRLA battery that has not been put into second-use is studied by theoretical analysis and experiment research. It is found that the impedance at 0.01Hz (capacitance) and 50Hz (resistance) can be used to select batteries that need restoration and the irreparable batteries respectively. Moreover, the test results of charge-discharge cycles show that the residual capacity of the retired VRLA battery that has been put into second-use can be estimated using battery’s open-circuit voltage and DC impedance, both of which are easy to measure for batteries in operation. The residual capacity estimation methods lay a theoretical foundation for the second-use of retired VRLA batteries, thus promoting resource recycling and producing social and economic values simultaneously.

articleTitle: Application of Time Domain Dielectric Spectral Characteristics in Quantitative Evaluation of Oil-paper Transformer Insulation Status
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Previous studies have confirmed that the insulation status of oil-paper transformer can be qualitatively analyzed by its time domain dielectric spectral characteristics. However, it is more important to evaluate the insulation condition of transformers quantitatively in engineering practice. An evaluation system based on characteristics obtained by the return voltage measurements is constructed in this paper for the quantitative evaluation of the insulation state of oil-paper transformers. First, data of characteristics of transformer are normalized and neighborhood radius of each characteristic are calculated. Then, the decision table of oil-paper insulation diagnosis system is generated based on neighborhood rough set theory. Moreover, attribute reduction is carried out to the decision table and the best rules are extracted. Finally, the oil-paper insulation state evaluation system is constructed based on the historical database. Five transformers of known insulation status have verified the accuracy of the evaluation system.

articleTitle: Research on a Typical Connection Mode of Flexible DC Distribution Applied to High Reliability Area
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: In this paper, the basic modules of distribution network are divided based on reliability calculation demand. From the conventional high reliability power supply mode, a new three-way connection mode with flexible DC loop is proposed creatively, which is suitable for high reliability area with distributed generators(PV, wind turbine) and DC load, and the corresponding operation policy is put forward. Briefly, referring to an improved minimal path set reliability calculation method, the operation transfer situation and influence of distributed generators are counted into the calculation. The connection mode and the calculation method are brought into a practical distribution network, and the double fire and double loop network connection mode are compared and analyzed. It is proved in the paper that the proposed connection mode can improve the system reliability, and well adapt to the developing requirement of the distribution network with distributed generators, energy storage and DC load in the future.

articleTitle: A Fast Frequency Control Strategy for Deloaded WTG in the Power System with High Penetration of Renewable Energy
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: With the increasing penetration of wind power, the capability of the power system to maintain frequency stability decreases. Therefore, frequency support for grid from wind turbine generators (WTGs) are required. WTGs usually operate without reserve power and can only provide short-term frequency support by utilizing the rotational kinetic energy. While, the deloaded WTG has a certain power reserve, which can be utilized during frequency control. This paper presents a fast frequency control strategy for the deloaded WTG, which not only imitates the primary frequency regulation characteristic of synchronous generators, but also utilizes the fast power adjustment capability of WTGs to increase the output power a lot at the early stage to reduce the rate of change of frequency. The frequency controller parameters and deload level of WTG are also carefully designed. The simulation results demonstrate that the control method can significantly enhance the system frequency control effect.

articleTitle: Data-Driven System-Side Harmonic Impedance Estimation Method for UHVDC Converter Station
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: With the increasing attention to power quality, the AC system-side harmonic impedance of the UHVDC converter station is of great significance for harmonic analysis, harmonic control and engineering construction. In this paper, a data-driven method based on the extracted typical data is proposed to estimate the system-side harmonic impedance. According to the equivalent harmonic analysis circuit of the UHVDC converter station, the 500kV AC bus of the UHVDC converter station is used as the Point of Common Coupling (PCC), and a measurement matrix is formed by taking the harmonic voltage and current of AC bus as observation data. Then, the Density-Based Spatial Clustering of Applications with Noise (DBSCAN) algorithm is applied to extract the typical data of different operating conditions of the converter station from the large measurement matrix. Finally, the validity and practicability of the method are verified by the PSCAD simulation model.

articleTitle: The coordinated control of thermostatically controlled loads and energy storage considering the lock-out effect
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: In this paper, a coordinated control model based on empirical mode decomposition (EMD) is proposed for making full use of the load-flexibility from thermostatically controlled loads (TCLs). Based on the analysis of the impact of compressor-lock-out effect on the load-flexibility of TCLs, the coordinated control model is established to instruct TCLs and the energy storage (ES) to response to the low frequency and high frequency part of the control requirements respectively. The contrastive results illustrate that the proposed method can make full use of the flexibility potential of TCLs and enhance the performance of the ancillary service.

articleTitle: Simulation of Electrical Stresses on DC Cable system in a ± 800 kV LCC-UHVDC Transmission System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: UHVDC cable system is suitable for special environments from a large-scale offshore wind farm to a metropolis. In order to evaluate the electrical stresses of UHVDC cable, the key parameters of typical UHVDC project are investigated. Based on super clean base resin, preliminary dimension parameters of the UHVDC cable with ratings 800 kV and 3750 A have been briefly discussed. Then, the simulation model of the UHVDC system with UHVDC cables and overhand lines has been built. For the serious overvoltage case, the voltage current characteristic of the surge arrester installed is discussed. Finally, the voltage and current stresses of the UHVDC cable are discussed. The results will be further explored in the development of our ±800 kV UHVDC cable systems.

articleTitle: Root Cause Analysis of Abnormal Conduction of Electric Trigger Converter Valve in HVDC Projects
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Four abnormal conduction events occurred in the converter valve of Tian-Guang HVDC project, which affects the safe operation of HVDC project seriously. In order to find out the root cause of abnormal events and prevent them from happening again, a fault diagnosis strategy has been proposed in this paper. The working principle of TE board is studied, and the root cause is inferred to be the insulation reduction of TE board after analysis. Then a simulation model of TE board is built using NI Multisim, and a hardware platform of TE board is built to verify the assumption and comfirm the root cause of abnormal conduction. Results show that the surface of TE board are seriously fouled after a long period of operation, and the equivalent insulation resistance of the capacitor C57 of backup trigger circuit is reduced, resulting in the abnormal conduction of the electric trigger converter valve. Finally, the renovation measures such as routine cleansing of TE board and the valve hall humidity control are proposed and applied in the HVDC project.

articleTitle: Developing a Decision Support System for the Optimal Operating Strategies of a Polygeneration Facility
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Polygeneration, i.e., the generation of two or more energy products at the same time, emerges as a promising solution for optimal energy resource utilization. Due to the highly complex interactions among system components, optimization is needed to achieve environmental and economic benefits. Important work has been done in polygeneration system design, but few studies deal with the response to varying conditions and contingencies to maintain and improve savings and to achieve reliable operation. Here we implement a polygeneration facility model consisting of a combination of renewable and conventional energy generation, conversion, and storage devices. Genetic algorithm is used to find the optimal system designs under different operation strategies that minimize CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> emissions, fuel usage, and overall cost. After initial optimization, a decision support system is developed to aid in the day-ahead operation strategy selection to improve system performance under the changing operational conditions. Results show that the 3 operating strategies analyzed can achieve annual savings of 20-27% compared to the reference system. It is also shown that switching strategy can result in additional savings and avoid system collapse in some scenarios. This work will contribute to the future design and operation of polygeneration facilities.

articleTitle: Distribution Network Economic Dispatch Based on Network Reconfiguration and Electric-heat Combined Demand Response
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: With the continuous growth of multi-type loads such as electric heating in the power grid, traditional single-scheduled means such as electric load demand response or network reconstruction can not meet the demand of safe economic operation of the distribution network. The validity and practicability of the proposed model and method are verified by an example.

articleTitle: Electrical Equipment Inspection Process Intelligently Tailoring Based on Graph Planning
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: At present, cost of electrical equipment inspection process is redundant and arduous. This is the bottleneck of the improvement for power grid operation. In order to solve this problem, it is necessary to optimize the electrical equipment inspection process to improve production efficiency. This paper introduces Automatic Planning algorithm to realize the model of Intelligently Tailoring operation for inspection process . Intelligently Tailoring model is described as PDDL (Planning Domain Definition Language). It provides intelligent aided decision for daily work.

articleTitle: Framework for Computationally Efficient Outage Detection
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Outage Detection method for radial distribution networks uses demand forecasting based on historical load data of the system and real time line flow measurements. The line flow measurements are obtained from sensors placed on certain nodes of the system to predict the location of the outage. Hypotheses are created for outage at each node as covariance matrix between forecasted demand and the real time line flow data. A Backward Forward Sweep (BFS) load flow is performed to obtain line flow sensor measurements in the nodes at which the sensors are installed. The system is decoupled into areas based on sensor placement to reduce the computation. Outage is located by identifying the area in which outage has occurred and then evaluating all the outage hypotheses under the area. This method is computationally efficient as minimal number of outage hypotheses are evaluated.

articleTitle: Engineering Application and Operation Analysis of Virtual Synchronous Generators
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: As a grand new control strategy for renewable energy power generation, Virtual Synchronous Generator (VSG) has attracted much attention because of its advantages in providing dynamic supports for grid frequency and voltage. However, most study concentrates on the theoretical research of its algorithm and strategy, rarely paying attention to the method of large capacity integration. Few application cases can be seen in field of microgrid, but the implementation of engineering application in power system will meet a series of challenges like developing large-capacity equipment and evaluating the operation performances. This paper gives brief introduction to and comparison of two technical routes of VSG, and explains in detail the implementation method of VSG of different types. As the first renewable energy generation station with VSG function worldwide, VSG Demonstration Project is introduced and its operation performances are analyzed from various aspects.

articleTitle: On Application Specific Requirements of PMUs for Electricity Distribution Grids
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Phasor measurement units (PMUs) have been widely and successfully used in power transmission grids. PMU technologies could be exploited in distribution grids to manage the impact of distributed generation and the electrification of the transportation sector. However, distribution grids are quite different from transmission ones resulting in more stringent accuracy requirements for the distribution PMUs (D-PMUs)). Currently, no standards for D-PMUs are available. However, there are numerous requirements proposed for D-PMUs that need further understanding and assessment. In this paper, a comparison between the IEEE Std C37.118 that is applicable to T-PMUs and requirements for D-PMUs is documented. A classification based on accuracy is proposed. Finally, the factors influencing the accuracy of D-PMUs are discussed in detail.

articleTitle: On Multiobjective Optimization of Switch Allocation in Radial Distribution Networks
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Reliability of power networks can be improved by installing sectionalizing switches which in case of a failure are used to isolate a faulty part of the network. In a single objective optimization the positions of switches are selected to minimize a selected objective function; for example SAIDI, SAIFI or AENS. Minimization of one of the objective functions is usually not equivalent to the minimization of other ones. In this work, a multiobjective optimization problem of the optimal switch allocation in radial distribution networks is considered. Three methods to solve this problem are studied: the exhaustive search method, the evolutionary computations based approach and the tree structure based algorithm. Distribution networks of various sizes with a radial topology and a single feeder are used to compare the methods in terms of the computation time and the accuracy of the results. It is shown that the tree structure based algorithm outperforms other approaches.

articleTitle: A Simulation Approach to Multi-station Solar Irradiance Data Considering Temporal Correlations
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Solar energy is one of important renewable energy sources and simulation of solar irradiance can be used as input for simulation of photovoltaic (PV) generation. This paper proposes a simulation algorithm of multi-station solar irradiance data considering temporal correlations. First of all, we group all the days of the observed data to k clusters for each station based on their daily features of solar irradiance and the daily states constitute Markov chain of days. Then, we reduce state permutations of different stations before getting Markov Transition Probability Matrix (MTPM). In terms of the observed data and MTPM, the simulation approach is proposed. Finally, we test our approach by applying to solar irradiance data of three stations and show that the properties of simulated data match those of the observed data.

articleTitle: Modeling and Analysis of Super-synchronous Oscillation in Converters-dominated Power System Based on Multivariable Frequency Domain Method
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: The large scale integrated power electronics are challenging the power system dynamic analysis. This paper investigates the system super-synchronous oscillation caused by grid-connected voltage source converter (VSC) of wind turbine generation in current control timescale. A micro-grid system model is proposed as an example of converters-dominated power system from the perspective of multivariable feedback control theory in frequency domain. The analysis result shows that super-synchronous oscillation will occur if the system operates with light load. Furthermore, by introducing the new index into multivariable frequency analysis, it is found that the system stability is mainly deteriorated by the wind farm which equipped with cable collector system. Time-domain simulation results of the micro-grid system implemented in MATLAB/Simulink validate the correctness of analysis and the effectiveness of the proposed model.

articleTitle: Static security control method to solve UPFC near area equipment overload
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: At present, the fast adjustment characteristics of UPFC are used to solve the static security problem in the near area, but the control objectives are determined beforehand, without considering the change of the actual operation mode and the economy. In this paper, UPFC is taken as the static security control and optimization measure to solve the overload of UPFC near area equipment. Firstly, the effectiveness of UPFC static security control is determined. Then, UPFC control objectives are determined by using cluster parallel computing. Finally, UPFC adopts a given control mode and setting value, and conventional control measures are used as supplement continue to eliminate the static insecurity. The actual data analysis results of Southern Jiangsu show that the method proposed can effectively solve the UPFC near area static security problem and optimize the network loss.

articleTitle: A kind of Recommendation Algorithm of Matrix Decomposition Based on Power Grid User Rating Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Recommender system can effectively solve the information overload problem in the era of big data. Recent research on recommender systems, specifically Collaborative Filtering, has focused on Matrix Factorization methods, which have been shown to have excellent performance in the recommendation. However, these methods do not pay attention to the influence of user's rating characteristics, which are especially important for the accuracy of prediction or recommendation. Therefore, in order to get better performance, this paper proposes a novel method based on matrix factorization. We consider that the user's rating score is composed of two parts, one part is called real score which is decided by the user's preferences, and another part is called bias score, which is decided by the user's rating characteristics. We analyze the user's historical behavior to find his rating characteristics by using the matrix factorization technique, and then use them to adjust the final prediction results. By comparing with the latest algorithms on the existing datasets, we verified that the proposed method can significantly improve the accuracy of recommender systems and achieves the best performance in terms of prediction accuracy criterion over the state-of-the-art methods.

articleTitle: A Novel Integrated Control Strategy of Multi-micro Source Microgrid
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: To solve the problem that voltage and frequency fluctuations during the switching process of grid-connected and island of microgrid with multi-micro source, this paper researches the structure and characteristics of doubly fed induction generator (DFIG), micro gas turbine and battery, then proposes a novel integrated control strategy of multi-micro source microgrid. The proposed method utilizes different control methods are adopted for multi-micro source. Make the micro source have a stable output in grid-connected operation state. Maintaining the micro source has a stable output during switching process of grid-connected and island, and keeping a stable and reliable voltage and frequency in island operation state. Ensure the voltage frequency stability during the switching mode of the microgrid operation mode. This paper simulates the microgrid system by using Matlab/Simulink simulation software. And the simulation results verify that the novel integrated control strategy for multi-micro source microgrid is stable and can smoothly transition when the microgrid operating state is switched.

articleTitle: Passive Sliding Mode Variable Structure Control For MMC-UPFC
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Modular multilevel converter based unified power flow controller (MMC-UPFC) plays an important role in active control of smart grid. It provides a powerful solution to problems in grid operation and future development. MMC-UPFC is a nonlinear system with strong coupling characteristics. Traditional dual closed-loop PI control has disadvantages such as difficult control parameter design, slow dynamic response and limited stable operation interval. Therefore, a nonlinear strategy based on passive sliding mode variable structure control (P-SMC) of UPFC is proposed in this paper. Firstly, a UPFC passive controller on the basis of MMC Euler-Lagrange (EL) model is established by damping injection method according to passive control theory. Secondly, the proposed passive controller is combined with sliding mode variable structure control to provide fast response and robustness against parameter change and external disturbance. Finally, a 27-level MMC-UPFC model is constructed in MATLAB/Simulink and verifies the effectiveness of the proposed control strategy.

articleTitle: Electricity Consumption and Weather Reflect Macro-Economic Status
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Electricity is closely related to economy. With the development of society and deployment of green energy, a more complex and close relationship between electricity and economy is coming into being. Electricity consumption and Gross Domestic Product (GDP) are the most intuitive indicator of electricity and macro-economy. On one hand, this paper aims to find out the relationship between electricity consumption and GDP; on the other hand, it builds GDP forecast model to replace the costly traditional economy census. Aiming at predicting economic status, 29 provincial GDP, electricity consumption and weather factors in China during 2006-2017 have been analyzed in this paper. The results indicate that although electricity consumption is bound up with local economic development, and GDP standard could be forecasted better combining with local weather factors such as average temperature. Moreover, the method not only revealed the macro-economy instantaneously with nearly no cost, but also provide a new way to assess risky signal in local economy structure.

articleTitle: Capacity Assessment of VAR Compensation in Distribution Network using Multi-parametric Programming
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: The increasing integration of distributed generation (DG) brings new problems to distribution network and requires more VAR compensation device to cope with overvoltage problem. In order to allocate VAR compensation device reasonably and assist planning and construction of VAR compensation, capacity assessment of VAR compensation is indispensable. This paper proposes a new method to conduct capacity assessment for VAR compensation on distribution network based on multi-scenario optimization method by introducing the multi-parametric programming. The new method handles the uncertainties of loads and DGs efficiently and can facilitate more scenarios to refine the solution. The tests on the IEEE 69 buses system shown the proposed algorithm correct and efficient.

articleTitle: Optimal Operation of Distribution Network with Distributed Wind Power Efficient Consumption Accounting for Demand Response
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: After large-scale access of wind power to the distribution network, how to improve the ability of distributed wind power consumption under the premise of ensuring the safe operation of the system is an urgent problem to be solved. This paper constructs an optimal operation model that aims to achieve efficient consumption of wind power resources, improve demand response utilization and voltage quality at grid-connected points. The hybrid integer second-order cone programming method based on multi-objective collaborative optimization of distribution network with distributed wind power makes the optimization problem efficient, fast and accurate. In the example test of the extended IEEE 33 node system, the feasibility of the proposed distributed wind power grid-connected optimization operation method was tested.

articleTitle: A Fuzzy Multi-objective Operation Strategy of Energy Storage System based on Gravity Search Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: As the key element of active distribution systems (ADSs), energy storage systems (ESSs) play multiple important roles including enhancing reliability and improving economic efficiency. In this study, a novel day-ahead operation strategy is proposed for ESSs, and it is developed as a fuzzy multi-objective model without violating the operating constraints. In this model, three objectives are taken into account adequately and equally, including the enhancement of reliability, the improvement of economic efficiency, and the promotion of operation friendliness. In order to harmonize the relation among these objectives, the approach based on the fuzzy mathematical theory is adopted. To solve this proposed fuzzy multi-objective model, the gravity search algorithm (GSA) is adopted. Simulation results obtained based on the modified IEEE-33 bus distribution system are provided and discussed, where the availability and the feasibility of the proposed model and adopted algorithm are verified.

articleTitle: Spatial-temporal Charging Pattern Analysis for Electric Taxi Grid Integration Study
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Many cities in China are planning to adopt electric vehicles on a large scale. It is foreseeable that electric taxis will be an integral part of smart grids in the near future. However, due to the lack of historical data, the charging load of electric taxis is highly uncertain. This paper proposes a charging behavior simulation framework for electric taxi based on trajectory data of conventional internal combustion taxis currently in operation. The framework consists of battery discharging model, battery charging model and charging event decision model. Under this framework, dynamics of state of charge can be simulated and rational charging decisions can be derived. A case study is performed using GPS data of a taxi fleet in Shanghai, China. Spatial and temporal distribution of charging load is obtained and the effect of charging price is examined.

articleTitle: An Implementation Evaluation Method of Demand Response considering Secondary Peak Effect
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Demand response (DR) has become an effective options provide balance service for the system. The evaluation of DR is a key part of its implementation, involving response cost, capacity and other aspects. A novel implementation effect evaluation model of DR on the response and rebound stage is proposed from the perspective of time and capacity. Considering secondary peak effect, the concept of average rebound is taken into account, and a multi-level index system of DR implementation effect is presented, solved by attribute interval recognition. Then, the evaluation results are applied to the newly DR distribution scheme. Simulation results show its effectiveness and feasibility.

articleTitle: Study of Intelligent Inspection for Distribution Network Based on Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: In order to solve the problems of lines and equipment inspection for distribution network of traditional way at present, such as low level of information technology, insufficient state acquisition, high management cost and low inspection efficiency, This paper proposes an intelligent inspection and diagnosis system based on the technology of internet of things. According to the network layers of the internet of things, the system is divided into three layers , namely, the perception layer, network layer, and an application layer, which has developed a kind of intelligent inspection terminal at perception layer. Intelligent inspection terminal can be real-time position of distribution equipment and personnel, and collection of multi-source heterogeneous status information, such as infrared, ultraviolet, visible, partial discharge, the transient waves, ultrasonic images and video. The network layer preprocesses the object data perceived by the intelligent inspection terminal, and transfers the object data to the application layer server in real time through the wireless network and the unified communication protocol. The application layer, based on the multi-source heterogeneous state data, proposes a comprehensive route optimization strategy state and status evaluation and comprehensive diagnosis method of power distribution equipment, adopts the fast non dominated sorting genetic algorithm with the elite strategy.
