System has practical application in Hubei 200 article 10 kV distribution network, which can effectively reduce the total time of distribution network inspection, reduce the inspection of distribution line operations staff workload and improve the work quality and efficiency of inspection.

articleTitle: Non-Invasive Electromagnetic Sensor for Residential Harmonic Distortion
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Power quality of the residential distribution systems receives lots of attention as the penetration of household power-electronic appliances has been significantly increased in recent years. Existing current measurement technologies are only able to measure either a single wire (e.g., clamp-on probe) or two-wire cables using a sensor array, which is large in size and difficult to install. A non-invasive, integrated, compact electro-magnetic sensor for the two-wire residential service cables is proposed, designed and applied to monitor household harmonic distortion. It does not need to break the cable enclosure and is convenient to deploy by attaching the sensor to the cable. Its accuracy is proven by a series of comparisons with standard measuring instruments. And harmonic distortion analysis is made using the measure waveforms of various household appliances.

articleTitle: Analysis on AC Voltage Characteristic of UHVDC Converter Station and Dynamic Compensation
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: It is projected that Ultra High Voltage Direct Current (UHVDC) can impact positively in both economic and environmental aspects but they will also decrease the security and stability of power grid, especially result in lack of dynamic reactive power reserve and dynamic voltage support. So, dynamic compensation devices are needed in order to avoid commutation failure or even more serious blocking failure. First, the characteristic of dynamic voltage concerned with AC bus and UHVDC converter valve, and the characteristics of different reactive power compensation devices are analyzed. Then, possible compensation schemes, including parallel device, serious device and combined device, are proposed according to the different characters of compensation devices. Thereafter, the effect of dynamic voltage support of different scheme is compared and verified by simulation.

articleTitle: Stability Analysis of N-Paralleled Photovoltaic Grid-connected DC Systems
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: The increasing penetration of renewable energy is altering concern about the stability of the renewable grid-connected system. Photovoltaic (PV) output characteristic should be considered when modelling for N-paralleled PV grid-connected systems, where nonlinear methods are required. In this paper, N-paralleled PV grid-connected DC systems are modelled and simplified firstly. Then for a single PV system, describing function method is adopted to model the nonlinear part of the power control part based on P&O method. Finally, the influence of the grid inductance and the number of paralleled systems are analyzed. Theoretical analysis shows that the increscent grid inductance and the number destabilizes the system, and RTLAB simulation is conducted to verify the analysis.

articleTitle: Research on Storage and Processing Method for Renewable Energy Big Data
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: With the development of renewable energy, the amount of renewable energy data is growing rapidly. Renewable energy data is either large in volume or low in value density. Traditional data processing methods cannot meet the rapid query for state monitoring, evaluation and prediction. The need for power system analysis using renewable energy big data is thus urgent. This paper studies the storage and processing methods of big data in power systems with high proportion of renewable energy. Based on the analysis of renewable energy data characteristics and distributed data storage methods, this paper presents a general processing and storage framework for renewable energy big data.

articleTitle: A Locating Method of EV Fast Charging Stations Based on the Conditional Generative Adversarial Networks
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: The planning and locating of charging stations is of great significance for the development of EV. The existed methods are often carried out by solving an optimal model, which requires a large amount of user data to simulate user behavior. Considering that a large number of planning schemes are available, this paper proposes a construction planning method of EV charging station based on the conditional Generative Adversarial Networks, aiming to find a quick and convenient planning method and thus reduce the demand for user's data under the condition of ensuring the rationality of the results. The pix2pix problem was solved by cGANs, and the network structure was adjusted reasonably to avoid over-fitting. The construction diagram of the charging station was captured for training, and the network achieved good results in both the training set and the test set.

articleTitle: Integrated Decision Making of Distribution Network Planning Schemes Based on EW-GRA Algorithm Combined with P-OWA Operator
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: To solve the problem of strong subjectivity and less objectivity of decision-making in distribution network planning scheme caused by qualitative evaluation indices, a model was proposed which combines parabolic ordered weighted average operator (P-OWA) with entropy weight and grey relational analysis (EW-GRA). Firstly, the expert scoring of qualitative indices were reasonably assembled by a P-OWA operator. The whole indices using an entropy weight method. The correlation matrix was obtained according to a grey relation analysis. The grey correlation degree was obtained by weighting. Finally, the optimal scheme was obtained according to the result of ranking. By applying this method to an actual case, its effectiveness was verified by comparing with other methods.

articleTitle: Analysis of a Relay Protection Responding to 220kV Transmission Line
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: The paper introduces an accident of line protection action caused by disconnecting switch fault. According to the time sequence of the line relay protection action and the principle of protection action, this paper makes a detailed analysis of the line protection action. According to the impedance distribution of grid, the reason why one side of the zero-sequence protection does not work is explained in detail by calculating the zero-sequence voltage when the fault occurs. At the same time, the reason why Substation side of line protection did not receive the remote breaking was explained.

articleTitle: Research on Credibility of the Dynamic Simulation of Power Grid Frequency Regulation based on the Hybrid System Model
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: This paper presents an index of the reliability of the dynamic simulation results of power grid frequency regulation, and the actual tests of power grid are carried out, in the view of two typical power grid faults. Real-time test using Power System Dynamics-Full Dynamic Simulation (PSD-FDS) which was developed by China Electric Power Research Institute. Finally, the reliability of simulation results is analyzed by evaluation indices. The feasibility of simulation models and parameters in terms of accurate simulation calculation is verified.

Author Keywords: the modeling method of hybrid system

articleTitle: A Decompositon Method for Weekly Unit Commitment Considering Hydro Power Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: With the development of hybrid power system, its unit commitment (UC) faces the problem of large scale and high complexity. This paper proposes an ADMM-based method to decompose the problem to smaller scale while obtaining the same result. Considering the cross day adjustment characteristic of hydro power, the UC through one week or longer period is broken down to each single day. By obtaining the scheduling solution and hydro power distribution plan alternatively and iteratively, the final solution with high precision can be determined. The case studies prove the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Design Method for the Reinforcement Scheme of the Typical Regional Power Grid with High Proportion of Renewable Energy using VSC-HVDC Technology
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: A design method for the reinforcement scheme of the typical regional power grid with high proportion of renewable energy using voltage source converter based high voltage direct current (VSC-HVDC) technology is proposed. Taking Chuxiong Power Grid in Yunnan as an example, this paper firstly analyzes two main factors that restrict its safe and stable operation. Then, two VSC-HVDC reinforcement schemes are designed from two aspects of location and capacity determination. Finally, the two alternative reinforcement schemes are analyzed technically. The calculation results show that, the two VSC-HVDC schemes can reduce the line load rate of those lines with severe overload problems to less than 90%, which is a good solution to the line overload problem of the electromagnetic loop networks. With the VSC-HVDC technology, the voltage level of key buses in Chuxiong area is increased by 10%~19% during the fault period, effectively increasing the voltage level of the system.

articleTitle: Two-stage Optimization Method for Medium and Long-term Electric Quantity Security Check
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: In order to quantitatively evaluate the security risks of medium and long-term electric quantity transaction contract, a two-stage optimization method for electric quantity security check is proposed. In the first stage, the optimization model of electric quantity security check is established with the objective of minimizing the power flow over-limit for transmission equipment, and the optimal unit commitment result under the electric quantity constraints is obtained. In the second stage, the optimization model of electric quantity security correction is established by consider the security constraints of power grid strictly, and the power flow over-limit for transmission equipment is eliminated by adjusting the unit commitment result. The two-stage optimal method obtains the executable conclusion of electric quantity contract, and further to locate the reason why the electric quantity contract is not feasible, and how to adjust it. A case study based on actual data of provincial power grid indicates the effectiveness.

articleTitle: DE algorithm based double-layer frame of power flow calculation for loop distribution networks
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: This paper introduces a differential evolution algorithm based double-layer frame of power flow calculation for loop networks. Loops in distribution networks firstly are converted into radial structures by breaking up loop breakpoints. Then the power flow calculation for loop network is considered as two layers with upper layer as an optimization problem while the lower layer as a traditional power flow problem. In the upper layer, differential evolution algorithm is used to optimize the injected power in breakpoints in order to ensure that equality of the radial network and the transformed ring network. In the lower layer, an improved back/forward sweep algorithm is applied to calculate power flow of radial networks in each iteration. The power flow distribution of loop network is obtained when the calculation in upper layer achieves convergence. The numerical results in modified IEEE 33-bus system demonstrate the efficiency of the proposed method in power flow calculation for loop distribution networks.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Filtering Function for Grid Connected STATCOM in Wind Power Applications
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: The paper investigates the potential for added value of the active filtering function of a STATCOM at the AC grid access point for the connection of wind power. This study is based on a realistic project with the network parameters and background harmonics required for modelling provided by the grid operators. The model is constructed in DIgSILENT PowerFactory. The phenomenon of background harmonic amplification is illustrated and two leading candidate switching scenarios are selected for the studies on low order harmonics. The active power filtering control algorithms for the grid connected STATCOM is evaluated in this study to provide a level of understanding of the potential limitations and problems that might be encountered in performing the APF function in STATCOM.

articleTitle: Technical Analysis of the Charge/Discharge Rate and the Capacity of Batteries in Meeting the Residential Peak Demand within a Community Solar
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: There is a growing trend among the decision-makers in suggesting the installation of energy storages such as batteries in residential premises. However, the cost of batteries is comparatively high. Moreover, batteries installed by the individual households may not be optimally utilized during a significant portion of the year as there may not be enough generation from rooftop photovoltaic (RPV) systems during winter to charge the battery to its full capacity. Community solar on the other hand, if optimally designed can give the opportunity to use a battery to its maximum capacity. One of the key parameters in battery design are its charge and discharge rate and the overall capacity. This paper presents a technical analysis of battery energy storages in achieving the desired objectives of self-consumption, self-sufficiency and peak shaving. It also discusses the degree of usage of battery during peak demand periods.

articleTitle: Research on the Structure Optimization of Grid Frame Based on Generalized Slow Coherency Clustering
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Considering that the existence of fuzzy nodes will increase the difficulty of clustering when the system splitting occurs, a method is proposed to change the network topology, reduce the number of fuzzy nodes, and optimize the system operation. Firstly, we can obtain the modal matrix of all system nodes based on the generalized eigenvalue analysis. Secondly, Gauss elimination with pivoting is used to construct the slow coherence correlation matrix. Thirdly, the optimal scheme is obtained by continuously modifying the grid structure. It can reduce the number of fuzzy nodes, which is more convenient to maintain the stable operation of the system. Finally, the simulation results of IEEE-118 system show that the proposed method is reasonable and effective.

articleTitle: Impact of Different Protection Outlet Schemes on the Body Equipment of Large Capacity Power Flow Control Device
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: The large capacity power flow control device is able to quickly and flexibly control the power flow of the line, improve the uneven power flow of grid and realize real-time control and dynamic compensation of the AC line. The protection system is a guarantee to realize system dynamic performance and safety and reliability of the system operation. The Unified Power Flow Controller (UPFC) and the Static Synchronous Series Compensator (SSSC) are the most typical devices. This paper mainly studies the influence of two kinds of protection outlet schemes on the body equipment of the UPFC based on Modular Multi-level Converter (MMC). According to parameters of the demonstration project and RTDS real-time digital simulation experiments, focus on analyzing the effect on DC voltage, sub-module capacitor voltage and thyristor bypass switch (TBS) with the three-phase short-circuit fault of the series valve side AC bus respectively.

articleTitle: A Frequency Control Strategy Using Electric Vehicles Considering Travelling Demand
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: The increasing use of renewable energy presents a significant challenge to the frequency stability of power grids. This paper proposes a frequency control strategy using electric vehicles (EVs) considering travelling demand. Firstly, the controllable area is introduced to determine the response capability of EV. Secondly, a state index State of Battery (SOB) is defined to describe the available response capability, which is represent by a relative position between the upper and lower limit of the controllable area. Finally, a sorting algorithm is proposed to change the EV charging power for frequency control. A simplified Great Britain model is used to investigate the effectiveness of the control strategy. Simulation results show that the proposed frequency control strategy suppressed frequency fluctuations effectively with satisfying the travelling demand.

articleTitle: Wind Power Fluctuation Absorption through EV Charging Power Control Based on Markov Chain
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: It is a general trend for new energy vehicles to replace traditional fuel vehicles, while the number of electric vehicles has increased dramatically, the pressure of charging on the power grid has also increased. Therefore, from the angle of wind power absorption of electric vehicles, this paper mainly studies the time series of wind speed power. The time series of wind speed is decomposed into the sum of 15-minute average wind speed signal and turbulent wind speed signal. The relationship between the magnitude of turbulent signal and average wind speed is studied. Based on the discrete Markov chain, the battery state transition probability of electric vehicle is established according to the results of Monte Carlo simulation. The state transition matrix varies with time, and the stationary distribution is obtained to obtain the charging potential of the electric vehicle in a certain area, that is, the charging demand of the electric vehicle with time. The main factors affecting the state transition matrix are analyzed, and the results of each factor affecting the state transition matrix are given. Thus, a more accurate charging potential model can be obtained. By predicting the average wind speed, the number of electric vehicles participating in the regulation can be obtained. The results of simulation indicate that wind fluctuation can be effectively reduced by controlling charging power of electric vehicle.

articleTitle: Efficient Abnormal Load Identification in Large-Scale Power System employing Rayleigh Quotient Method and Parallel Computing Techniques
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: This paper proposes an efficient abnormal load identification method in large-scale power system employing Rayleigh quotient method and parallel computing techniques. It firstly constructs a group of data source matrices with random load fluctuation and noise interference for each zone, respectively. Then their standard matrices and the sample covariance matrices of each zone can be formed. Secondly, the maximum eigenvalue of sample covariance matrix (MESCM) for each zone could be acquired rapidly with the help of the Rayleigh quotient method and the parallel computing techniques. In this way, the rapid identification of abnormal load may be achieved by the violation checking of MESCM. Utilizing PST and Matlab® software, the case studies have been carried on an IEEE 54-machine and 118-bus system and a Polish 420-machine and 2736-bus system. The results in comparison with the traditional mean spectral radius(MSR) based method show that the proposed methodology is valid and efficient.

articleTitle: Designs and Applications for the Controller Parameters of the Photovoltaic System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: The environmental factors and the design parameter of the photovoltaic (PV) power generation system have a large influence on the stability and reliability of the PV system. In order to find scientifically and rationally parameters for the stability of the system in the global control parameter scope, a global optimization method is proposed in this paper, which has a global consideration on the main factors that affect the stability of the system. By using this method, we make an optimization to the control parameter of the PV power generation system, and obtain a set of the optimal control parameters. It is demonstrated by simulation that the global optimization method can lead the PV system have a better stability. Finally, using the optimal control parameters obtained by the global optimization method, we present an analysis for the influences of the ambient and system physics parameters on the stability the PV power generation system, and discovered some rules of the system stability, which can play an important role in the PV system design.

articleTitle: Field Implementation of a Real-time Battery Control Scheme for a Microgrid at the University of California, Riverside
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: This study demonstrates a real-time battery control scheme which consists of off-peak, mid-peak and on-peak period operation of a microgrid system at the University of California, Riverside. Using limited system historical information, the control scheme minimizes demand peak and energy consumption from the grid under a time of use (TOU) rate schedule. The off-peak operation mode fully charges the battery system while keeping low building demand by autonomously adjusting the demand threshold based on the real-time building load. The mid-peak operation mode maximizes self-consumption of onsite renewable energy by consuming surplus energy stored in the battery system. As previous reported, on-peak operation mode minimizes the building net load by optimally discharging the battery system based on real-time solar generation and building load consumption.

articleTitle: Study on the Influence of Key Structure Parameters of Conical Insulator on AC and DC Electric Field Distribution
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: In AC and DC power system, the conical insulator is an important component in gas insulated switchgear (GIS) or gas insulated transmission line (GIL) equipment. The flashover phenomenon formed on the surface of the conical insulator is the key factor determining the insulation strength of GIS/GIL equipment. Studying the influence of the structural parameters of the conical insulator on the electric field distribution along the surface under the AC and DC voltage is of great significance for increasing the flashover voltage of the insulator and improving the insulation reliability of the equipment. In this paper, the key structural parameters of the conical insulator (inclination angle and fillet radius) are taken as the research object. The electrostatic equation is used to calculate the AC electric field distribution along the surface under different structural parameters. Consider the generation, migration, diffusion, recombination of free ions in gas, and the nonlinear relationship between gas current density and electric field strength. A numerical model for the charge transport and accumulation in DC GIS/GIL is established, and the DC electric field distribution along surface under different structural parameters is calculated. According to the calculation results, the influence laws of the inclination angle and fillet radius of the conical insulator on the AC and DC electric field along the surface are obtained, and the difference of the AC and DC electric field distribution along surface is compared. The results show that under the AC voltage, the electric field strength along the surface increases as the inclination angle increases, and decreases as the fillet radius increases; Under the DC voltage, the electric field strength along the surface has different distribution patterns near the high voltage conductor and the grounding shell: the electric field strength near the high voltage conductor decreases as the increase of the inclination angle, and the electric field strength near the ground shell increases as the increase of the inclination angle; Under the DC electric field, the polarity of the accumulated charge on both sides of the conical insulator is different, the concave surface accumulates a negative charge, the convex surface accumulates a positive charge, and the concave negative charge density is 1.6 times the convex positive charge density. The surface average charge density increases as the inclination angle increases and decreases as the fillet radius increases. The conclusion of this study has reference value for guiding the design optimization of GIS/GIL conical insulator structure.

articleTitle: DERs Sizing of Hybrid Microgrid by Hierarchic Optimization Strategy
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Optimal sizing of distributed energy resources is of great importance to enhance the reliability and economic performance of microgrid. In this paper, multiple objective functions are employed to determine the optimal capacity, including the utilization rate of renewable energy, economic performance, and reliability of the system. The capacity optimization is transformed into two parts by using hierarchic optimization strategy. The first part is to calculate the rough capacity range of wind, PV, storage and diesel generator. The mixed integer programming is employed to solve the problem, taking the minimum capacity of energy storage and diesel generator as the objective function. The second part is to seek the best capacity through the rough capacity range. The capacity configuration scheme is obtained by optimizing the cost and operation of hybrid microgrid. The method is used in an example microgrid, the results show that the model can get the optimal capacity guaranteeing the reliability and economy of the system, and the utilization rate of renewable energy is improved.

articleTitle: Probabilistic assessment of distribution network with high penetration of distribution generations
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: In order to better understand the impact of distributions generations (DGs) on the active power distribution networks (ADNs), a combined 3 points estimation method and maximum entropy technique (3PEM-ME) is developed for the probabilistic analysis of ADNs with high penetration of DGs. The proposed method takes advantages of two state-of-the-art approaches: the well-established 3PEM to obtain statistical moments of output variables; the ME technique to reconstruct the probability distributions based on the obtained moments. The proposed method has some remarkable features, including the ability to accurately obtain statistical moments of desired outputs in an efficient manner; to precisely estimate the tail regions of probability density functions (PDFs). The proposed method is used to evaluate the over-limit events and voltage stability in IEEE 33-bus system. The results show that the proposed method can achieve high accuracy while requiring less computational effort compared with the conventional approaches.

articleTitle: Security co-planning of generation and transmission considering flexible facility and high-penetration renewable energy
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: With high-penetration renewable energy integrated, the absence of flexibility is endogenously appeared, which draws the importance of installing flexible devices. To improve the network flexibility and prevent stochastic contingencies, a novel security co-planning methodology of generation and transmission with multiple flexible devices is proposed in this paper. The flexible facility installation is composed of VSC-HVDC feeder construction and TCSC extension. The flexibility of transmission network is represented by load shedding and renewable curtailment. Compared with the previous research, the proposed novel model takes comprehensive consideration of both AC and DC losses, which is more suitable for the practical scenario. For the sake of contingency adaptability, N-1 stochastic contingency is taken into consideration by consecutive branch-breaking. Case studies are carried out on the modified Gaver 6-bus and IEEE 24-bus test systems, and the results show that the proposed model is able to enhance the flexibility, reduce the loss cost and guarantee the security of the power system.

Author Keywords: co-planning of generation and transmission security

articleTitle: Extracting Time-Varying Subsynchronous Oscillation in Wind Power Systems Through Kalman Filtering
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Unlike traditional subsynchronous resonance having fixed resonance frequency, the frequency of oscillation caused by subsynchronous control interaction (SSCI) in wind power systems is time-varying. The oscillation frequency depends on various factors including series compensation degree, wind speed, grid stiffness, converter control structures and parameters, and number of in-service wind generators. The accurate estimation of time-varying subsynchronous frequency component is necessary for the identification, monitoring, and control of the SSCI. In this work, Kalman filtering approach is utilized to recursively extract the time-varying subsynchronous frequency component. The proposed methodology is first verified on benchmark signals under fixed and time-varying subsynchronous components. Then, it is validated on an actual wind power system suffering from SSCI. The Kalman filter based frequency estimator is developed in PSCAD and run in parallel with the Guyuan wind power system model. The results show that the proposed method efficiently extracts the time-varying SSCI components.

articleTitle: Active distribution network planning method under power-user interaction mode
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: With the continuous enrichment of demand-side resources in the active distribution network, a good source-charge interaction mechanism can take advantage of the complementary characteristics of power generation resources and demand side resources in the active distribution network to promote new energy consumption and cost optimization. In this regard, based on the source-charge interaction response model, this paper proposes a distributed power bi-level programming method that considers power-user interaction. The upper model of the method aims at the comprehensive optimization of economic and environmental indicators, and determines the location and capacity of the distributed power supply. The lower model aims to minimize the annual operating cost after implementing the interactive response. Control distributed power output and load demand response power. Finally, the improved particle swarm optimization algorithm is used to solve the model and verify the effectiveness of the method.

articleTitle: Analysis and Treatment of 220kV Main Transformer Insulating Cylinder Discharge Failure
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Through the analysis of dendritic discharge faults on the 220kV transformer insulating cylinder, the basic process of dendritic discharge faults on the insulating cylinder is expounded. It is demonstrated that the insulation moisture and gas inclusion are the main external factors, and the insulation structure defects and the first oil gas distance on the winding surface are the main internal factors causing the fault. Through the simulation of transformer insulating cylinder discharge accident, the mechanism of the insulating cylinder dendritic discharge is obtained, and the countermeasures for preventing the insulating cylinder discharge are proposed. Finally, the concrete measures to prevent the fault of the insulating cylinder dendritic discharge are put forward.

articleTitle: Numerical Analysis of Cavitation Flow in Low Specific Speed Condensate Pump Impeller
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: The low specific speed condensate pump has the characteristics of high head, small flow, large outer diameter of the impeller and low efficiency.However, during cavitation, the head is reduced, the efficiency is reduced, and the noise is increased significantly.This paper takes 105-34-1500 type condensate pump as the research object.Based on numerical calculation and experimental method, the flow rule of cavitation in condensate pump impeller is studied.The results show that at 0.6 times design flow, with the inlet pressure decreases, the cavitation on the suction surface of the blade is significantly larger than the cavitation on the pressure surface and there is a significant fracture cavitation occurs in the volute. At the design flow rate, significant gap cavitation occurs in the volute with the inlet pressure decreases. At 1.4 times the design flow, the cavitation is intensified and fills the entire flow path. With the pressure decreases, the cavitation zone on the pressure surface gradually disappears, and there is obvious cavitation at the exit of the volute. This phenomenon causes the pump characteristic curve to drop faster, and this condition should be avoided as much as possible.

articleTitle: An evolution algorithm of the distribution network reconfiguration to avoid the infeasible solution
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: The importance of the distribution network gains more attention due to the development of the smart grid and the renewable energy. A method to guarantee the radial structure of the distribution network reconfiguration schemes is proposed in this paper based on the features of the network. The self-own switches of each circle are proposed. The switch that is going to be opened during the iteration is selected in random from the closed switches of circles, which can ensure the optimal scheme. The operation of the self-own switch can guarantee the radial structure of the network. Furthermore, the proposed method can handle networks with different structures effectively, including the circle with circle. The results with IEEE33 and IEEE69 tested system demonstrate that the proposed method can find the optimal solution of the distribution network reconfiguration effectively. Meanwhile, the infeasible structures are avoided.

articleTitle: Hybrid HVDC system parameters tuning based on Robust Multi-Objective Optimization via Evolutionary Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: The hybrid HVDC transmission system combines the advantages of the line commutated convertor (LCC) and the voltage source converter (VSC) which has great development prospect. Given the uncertainty and complexity in parameters tuning of control modules, this paper introduces a novel robust Multi-Objective Optimization via Evolutionary Algorithms (RMOEA). By searching pareto optimal solutions and robust solutions separately, each region's convergency and diversity performance under perturbance are enhanced appreciably. The improved RMOEA is used to optimize the PI parameters in the rectifier side controller and the inverter side dq axis decoupled dual-loop controller simultaneously. The simulation is implemented jointly by MATLAB and PSCAD software and the experiments results show that compared with the other optimization algorithm, the proposed RMOEA verifies the effectivity of improvements on robustness under the disturbances and tracking ability of preference.

articleTitle: Research on adjustment and utilization strategy of transformer in distribution network based on safety efficiency cost
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: The development of China power grid is accelerating, and the assets of the power grid are large with fast growing, the equipments are new, and the service life is short, resulting in the poor utilization of power grid assets. This paper presents an adjustment and utilization strategy based on Safety Efficiency Cost (SEC) for main transformer in distribution network to adjust and replace the transformer with light load. First, the distribution network planning model is built on the basis of the safety efficiency cost index, then the planning model is used to evaluate the selection scheme to get the optimal replacement time. Focusing on the basis of this, the main variable adjustment and utilization strategy is put forward. The feasibility and validity of the model method are verified by relevant examples.

articleTitle: Application Research of Fiber Bragg Grating Sensing System in Condition Monitoring of Voltage Transformer
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: This paper presented a cross-correlation-based FBG wavelength offset detection algorithm, applied it to transformer condition monitoring, significantly improved the accuracy of measurement. The test results show that the measurement error of central wavelength can be limited between 2pm and 3pm in the SNR range of 7dB to 14db. Under high SNR conditions, the absolute error can be reduced to approximately 0.5 pm. Therefore, the demodulation algorithm can effectively reduce the influence of noise, and help to further study the characteristics of the FBG sensor demodulation system, thereby improving the transformer condition monitoring accuracy.

articleTitle: High-frequency Modeling of UHVDC Converter Station Based on PSCAD
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: The converter valve always generates high-frequency harmonics during the switch-on and switch-off processes. The high-frequency harmonics in the carrier communication band (30 kHz-500 kHz) will conduct through the conduction channel to the AC/DC line and interfere the carrier communication equipment. This paper is based on ±1100 kV UHVDC project. Firstly, the high-frequency model of the converter valve with equivalent voltage source is built according to its actual circuit structure. The parameters of the equivalent voltage source can be obtained by fitting with the actual high-frequency noise level of the converter. Secondly, high-frequency models of the key equipment in converter station are proposed. Then the complete high-frequency conduction channel is built in PSCAD and the parameters are obtained through standard specifications and test results. Finally the high-frequency noise levels of the relevant points are measured separately before and after installing PLC filter, and the parameters of PLC filter can be optimized.

articleTitle: Smart Terminal Unit for Distribution Network with Model Verification Ability
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Large scale integration of intermittent renewable energy sources, responsive loads and energy storage devices in distribution network has brought great challenges to operation in power systems, especially under fault condition. To cope with the requirement of reliability of the distribution network, distributed feeder automation (FA) is utilized, and the performance of it is high relied on the accuracy of the system model. In this paper, a verification algorithm is introduced to check the model from smart terminal unit (STU) and master station to enhance the reliability of distributed FA. The algorithm utilized MD5 message-digest algorithm and consensus algorithm to generate the "finger print" of the model to be compared with each other. Thus, the comparison can be achieved by communication between the master station and only one STU, which greatly simplifies the verification procedure and increase its speed. And the application of this algorithm is also given in the paper.

articleTitle: Design of temperature control system for high-precision position sensor calibration thermostat based on Fuzzy-PID compensation
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: The calibration of the position sensor of the nuclear pump test rig requires strict temperature compensation accuracy. In order to overcome the problems of nonlinearity, large hysteresis and uncertainty encountered in the thermostat calibration environment, a fuzzy and PID (Proportional-Integral-Derivative) switching control method were used to make an accurate and rapid control over the internal temperature, combining with the virtual instrument technology. The measurement hardware system consists of the industrial computer, cDAQ9184 and high-precision data acquisition card and synchronization mechanism, with LabVIEW as its software. The test results show that the system has high control precision, accurate positioning and meets the engineering requirements.

articleTitle: Impacts of Switching AC Filters of UHVDC Converter Stations on Harmonics
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: To verify and evaluate the impacts of switching AC filters of converter stations on harmonics, the harmonic of HVDC power transmission project converter station under different filter combinations is researched. In this paper, harmonics measurement and simulation research under different types of unitized AC filters are given. Results of measurement and simulation show that switching AC filters of converter station may cause amplification, predict the possible harmonic amplification accident in converter station, also give suggestions on filter switching.

articleTitle: Research on the Vibration Characteristics of GIS/GIL Bushbar
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: The vibration characteristics of the GIS / GIL bus bar conductive rods have great influence on the operating noise and seismic capacity, and need to be evaluated by simulation in the design process. The structural characteristics of GIS / GIL busbar are analyzed, and the dynamic simulation model is established. The effects of length, thickness and joint spring stiffness on the vibration characteristics are simulated. The results show that when the thickness of the conductive rod is small, the base mode of the conductive rod is extrusion deformation, the increase of spring stiffness has no effect on the base frequency; when the thickness of the conductive rod is large, the base frequency of the conductive rod increases with the increase of the spring stiffness to a stable maximum, which equals to the frequency of work condition for simple support at one end . The error influencing factors of shell element and beam element are compared and analyzed: thickness is the main factor affecting the simulation accuracy of shell element, when the length of the conductive rod is not less than 110 mm and the thickness to diameter ratio is less than 0.182, the shell element simulation error is less than 5%; the main factor affecting the simulation accuracy of the beam element is length, when the length to diameter ratio is greater than 2.0, the maximum error of the beam element simulation is less than 5%.

articleTitle: General Design Research of Intelligent Substation Equipment Interface Based on Modular Construction
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: With the implementation of modular intelligent substation construction, the standardization of equipment interface is becoming more and more important. In this paper, the influence of modular construction on intelligent substation structure is analyzed, and the requirements for functions and interfaces of intelligent high-voltage equipment are given. Then taking the high voltage switch combination equipment as an example, the design method of the high voltage equipment interface considering the modular construction was studied. Finally, the interface design method and interface test flow of the intelligent high-voltage equipment are presented, and the gas insulated switchgear (GIS) is taken as an example to analyze the work. This type of interface design is suitable for modular intelligent substation structure, can realize the integration of protection, measurement and control, and can achieve cross-interval function concentration. The interface is based on IEC 61850 standard and has good expansibility and economy.

articleTitle: Intra-day Multi-sequential Generation Schedule Considering Energy Storage System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: To adapt to the rapid development of new energy and the construction of large capacity energy storage power station, this paper designs the intra-day generation scheduling and real-time generation scheduling progressive coordination mode, and puts forward a two-stage optimization method in the intra-day and real-time generation scheduling, to eliminate the new energy and load prediction deviation sequentially, and also focus on the effect of energy storage system on this multi-sequential scheduling. The first stage is new energy and load prediction deviation distribution model: deviation is decomposed to the units according to adjustment strategies. On the basis of the calculation result in the first stage, a coordinated smoothing model is established to obtain the final optimization result in the second stage. A case based on actual operating data is utilized to show the validity of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Research on Potential Evaluation Model of Electric Energy Alternative
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: The electric energy alternative is conducive to improving energy efficiency and promoting the development of clean energy at the same time. The implementation of electric energy alternative can improve the level of electrification and the proportion of clean energy to terminal energy, which is the future development trend. This paper first analyzes the necessity of implementing electric energy alternative. Then the main influencing factors of electric energy alternative are analyzed. The potential evaluation model of electric energy alternative is also proposed. Finally, the potential evaluation model of electric energy alternative is analyzed deeply. The research results can play a good guiding role in the future of Chinese electric energy alternative work.

articleTitle: A strategy for suppressing the second harmonic of output power for photovoltaic grid-connected inverters with low voltage ride-through
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: When an unbalanced voltage drop occurs in the grid system , output power of distributed photovoltaic grid-connected system will generate second harmonics. In order to suppress the second harmonic, a new low voltage ride-through control strategy is proposed, which can adjust the harmonic suppression target according to the degree of voltage drop. This strategy can suppress the second harmonic of active power when the voltage drop is low, and suppress the second harmonic of reactive power when the voltage drop is large. The control strategy is simulated in MATLAB, and the results testified its effectiveness.

articleTitle: Fault Model of Inverter Interfaced Distributed Generator Adopting PQ Control Strategy Considering Current Tracking Capability of Converter
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: As the scale of inverter interfaced distributed generator (IIDG) in low-voltage grid expanding, the changes of distribution network's fault characteristics are drawing great attention. The fault modeling method of IIDG gradually becomes an important part of the fault analysis of distribution network with IIDGs. This paper proposed an IIDG fault model considering the current tracking capability of the converter based on the analysis of the dynamic model, control system and parameter design of IIDG. In the proposed model, IIDG was equivalent to a voltage-controlled current source and a voltage- controlled voltage source according to whether the converter current tracks the reference exactly, which reflects the control characteristics of IIDG under different fault conditions. The case studies show that the calculation results based on proposed model are more consistent with electromagnetic transient simulation than that of existing model and have verified the high calculation accuracy as well as simplicity of the proposed model.

articleTitle: Analysis on Construction and Development of Hubei Electricity Sale Market
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Due to the lack of competition and unbalanced demand supply situation in current electricity market, deregulating electricity sale market has become the core of new electricity reform. The electricity market pattern of "multi-buyer-multi-seller" will be formed by opening up electricity sale market. In this paper, the construction and development of Hubei electricity sale market is introduced in detail. The first batch of electricity sale companies in Hubei Province is analyzed. The development stage of electricity sale market in Hubei Province is studied, including primary stage, growth stage and mature stage. The situation and suggestions of each stage are analyzed. The business development of electricity sale market in Hubei Province is proposed. The research results can provide a reference for other provinces in China to carry out electricity sale market reform.

articleTitle: An Optimization Method Based on Time-Sharing Energy Complementation to Determine Transmission Capacity of Wind-CSP Plants Combined System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Since northwest China has abundant wind and solar resources, constructing the concentrating solar power (CSP) plant near to the wind-generated electricity factory tend to a common form of energy exploiting. How to size for the capacity of the transmission line to meet the demand of delivery of the wind-concentrated solar power (CSP) plant system becomes an intensive problem. Based on the theory of time-sharing energy complementarity, this paper proposes a mathematical optimization model of the integrated output of Wind farm and CSP plant to suppress the power fluctuations. Then, by independently considering the impacts of the thermal storage capacity of CSP plant, the capacity optimization model of transmission line of wind power-CSP combined system is established. The case result demonstrates that the proposed method can reduce the investment cost of transmission line by reasonably configuring the thermal storage capacity of CSP. Moreover, the proposed strategy significantly improves the utilization rate of the transmission line and increases the comprehensive income of the joint generation system.

articleTitle: The system of implementation effect evaluation for distribution network planning and design standard
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: At present, the work of planning and designing standards for distribution networks only focuses on standard setting, and lacks effective methods and evaluation systems for evaluating the effectiveness of standards implementation. It is difficult to track, feedback and solve problems in standard applications. This paper briefly introduces the evaluation methods of domestic and international standards implementation effects, and combines the actual situation of distribution network planning and design standards to construct an evaluation system for the implementation of distribution network planning and design standards, and uses fuzzy analytic hierarchy process to evaluate the implementation effect of standards. In conclusion, this paper provides reference for the standardization of distribution network planning and design.

articleTitle: Urban Smart Energy System Architecture and Key Technology Analysis
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Based on the current situation of urban energy and the construction demand of smart energy system, this paper conducts research on key technologies. The urban smart energy system architecture is established from the three aspects of clean energy supply, optimal allocation and efficient utilization of energy, and smart energy support, and the application scenarios of key technologies adapted to local conditions are studied to form the technology path of combining near and far and cascade connection.

Author Keywords: optimal allocation and efficient utilization of energy

articleTitle: Interval-Based Decentralized Dispatch Method for Coupled Transmission-Distribution System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: In this study, a novel interval-based decentralized dispatch approach for the coupled transmission-distribution system optimization problem is proposed. The interval values are introduced as the control targets for tie-line power exchanged between the upper level transmission grid and lower level each distribution grid. According to the analytical target cascading technique, a decentralized dispatch framework and a set of decentralized dispatch models are formulated. Then the truncated diagonal quadratic approximation strategy is applied to coordinate the upper level transmission grid and lower level each distribution grid in a parallel manner. Test results illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: Hydro-dominated Power Markets in Southwest China: Characteristics and Challenges
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Hydro-dominated power markets have been formed in the southwest China where almost 70% of the China’s hydropower is concentrated. In 2015, China developed a new round of power market reform with the core goal of promoting the absorption of green and clean energy resources. This marketization provides new opportunities for hydropower absorption, at the same time brings new challenges. This paper deeply analyses the characteristics of hydro-dominated power markets in the southwest China, and further discusses the main challenges faced by these markets in the light of the reality of China’s electricity reformation and the common problems of general power markets. The analysis results provide references for market management and hydropower operation for hydro-dominated power markets.

articleTitle: Research on the Electricity Market Clearing Model and Price Fluctuation with Wind Power
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: The output of wind power is random and uncertain. As the proportion of wind power participating in the electricity market increases, it will have a great impact on the electricity price and the profit of traditional generators. Generating the scenarios of wind power by Monte Carlo method, this paper establishes unit commitment model and economic dispatch model of electricity spot market with wind power. Based on the actual operation data of a provincial electricity market, the changes of nodal price under different wind power penetration rates and different prediction accuracy of wind power are calculated. The influencing factors of electricity price fluctuation are studied, and the impact of wind power on the profit of traditional generators is analyzed.

articleTitle: Research on the Economic Benefit of Energy Storage System Works with Photovoltaic System Considering the Cost of Electricity
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: The energy storage system (ESS) works with the photovoltaic (PV) system is an important application scenario. This paper studies the economic benefits of ESS operation. Firstly, the calculation method of the electricity cost of the ESS is proposed, and then the optional discharge period of the ESS is determined according to the electricity price structure, further determined the operation strategy of the ESS. Secondly, the three-parameter empirical aging model of lithium battery is proposed, and the battery aging estimation method is obtained by combining the rainflow counting method. Finally, based on the net present value calculation, the economic calculation method of ESS is proposed. The analysis of the example shows the effectiveness of the economic calculation method, and the calculation results have certain reference value.

articleTitle: Calculation and Analysis of Energy Storage Demand in Shanxi Power Grid
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: The application of energy storage is mainly concentrated in several fields, including the access to grid of new energy, ancillary services of peak load regulating and frequency regulation, user side peak cut, demand side response, as well as micro-grid and household energy storage, etc. At present, energy storage is becoming more and more involved in Shanxi market of frequency regulation and flexible grid-connection of new energy, but the relevant intervention mode, incentive mechanism, operation mode and effect evaluation are still in the stage of exploration and demonstration. This article analyses and calculates the energy storage capacity demand in Shanxi power grid from five aspects of power system ACE command response, peak load regulation, frequency regulation, new energy consumption and power control of regional tie line, in order to provide a decision-making reference for the stable, economic and high-quality operation of Shanxi power grid.

Author Keywords: Power control of regional tie line

articleTitle: Predicting the Damage of Distribution System by Strong Wind
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: This paper presents the methodology to predict the strong wind-related damage in the distribution system. For this, weather data and distribution system failure data are collected from the Meteorological Administration and an electric power company in South Korea respectively. Then, these datasets are integrated to analyze a relationship between weather and equipment failures in the distribution system. The prediction model is developed based on a typical regression model using the highly-correlated weather parameters selected by Pearson correlation analysis. Furthermore, two models which called the divided and combined models are developed to enhance an accuracy of prediction based on the natural disaster standard. To verify the algorithm, the results of the developed model are compared with the basic regression model by using the actual data in the strong windy day.

articleTitle: Harmonic and Magnetic Leakage from Wireless Charging System for Electric Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Magnetic-coupled wireless power transfer technology is widely used in wireless charging for electric vehicles (EVs). In this paper, we establish a circuit diagram and a simulation model of WPT charging system for EVs. The magnetic fields from different sights and the E-field strength when the wireless power transmission system is working are simulated and judged by comparing with International Committee on Non-Ionizing Radiation Protection (ICNIRP) guidelines. The current and the voltage of the transmitter coil and receiver coil are given in this paper. Power grid harmonic is also evaluated as the working frequency is offset.

articleTitle: Short-term Daily Load Forecasting in Distribution Power System Based on VMD & BA-LSSVM Combined Method
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Short-term load forecasting is an important basis for optimal control of power distribution network, which directly affects the reliability and economy of power network operation. In this paper, variational mode decomposition (VMD) is used to decompose hourly load sequence of a day to four subsequences with specific frequency scales. The previous 14-day loads are processed with VMD and their results are combined into four matrices. Four matrices and environmental datas which include five factors are normalized and put into four different LSSVMs for the respective forecast. Different parameters in LSSVMs are optimized by bat algorithm (BA). Four LSSVM results are summed and the final prediction result is yielded. Simulation verifies the effectiveness of this method.

articleTitle: Statistical Characterization of Solar Irradiance Variability and Its Effect on Step Voltage Regulators
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: This paper examines the acceptability of two variability metrics, i.e., universal variability index (UVI) and natural variability index (NVI) for quantifying the variation of solar irradiance and PV power output under multiple timescales. Statistical characterization of irradiance ramp rate is investigated using high resolution irradiance measurement data of a PV plant over a considerably long period. The impact of solar irradiance and PV power variability on the tap change operations of step voltage regulators (SVR) is also analyzed. It demonstrates both UVI and NVI can be used as quantitative metrics for irradiance variation. A strong linear relationship is observed between UVI and NVI of irradiance ramp rate. Compared with UVI, NVI is more easily to be implemented due to its direct derivation from the statistical nature of the measured irradiance and PV power output. The results indicate that NVI has the potential to estimate the number of tap change operations of SVR by considering the operational strategies of SVR and proper selection of timescales.

articleTitle: Study on short-term load forecasting method considering meteorological factors of offshore oilfield group microgrid
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Accuracy is an important parameter to measure the performance of load prediction. As the power load of offshore oilfield group microgrid is greatly affected by meteorological factors such as temperature, wind speed and so on, the short-term load prediction results are greatly deviated from the actual load. The influence of meteorological factors is considered in this paper and the exploitation suitability index is put forward to comprehensively quantify meteorological factors. Dragonfly Algorithm-based support vector machine (DA-SVM) algorithm and exploitation suitability index (ESI) are used to predict the short-term load of a certain offshore oilfield group microgrid in Bohai sea. The experimental result shows that the accuracy of the prediction results obtained by using the exploitation suitability index to quantify meteorological factors is improved.

articleTitle: Research on On-line Monitoring Fault Diagnosis System of GIS UHF Partial Discharge
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: The most common fault in GIS is the partial discharge of insulator before the full breakdown. On-line monitoring of uhf partial discharge is an effective means of partial discharge monitoring. The anti-jamming performance of monitoring system at the present time is poor, false positives, non-response rates higher problem. We design a set of uhf partial discharge of intelligent monitoring and fault diagnosis system. In order to improve the accuracy of the test, We need to calibrate sensor. Then the UHF electromagnetic wave radiated by partial discharge of GIS equipment is monitored by sensors, and the monitoring data is transmitted to expert database analysis system in real time by means of Ethernet data transmission. By intelligently identifying the possible partial discharge defects in GIS, the types of defects in GIS can be found in time and major accidents can be avoided.

articleTitle: Real-time Model Predictive Control for The Regional Autonomy Multi-microgrids With Three-Phase/Single-Phase Architecture
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: With the large-scale application of microgrids, the microgrids with three-phase/single-phase architecture, which are geographically relatively close can be interconnected to multi-microgrids systems with multi-phase architecture. For the regional autonomy multi-microgrids which are out of the power distribution network, the paper proposes a real-time control strategy based on Model Predictive Control (MPC). Based on multi-microgrids distributed and hierarchical control architecture, the proposed strategy considers the three-phase unbalance and the minimum deviation between the actual tie line power and the given reference value, which builds a dynamic prediction model with multi-input, multi-disturbance and multi-variable. Then transform it into a mixed integer nonlinear programming and solve it. With the introduction of feedback correction for prediction error correction, it finally realizes rolling finite time closed loop optimization. By the simulation results, the proposed strategy can adjust power of sources, loads and energy storage systems (ESSs) for the regional autonomy multi-microgrids as well as stabilize power fluctuation of sources and loads. Besides, it can keep track of tie line power so as to meet the unbalanced constraints, which is beneficial to the operation of the multi-microgrids that are out of the distribution network.

articleTitle: A Combined ARIMA-PPR Model for Short-Term Load Forecasting
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Accurate short-term load forecasting (STLF) is essential to ensure reliable and efficient operation plan , and improve the utilization of power grid . The purpose of this research is to explore and evaluate the use of a combined ARIMA-PPR model to STLF. By fully analyzing the auto-correlation of load data, we develop an autoregression integrated moving average (ARIMA) model and a projection pursuit regression (PPR) model to capture the linear and nonlinear pattern exhibited in the load series. The combined model is constructed by assigning weight coefficients to individual models, and the weight coefficients are determined by root mean square error (RMSE). The combined model is applied to the 5 min interval load series data of Sichuan Province, China to the task of half-hour ahead forecasting. The combined model outperforms two single models in a variety of performance measures. It achieves more reliable and better prediction results, because it can capture both linear and non-linear modes. . Results show that the combined model is a promising tool for STLF.

articleTitle: Short-term load forecasting based on Elman Neural Network optimized by Firefly Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: The load of power system usually presents a certain range of nonlinear fluctuation with time, but the load characteristics in power system still have certain rules. Therefore, this paper presents a Firefly Algorithm to optimize the short-term load forecasting model of Elman Neural Network, in order to improve the accuracy of load forecasting. Firstly, the nonlinear optimization ability of Firefly Algorithm is utilized to optimize the weights and thresholds of Elman Neural Network, to overcome the shortage of the Elman Neural Network easily plunging into local optimum. Then, make use of the optimized weights and thresholds to enhance the fitting ability of Elman Neural Network. Finally, the simulation results show that the Elman Neural Network optimized by Firefly Algorithm has higher prediction accuracy than the traditional Elman Neural Network.

articleTitle: Virtual Power Plant Optimization Decision Method Considering the Interaction Between Combined Cooling-Heating and Power and Electric Heating Equipment
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: The energy Internet revolution has greatly improved users' flexibility in using energy. The extensive use of electric heating equipment(EHE), combined cooling heating and power(CCHP) and many other equipment enables the flexible conversion of different types of energy at the user side, which has widened the regulation scope for virtual power plant(VPP) in participating in the demand response of large power grid. In this paper, a flexible operation technology framework of VPP considering the interaction between CCHP and EHE is proposed and the operation characteristics of CCHP and EHE are emphatically introduced. Then an optimal decision model for VPP considering the interaction between CCHP and EHE is proposed which could fully satisfy the user's comprehensive energy demand and aims at maximizing the operation efficiency of VPP. Finally, a case study based on the actual data of an industrial park in China is used to prove the validity of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Docker-based Simulation Training System on Dispatching and Control Cloud
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: In order to solve the problems of low resource utilization and complex deployment in traditional dispatcher simulation training system, a Docker-based simulation training system on dispatching and control cloud is proposed in this paper. Based on the achievements in construction of dispatching and control cloud, the architecture, main functions and business process of the system are designed in detail. Based on the analysis of the advantages of Docker technology, Docker image is used to realize on-demand creation, rapid deployment and dynamic recovery of simulation resources. The test results show that the system can achieve multi-user, multi-scene and multimode simulation training, to solve problems in traditional simulation training simulation. Docker technology is obviously superior to virtual machine mode, which can greatly reduce the occupancy of system resources and improve the speed of creation and start-up.

articleTitle: Grid Integration and Demand Response Management of Geothermal Power Plant with Hybrid Energy Storage System in Indonesia
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Geothermal power plant (GPP) is one of clean energy sources, with large potential in Indonesia. The GPPs can supply power to the grid with the load demand changing simultaneously. The energy saving is required when the GPPs are operated under or over the ratings. In this paper, a study on the implementation of Hybrid Energy Storage System in Three-phase AC system (ACHESS) with adaptive PQ controller is proposed to support the operation of the GPPs. The GPP is connected through the ACHESS to the large transmission system. The ACHESS can work in charging mode when the load demand is decreased, or in discharging mode when the load demand is increases. The GPP is maintained to generate constant power as the ACHESS can absorb excess power or supply addition demand. The PQ controller is applied to control the difference of power between generation and load demand. The proposed system is developed in MATLAB/SIMULINK and is validated using real load demand data, recorded in Java-Bali, Indonesia.

articleTitle: Shapley Value based Customers Voluntary Demand Response Program: A Stackelberg Game Approach
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Retailers stimulate customers to curtail their demand during peak pricing in demand response (DR) program. This research exhibits an advanced customers voluntary DR (CVDR) program to help retailers reduce peak demand to defer new facilities construction. In this paper, a Shapley Value (SV) based DR program is proposed to achieve fairness rebates allocation among aggregators. Simultaneously, a Stackelberg game strategy is applied to solve the retailer-customer two layers load dispatch problem. The effects of the SVDR program are studied with IEEE 33-bus distribution network. Numerical results demonstrate that the SVDR program can better enhance customers initiatives, and further reduce retailers’ cost.

articleTitle: Uncertainty Analysis of Wind Power Fluctuations in Yunnan Power Grid
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: The statistical analysis of wind power characteristics is the basic work of wind power integration research, and the statistical analysis method based on actual output data is the most direct and credible method to understand the characteristics of wind power fluctuations. Yunnan (a province in southwestern China) is rich in wind power resources. It is estimated that by 2020, the total installed capacity of wind power in Yunnan will reach 10 million kilowatts. Wind power output is characterized by volatility, randomness and intermittentness. As the penetration of wind power in the power grid is getting higher and higher, it will have an important impact on the stable and economical operation of power system. Based on the actual wind power output data of Yunnan power grid, this paper deeply studies and mines the uncertainty of wind power fluctuations in Yunnan power grid. The research results can provide important reference for power grid planning, scheduling, and wind power integration.

articleTitle: A New Form of User Power Supply System Promoted by Distributed Electric Resources
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: The unreasonable energy consumption structure today seriously threatens the sustainable development of human society and the natural living environment. How to make full use of wind or solar power generation and improve the efficiency of electricity utilization is an important topic in the field of electric energy in the future. With the development of power electronics and the large-scale utilization of distributed generation, the user power supply system presents the characteristics of multi-source co-operation and the development trend of power-electronized power supply equipment, direct current distribution of power grid and micro-grid formed power supply system. In this paper, the development direction and characteristics of user power supply system was analyzed, and the configuration of LVDC distribution system and the topological structure of AC/DC converter were discussed. Finally, it is pointed out that the future form of user power supply system will be a micro-grid group cored with a multi-source multi-port smart distribution terminal (MSMP-SDT), and the key technologies of the multi-source high-efficiency power supply system was also presented.

articleTitle: Positive Sequence Modeling of AC Drive Systems with Power Interruption Ride-Through Capability in DigSILENT
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: The paper draws attention towards the significance of positive sequence modeling of AC drive systems for creating the dynamic load model of industrial facilities or for determining the transient stability of the industrial network. The DigSILENT power factory has prebuilt features for positive sequence modeling which are utilized while building and testing the control of AC drives. The power interruption ride-through control has been developed for such a model which prevents the tripping of the AC drives by regulating the DC link voltage at a safe level by utilizing the stored kinetic energy of rotating mass. The simulation results show that such a mechanism helps to ride-through even 1-second power interruption. Finally, the amount of investment saved is estimated while adopting this mechanism over the capacity extension of energy storage for 1-second power interruption ride-through.

articleTitle: Transient Stability Analysis of AC/DC System Considering Electromagnetic Transient Model
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Power electronic dominated power system has brought difficulties to the research of transient stability analysis. With the great progress in time-domain simulation technology, electromagnetic transients on power system can be calculated. There's still a lack of ability to assess the transient stability margin considering electromagnetic transient model. This article builds a framework to quantitively analyze the transient stability of AC/DC system based on the EEAC theory. Electromechanical-electromagnetic transient hybrid simulation and trajectory stability assessment are combined in this framework. Some key technologies such as trajectory aggregation and parameter calculation are also discussed. Besides, the sensitivity analysis is used to find the critical clearing time in hybrid system. Case studies in test system demonstrate the validity of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Analysis of Aggregated Wind Power Dependence Based on Optimal Vine Copula
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Along with the rapid development of wind energy, a number of wind farms aggregate in the same region. It is necessary to consider the wind power dependence when analyzing aggregated wind farms. Aiming to the dependence of wind power, Copula function, which avoids the difficulty of constructing joint distribution function, is utilized for modeling dependence. Multivariate Copula functions, including Student t Copula, Gauss Copula and Archimedean Copula, is frequently used. However, traditional multivariate Copula functions assume that each pair of variables' correlation structures are the same, which is practically impossible, thus having limitation on precise and flexibility. Therefore, this paper adopts Vine-Copula to portray wind power dependence. Moreover, an optimal algorithm of choosing Vine is proposed. The modeling scheme is based on a decomposition of multivariate density into a cascade of pair copula, applied on original variables and on their conditional distribution functions.
