The case study uses several actual wind farms' operation data in Ningxia province of China for constructing both Vine-Copula and traditional multivariate Copula models. The result shows that the optimal Vine-copula that uses different Copula functions as building blocks can characterize the dependence of wind power more precisely and flexibly. At last, the proposed method is tested in the probabilistic load flow of an IEEE 118-bus system. The result shows the superiority of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Research on Meteorological Sensitive Load in Jiangsu based on Meteorological Dominant Factors
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: The highest load in Jiangsu generally occurs in the summer. In 2018, the highest load in Jiangsu has reached 106 million kilowatts. The meteorological sensitive load has an important contribution to the highest load. Based on the actual data of Jiangsu Province, this paper analyzes the meteorological conditions of Jiangsu summer in 2015-2018 by determining the method of comprehensive meteorological indicators, and determines the meteorological routine year for 2015 and 2018, and the meteorological high temperature year for 2016 and 2017. Based on the correlation principle, the correlation between meteorological sensitive load and dominant meteorological indicators is deeply carried out, and the fitting value and sensitivity of meteorological sensitive load corresponding to each unit meteorological indicator are quantified. Through in-depth study and analysis of historical meteorological load data, this paper provides an important basis for accurate load forecasting in the later stage.

articleTitle: Weaknesses Identification Using Reliability Tracking in Distribution System with Distribution Generation
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: There are many components in the distribution system and each component has different influences on system reliability. High density distribution generation is integrated into the county power grid, which has a significant impact on the system reliability as well. In order to identify the components causing the system unreliable, a method for identifying weaknesses of the county power grid based on reliability tracking is proposed. Firstly, the reliability tracking criterions are proposed, then the probability and frequency allocation of the system failure event model based on the criterions are designed. Finally, an example is presented in the final part of this paper to illustrate influences of adding distribution generation to the distribution system, and show the results of system weaknesses identification, and indicate the influence of distribution generation capacity on system weaknesses.

articleTitle: Generation Scheduling Optimization of Wind-Storage Combined Generation System Based on Combined Empirical Mode Decomposition (CEMD)
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Incorporating Energy Storage System (ESS) with wind farm to establish Wind-Storage Combined Generation System is a promising solution to improve the dependability of integrated wind power. Reliable system generation scheduling optimization is the key point to improve the economy and efficiency of system integration. In this paper, based on Empirical Mode Decomposition (EMD), the fluctuation feature of real-time wind power output is studied to propose a Hybrid Energy Storage System (HESS) model aiming to obtain the economic capacity as well as maximum charging/discharging power in every generation scheduling circle (10min). Besides, the algorithm of Combined EMD (CEMD) is proposed to minimize the deviation between generation scheduling plan and actual integrated power of Combined Generation System. The optimization results of case study shows that the proposed CEMD performs well for generation scheduling optimization, and the sizing method can reduce invest cost.

articleTitle: Multi-Period Stochastic Economic Dispatch of Microgrid Considering Renewable Energy Uncertainty Using Parallel Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: In recent years, microgirds (MGs) have gained sustained attractions among the researches. The economic dispatch is one of the most important topics of the MGs. For the fast real-time dispatch, the number of time periods may become larger and the computational complexity will rapidly increase. To handle this issue, a parallel algorithm for the multi-period economic dispatch of the MGs is proposed in this paper, which can decompose the original problem into several small-scale sub-problems that can be efficiently solved in parallel. Moreover, the model is designed in a stochastic scheme to handle the uncertainty of renewable energy sources (RES) output. Case studies verify the effectiveness of the proposed parallel algorithm.

articleTitle: An new method of PV generation fluctuation suppression for cascade hydro-pv-pumped storage generation system
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: In order to reduce the PV power fluctuation caused by meteorological changes, a PV power fluctuation suppression method for cascade hydro-pv-pumped storage generation system is presented in this paper. A multi-factor weighting factor suppression method is proposed based on considering short-term PV forecasting cumulative fluctuation error and pumped storage system state. The short-term target power determination function is established to obtain the short-term output target power of the PV power station, and then the power instructions of the FSC (Full Size Converter) pumped storage power station and cascade hydro station are calculated to compensate the PV power fluctuations. The FSC pumped storage system was used to suppress the PV power fluctuation initially, and the cascade hydro station was used to further suppress the PV power fluctuation. The simulation results show that the algorithm is simple and can effectively suppress the fluctuation of PV power.

Author Keywords: Cascade hydro-pv- pumped storage generation system

articleTitle: Optimal Allocation Method of Dynamic Reactive Power Compensation to Suppress Simultaneous Commutation Failure of Multiple DC Lines
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: After the AC side short-circuits fault occurs in the multi-infeed HVDC system, the voltage of the AC system keeps decreasing, which leads to the commutation failure of many or even all DC lines, which severely damages the security and stability of the power grid. In order to restrain DC commutation failure, a dynamic reactive power compensation device configuration method is proposed to restrain the risk of multiple DC commutation failures simultaneously. The type, installation location, and capacity of reactive power devices are optimized. Based on the duration of DC commutation failure and considering the interaction between DC and DC, the index of reducing the risk of commutation failure is proposed. According to the electrical distance, the weak area is determined, and then the optimal compensation location of dynamic reactive power is selected by the sensitivity index. A reactive power allocation optimization model is established to solve the optimal reactive power allocation scheme. The simulation results of a large power grid show that the optimal solution can effectively reduce the multi-DC commutation failures caused by AC faults while taking into account the economy.

articleTitle: Impact of the UHVDC on Performance Characteristics of Power Grid
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: In order to research the performance characteristics of power grid with putting into operation of ±800kV UHVDC power transmission project, based on higher load in winter of 2020 of an example power grid, the impact on stability of the power grid with UHVDC accessing under typical faults in AC system is analyzed, the influence on the power grid under the UHVDC bipolar blocking and restarting after DC fault is also researched. Simulation results show that during typical faults in AC system, the power grid can operate stately; if UHVDC bipolar blocking, the frequency stability and rotor-angle stability of the power grid can still be maintained, the AC bus of the example power grid also suffers from an over-voltage problem, and the example power grid can restart smoothly after the fault of the DC line.

articleTitle: Day-Ahead Reactive Power Optimization Model for Active Distribution Network based on Various Active Management Measurements
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: For Active Distribution Network (ADN), the original multi-period reactive power optimization model is no longer appropriate. This paper firstly gives the description of the active distribution system and the second-order cone power flow model of the active distribution network. Then minimizing the daily energy loss is considered as the objective function, and a multi-period mixed integer second-order cone programming for active distribution network is established by second-order cone relaxation and model linearization technology to achieve an efficient and accurate solution of the model. The correctness and effectiveness of the proposed optimization model have been evidenced in the modified IEEE 33 bus test case.

articleTitle: Stability Analysis and Compensator Design for PV Generators Based on Describing Function Method
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Stability issues caused by photovoltaic generators has drawn more and more attention. With the consideration of nonlinear elements in power control algorithm, the stability of PV system is analyzed through describing function method. As a result, the analysis conclusion is more accurate and the specific compensator is designed to avoid low-frequency oscillation. The veracity of theoretical analyses and the effectiveness of the compensator are demonstrated by simulation results.

articleTitle: Research on Power Supply Recovery Scheme Based on Distributed Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Feeder Automation (FA) system is becoming more and more mature on fault location and isolation, but it is slightly insufficient in power supply recovery. A power supply recovery scheme that can be used for distribution network with multi-connection and multi-branch is proposed in order to further improve the power recovery capability of distributed FA system and solve the tricky problem of power supply recovery due to different location of the fault point. The proxy terminal completes the power recovery work in the non-fault area by closing single contact switch, single inter-connection switch with load cutting on the basis of load evaluation system and topology model for the waiting recovery area, which realizes the recovery of power supply in the non-fault area. The control strategy and algorithm are verified by Real-Time Digital Simulator (RTDS).

articleTitle: Time Difference Method to Calculate the Optimal Differential Point of Half-wavelength AC Transmission Line Differential Protection
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Capacitive current compensation method of traditional differential protection can't be used on half-wavelength line, so the current after compensation capacitor can't obtain, and a new method of differential protection must be proposed. With distributed parameter model the current of both sides of any point on line can be calculated by the voltage and current of both ends of line, and the current constitutes a new differential protection, in the meantime the influence of the capacitive current is eliminated. The point is defined the differential point. When the differential point is closer to the fault point, the sensitivity and safety of the differential protection is higher, so the fault point is defined the optimal differential point. Based on the space-time characteristics of half-wavelength line, this paper proposed the time difference method to calculate the optimal differential point. The simulation system of half-wavelength AC transmission line was established on RTDS, and the time difference method and the differential protection based on the optimal differential point was simulated and verified.

articleTitle: The Research of Sub-Synchronous Oscillation in DFIG Wind Farm under Weak AC Grid
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: With the large-sale wind farms connected to the power grid , the problem of sub-synchronous oscillation caused by wind farms has become more and more serious. Previous studies have shown that wind farms are prone to occur sub-synchronous oscillation when DFIG connected to power system by series compensation capacitor and PMSG through weak AC network ,and the theory of SSO in above two cases is relatively clear and has been researched mostly. Since most DFIG wind farms in China are connected to the power system through weak AC grids, there is still a risk of subsynchronous oscillations without series compensation capacitors. This paper established a transfer function model of DFIG wind farm in weak AC power network, analysed the interaction mechanism between DFIG and weak AC system in detail, The influence on its characteristics from many factors was also analyzed. Finally, the correctness of above conclusions was verified by time domain simulation.

articleTitle: Reliability Assessment of Standalone Wind-Based Energy Storage System Using Monte Carlo Simulation
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Wind energy is one of the fastest-growing resources in the world. The increase integration of wind can potentially mitigate global warming by reducing the emissions of greenhouse gases. However, the power generated from wind turbines is always fluctuating due to the intermittent nature of the wind. The most effective powerful tool to suppress these fluctuations is by utilizing energy storage systems. Hence, assessing the impact of wind energy and energy storage on the reliability of local loads is an important issue. In this paper, the impact of wind capacity and energy storage on the reliability of local load of the Roy Billinton Test System (RBTS) is studied in the stand-alone operational mode. The performance of the system states and simulation results were performed using Monte Carlo simulations (MCS) and considering the uncertainty of the wind energy.

articleTitle: Modeling and Analysis of VSC-MTDC Transmission Systems
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: A small-signal model of voltage source converter based multi-terminal direct current (VSC-MTDC) systems is presented based on modular modeling for avoiding deducing the elements of the matrixes. The entire system is divided into three subsystems: AC system, VSC and DC system, where VSC is composed of AC electrical module, DC electrical module, and controller. The nonlinear state-space model and link equations of each subsystem are deduced based on equivalent circuit. The small-signal model for the whole system is automatically produced via the linearized state-space model and link equations, Finally, combined with the new energy generation in Gansu province, the small-signal model is validated via the comparison of the step response of the electromagnetic model based on a four-terminal system. The impact of converter control parameters on system stability under different control modes is analyzed via eigenvalues.

Author Keywords: voltage source converter based multi-terminal direct current

articleTitle: Virtual Power Plant Model for the Cluster of Household Prosumers Based on Minkowski Sum
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: With the great integration of distributed generation and practical control strategies as demand response, household prosumers are willing to take part in the day-ahead dispatch of distribution network. However, managing enormous amount of household prosumers with individually low controllable power becomes a huge challenge to the distribution system operator. In this paper, we propose a virtual power plant model for aggregating household prosumers into a simplified dispatch-able model. The feasible region for aggregated power of the household prosumers is contracted to a pyramid by means of Minkowski Sum, which represents an operational region for a power plant, and this model is then uploaded to distribution system operator. By using the aggregated model, distribution system operator no longer need to communicate with each household prosumer and to process a lot of individual constraints, but only use the virtual power plant model in day-ahead dispatch optimization. We take heat pump, electric vehicle, energy storage and photovoltaic into consideration and simulations show the effectiveness of the proposed model.

articleTitle: Restoration of a Meshed HVDC Grid with Non-selective Protection Strategy
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: VSC-HVDC grid can be grouped into two different topologies named radial and meshed. The meshed grid is more flexible, reliable and secure because there are more power flow paths between two or more converters, thus it becomes one of the most potential solutions for the Europe Supergrid. However, the restoration of such a system is still a challenging issue. In this paper, an automatic restoration strategy is presented to recover the grid after a contingency. Compared with other restoration strategies, this strategy has two advantages. First, it has a strong ability to automatically recover the grid system in a shorter time. Second, it realizes the coordination of restoration and grid control strategy thus over or under voltage caused by power imbalance during restoration period is avoided. The effectiveness of the proposed strategy is tested in the PSCAD/EMTDC for a pole to pole fault.

articleTitle: Look-Ahead Strategic Offering for a Virtual Power Plant: A Multi-Stage Stochastic Programming Approach
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: The increasing number of distributed energy resources on the distribution side has promoted the development of virtual power plants to become active market participants. Considering the uncertainty in the market price and the wind generation in a virtual power plant (VPP) in the real-time operation, this paper proposes a look-ahead real-time offering strategy using a multistage stochastic programming formulation within each look-ahead horizon. We test the proposed model on a small virtual power plant. The supply offer curve and the demand offer curve for different market price cases are determined, and the operating states for the VPP system and its components under different scenarios are also obtained. Using the proposed look-ahead approach, the VPP can determine the rolling offer curves continuously to participate in the real-time electricity market.

articleTitle: Design and Research on Electricity Market Operation System in Southern Region
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: With the rapid development of electricity market, it is badly need that build Electricity Market Operation (EMOS). This paper describes the design and research on Electricity Market Operation (EMOS) in southern region. This paper introduces the electricity market model and its influence, which tells us that electricity market construction should be combined with China's reality. The remainder of this paper will provide the overall framework of the EMOS, of which the key techniques, such as rule bank and algorithms library, data management, statistical analysis, disaster preparedness and protection, and simulation system. EMOS is composed of six modules and introduces the main function of the six modules.

articleTitle: A novel solar irradiance forecast model using complex network analysis and classification modeling
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: The output power of solar photovoltaic (PV) plant is mainly determined by the received solar irradiance of the solar PV panels. Therefore, for step wise PV power forecast methods, the accuracy of solar irradiance forecast is very important. However, the diversity of irradiance fluctuation patterns brings great challenges to PV power predictions and limits the application of existing forecast models. In this paper, a novel solar irradiance forecast model of ultra-short-term time scale is proposed, which using complex network analysis to identify the irradiance and classification modeling to realize classified forecast of irradiance. Firstly, 4 irradiance fluctuation patterns are defined according to the local historical irradiance data, then 4 BP neural networks (BPNN) are built and trained respectively using these data of different fluctuation patterns. Secondly, each four-hour irradiance series is transformed into complex network based on weighted horizontal visibility algorithm (WHVG), then three complex network features are extracted to analysis not only the time series characteristics but also the network topology of irradiance data sequence. Thirdly, the support vector machine (SVM) is used to identify the irradiance fluctuation pattern with complex network features, and the corresponding BPNN is applied to forecast the future irradiance. The accuracy of irradiance pattern identification and the subsequent classified ultra-short-term irradiance forecast are verified by simulation with two-years actual irradiance data in Mississippi, US.

articleTitle: Research on Lean Management of Power Marketing Strategy in Power Grid Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: The core of lean management is to eliminate all invalid labor and waste. It sets the target on perfection and ensures the advantage of the enterprise in market competition by constantly reducing cost, improving quality and enhancing management flexibility. At the same time, lean management delegated responsibility to all levels of the organizational structure, eliminating defects and waste at every job in a timely manner. Rapid construction and vigorously promoting social and economic development have put forward higher requirements for power supply. Power companies must intensify efforts to control and change management mode, and fully realize the sustainable development of power system. Marketing is the core business of power supply companies, which is important for enterprises to obtain economic and social benefits. However, limited by the market and their own management level, power marketing has many problems. Power enterprises need to adopt lean management to control power marketing management, which not only improves the economic and social benefits of power enterprises, but also further improves the service and management level of power enterprises.

articleTitle: Short-term Voltage Stability Mechanism Analysis Based on a Double-generator-one-load Model
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: This paper presents the mechanism analysis of short-term voltage stability based on a double-generator-one-load model. A double-generator-one-load (DGOL) model of power system is introduced. Compared with other existing simplified model, the DGOL model not only includes the dynamic of motor, but also takes the interactions of generators into consideration. Then, this paper analyses the mechanism of voltage stability based on DGOL model, and proposes a quantitative index (RAV ratio) to evaluate the influence of rotor angle variation on short-term voltage stability. At last, the simulation work is introduced to illustrate the advantage of the proposed simplified model and analysis method.

articleTitle: Global Voltage Sensitivity Calculation for power system including transmission and distribution networks
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: The development of smart distribution networks has become more flexible and changeable, making the interaction between transmission and distribution networks increasingly significant. When we list the inequality constraints of the whole-network voltage control model, we should consider the influence of voltage regulation in the transmission (distribution) network on the state variables of whole networks including transmission and distribution network, so it requires the sensitivity of the whole-network voltage/voltage-regulation controlled quantities. Generator regulates voltage in the transmission network and switching capacitors to regulate voltage in the distribution network are both common methods to regulate voltage. Using the idea of master slave splitting, the transmission network can exchange information with the distribution network, and sensitivity of whole networks voltage/controlled quantities of these two voltage regulation methods can be calculated. The result of simulation proves that the method proposed in this paper is accurate.

articleTitle: Parameter Optimization Method of MMC Controls Based on Firefly Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: A parameter optimization method of MMC(Modular Multilevel Converter) controls based on firefly algorithm is proposed in this paper. First, a simplified small signal mathematical model which contains primary structure of MMC HVDC system, control loops and measurements is built. Then an objective function is set to optimize active and reactive power response of converters while considering DC voltage at the same time. An optimization method based on firefly algorithm is designed for the model. Finally a case study of MMC HVDC shows, active and reactive power response of converters at both ends are improved by control parameters optimization.

articleTitle: Distribution Network Topology Model Generation Method for Distributed Feeder Automation
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Distributed feeder automation system can deal with the fault based on topology model included in intelligent distribution terminal without relying on the master station. The difference is found out between the whole network topology model of the master station and the local topology model of the intelligent distribution terminal by analyzing topology for adapting to distributed feeder automation system in intelligent distribution terminals, and comparing international standards that are used to modeling such as IEC 61968, IEC 61970, and IEC 61850. The local topology model of intelligent power distribution terminal and a system-wide topology model of master station are established by combining the local topology requirements of distributed FA system. The self-maintenance of local topology model is implemented through model transformation.

articleTitle: Graph Computing based Fast Screening in Contingency Analysis
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: During last decades, contingency analysis has been facing challenges from significant load demand increase and high penetrations of intermittent renewable energy, fluctuant responsive loads and non-linear power electronic interfaces. It requires an advanced approach for high-performance contingency analysis as a safeguard of the power system operation. In this paper, a graph-based method is employed for "N-1" contingency analysis (CA) fast screening. At first, bidirectional breadth-first search (BFS) is proposed and adopted on graph model to detect the potential shedding component in contingency analysis. It implements hierarchical parallelism of the graph traverse and speedup its process. Then, the idea of evolving graph is introduced in this paper to improve computation performance. For each contingency scenario, "N-1" contingency graph quickly derives from system graph in basic status, and parallelly analyzes each contingency scenario using graph computing. The efficiency and effectiveness of the proposed approach have been tested and verified by IEEE 118-bus system and a practical case SC 2645-bus system.

articleTitle: Wind power prediction based on the chaos theory and the GABP neural network
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: The wind power prediction plays an important role in the steady run of the power system after the wind power grid. Because of the large amount of data used in the prediction process and the large number of data dimensions, the traditional prediction methods are prone to fall into local convergence and affect the accuracy of prediction. In this paper, a prediction method based on chaos theory and GABP neural network is designed. Firstly, the evolution trajectory of wind power time series in high dimensional space is recovered by phase space reconstruction. Then genetic algorithm is applied to optimize BP neural network (GABP), to make up for the randomness of BP neural network in the choice value and threshold value. Then the trajectory recovered by GABP neural network training is applied to predict the evolution trajectory in the future. Finally, taking wind farm data as an example, the results show that the proposed algorithm improves the prediction accuracy of ultra-short-term prediction.

articleTitle: Division of working variable domain fuzzy PID control for valley electric phase change heat storage
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Aiming at the valley electric phase change heat storage and heating system, there are two different working conditions: using valley electric heating for heat storage, at the same time the furnace is used for heating, and the non-valley electric period is only for heating. The parameters of the system vary greatly under different working conditions. The variable-domain fuZZY PID controller with different working conditions was designed. The domain expansion factor of fuzzy PID controller under different working conditions is adaptively adjusted. The experimental results show that the proposed control method can realize the real-time tracking of the expected heating temperature under different working conditions, significantly reduce the temperature error of the heating effluent and improve the heating reliability.

articleTitle: Analysis of Influence Factors on the Transmission Capability of the Yu-e Back-to-back VSC-HVDC South Channel
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Yu-e back-to-back VSC-HVDC networking project is the first VSC-HVDC networking project whose voltage and capacity is up to±420kV and 5000MW. Currently, it is the VSC-HVDC project of highest voltage and largest capacity in the world which realizes the asynchronous networking between Southwest and Central China power grid and guarantees the safety of hydropower delivery between these two power grids. However, it may cause the units of Enshi and Three Georges power plant unstable when power is transmitted from Southwest power grid to Central China power grid through Yu-E back to back VSC-HVDC project. In view of the problems above, this paper studies the influence of the nearby Yihua HVDC transmission power, the up-delivery power of 500kV Enshi main transformer and output of the adjacent hydropower plant on transmission capability of Yu-E back-to-back VSC-HVDC system.

articleTitle: Predictive Control of Regional Flexible Load Cluster Based on Mixed Logical Dynamic Method
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Uncertainty of renewable energy sources (RES) has brought about complexity in distribution network operation scheduling and rescheduling. In this paper, flexible load cluster composed of regional customers’ controllable electrical and thermal load is considered to deal with regional RES power fluctuation. Firstly, mixed logical dynamic (MLD) models of electric vehicles (EV), water heater (EWH) and inverter air-conditioner (IAC) are established to present accurate dynamic characteristics. According to MLD models, day-ahead optimal scheduling model and rolling optimization model of flexible load cluster are studied via model predictive control (MPC) method. Finally, the methodology is employed to a regional flexible load cluster including 100 residents, the result shows that the proposed models enables flexible loads in cluster to follow the most economical operation schedule, and to adaptively adjust power demand as well to compensate power fluctuation of RES without affecting residents’ comfort.

articleTitle: Switched Capacitor Based Multilevel Boost Inverter for Smart Grid Applications
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Inverters are power electronic converters essential for linking sources of DC power to the AC grid. Conventional inverters often use transformers and harmonic filters which are bulky, expensive and lossy. Multilevel inverters are a viable alternative to classical inverters, offering reduced THD, inductor-less design and increased range of control. They produce a stepped waveform, with close resemblance to a sine wave. Smart grids may have several distributed sources and when these sources have minimal THD, there is a reduced stress for filtering them at the point of common coupling. In this paper, a switched capacitor based multilevel inverter offering boost capability and low THD is proposed. The inverter has inherent charge balancing capability, removing the need for voltage sensors and auxiliary circuits. The switches in the inverter are modulated using PODPWM technique, which facilitates voltage balancing and reduced switching losses. The design is validated by simulation and the output waveforms and parameters are presented.

articleTitle: Different Impacts of Positive Error and Negative Error of Wind Power Forecasting on Power System Economical Operation
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Positive error and negative error of wind power forecasting have different impacts on power system reliability and efficiency that should be treated individually. However, current error evaluation indexes are all from the viewpoint of average and absolute value of forecast errors that cannot reflect the impacts of different error symbols. Based on the definition of positive error and negative error of wind power forecasting, the different impacts of those two error indexes on power system economical operation are analyzed in detail in this paper. Also, the calculation method of different impacts of wind power forecasting positive error and negative error on power system is proposed and proved by an experimental example.

articleTitle: Sensitivity Vectors and Contingency Ranking using Linearised AC Load Flow
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: In this paper, sensitivity vector using linearised AC load flow are proposed. Change in bus voltages and line flows in the event of a line outage are found from this sensitivity vector. After evaluating post contingency flows using this vector, performance indices are used to rank contingencies. Conventional sensitivity vectors like line outage distribution factors (LODF) and power transfer distribution factors (PTDF) are usually evaluated using DC load flow. Hence, evaluation of voltage limits in the event of a contingency is not possible. AC load flow can be used to calculate the change in both voltage and active flow but it is time consuming. Hence sensitivity vectors using linearised ac load flow have been derived. These sensitivity vectors are used to find change in voltages and voltage angles in the event of a contingency. Post contingency active flows and voltages obtained from these vectors are then used to evaluate performance indices and contingencies are ranked. Simulations on the IEEE 14 bus system show that the results obtained using the proposed method are comparable to the results obtained using AC load flow.

articleTitle: Optimal Active Power Control of AGC Considering High-Penetration EVs
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: The paper considers the massive plug-in electric vehicles (EVs) connected to the grid to participate in automatic generation control (AGC), and establishes the real-time adjustable capacity evaluation model of the EV by satisfying the charging demand of the owners. On this basis, a multi-layer model of optimal active power control (OAPC) of AGC is presented for a coordinated regulation between a cluster of EVs and conventional hydro and thermal units. Case studies are carried out to evaluate the performance of active power control of AGC on a practical regional power grid in southern China.

articleTitle: Construction of Dispatching, Maintenance and Reconditions Under Provincial-Municipal Integration System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: It is crucial of construction of dispatching, maintenance and reconditions system in province and city two level information for guaranteeing information system running safely in State Grid Sichuan Electric Power Company (SGSEPC). This paper proposed the construction background and status quo of Provincial-municipal Integration (PMI) system of State Grid Sichuan Information & Communication Company (SGSICC). The dispatching monitoring mode by the company through the PMI is analyzed. Combined with the construction achievements of four aspects, the construction of the dispatching, maintenance and reconditions with information system of SGSICC under PMI is expounded. The dispatching, maintenance and reconditions systems based on PMI and the operation of PMI have opened up the provincial and local dispatching command channels, realizing the whole process of standard operation and maintenance management.

articleTitle: Fault Section identification method for Multi-terminal Hybrid HVDC Lines
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: For multi-terminal hybrid HVDC transmission system, the identification of DC line fault section is of great significance to isolate the fault. This paper analyses the current polarity characteristics of faults located on different fault section of DC lines based on equivalent line model firstly. Then, aiming at the characteristic drawn from the analysis, which medium and low frequency current energy will be reduced by T zone, a fault section identification method based on high frequency transient current polarity by wavelet transform is proposed. Finally, simulations in PSCAD/EMTDC verify the effectiveness and sensitivity of proposed fault section identification method.

articleTitle: Inertial Response of Doubly-fed Induction Generator with the Phase-locked Loop
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: With the development of wind power, the problem of system inertia and frequency dynamic deterioration caused by large-scale wind power integration is becoming more serious. The inertial response of wind turbines is worthy of attention and research. In this paper, the quantitative calculation method of the equivalent virtual inertia time constant H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">eqDFIG</sub> of the doubly-fed induction generator (DFIG) with the phase-locked loop (PLL) is studied, and the influence of the PLL on the inertial response of DFIG is analyzed. Firstly, a simplified model of DFIG with the PLL is established. By calculating the electromagnetic torque increment, the equivalent virtual inertia time constant H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">eqDFIG</sub> of the DFIG considering the dynamic characteristics of the PLL is obtained. And the influence of the PLL parameter variation on the virtual inertial response of the system is analyzed. Simulation verification proves the correctness of the conclusion.

articleTitle: Research on the Influence of Demand Response on the Life of Distribution Network Transformer
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: The traditional distribution network has gradually been replaced by the active distribution network (ADN) with active control and management methods. In the previous studies on ADN, the influence of demand response (DR) on the operation status of power equipment was rarely considered. This paper studies the influence of DR on transformer life. Firstly, based on the IEEE-33 nodes example, the load curve of the ADN transformer node is established, and the load is subdivided into two types: rigid load and flexible load. Then, the active distribution network regulation model of flexible load and adjustable load is established in order to simulate the adjustment effect of DR on the load curve. Finally, the thermal aging model and the percentage of loss of life (LOL%) are used to calculate the life loss of the transformer before and after DR. The validity and practicability of the method are verified by a case study.

articleTitle: Typical Voltage Quality Optimization Strategy for Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Through the analysis of voltage fluctuations, low voltage problems and over voltage problems in the distribution network, the causes of voltage quality problems are found out, and specific optimization strategies are proposed. The genetic algorithm was improved and then tested at the improved IEEE33 node and IEEE69 node. The weighting of the active loss and the voltage deviation is used as the objective function to improve the overall voltage quality while minimizing the total active power loss.

articleTitle: A General Extended Theory of Interline DC Power Flow Controller
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Interline DC power flow controller can be applied to power flow control in multi-line DC grid with good application prospect. A general extended theory of interline DC power flow controller has been proposed in this paper. N-line interline DC power flow controller can control (N-1)-line power flow actively. Extended theory including topology, working operation and control strategy are detailed. Simulation results of 3-line IDCPFC proved multi-line power flow ability of proposed extended theory.

articleTitle: A Novel Strategy for Wind-Solar-Hydro Complimentary Real-time Scheduling and Control
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: This paper proposes a novel wind-solar-hydro complimentary real-time scheduling and control framework in which the power system operation constraints, renewable energy prediction accuracy and response features, electricity spot, medium-term and long-term transaction are simultaneously considered. With increasing number of renewable energy sources penetrated power systems, available transfer capability of transmission channels approaches to zero. Prediction precision index, operation performance index and transaction execution rate are applied to the objective function for guaranteeing the feasibility and equality between all wind, solar and hydro power plants. The proposed real-time scheduling framework enables power system operators to allocate generation with security, fairness, in the meantime, to maintain a high share of renewables penetration. Wind-solar-hydro power coordination control system framework with data flow is provided and the proposed approach for wind-solar-hydro complimentary real-time scheduling and control is tested in a modified IEEE 9-bus 3-machine Benchmark Network.

articleTitle: Security Evaluation under N-1 for Active Distribution Networks Coordinated with Transmission Grid
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: With the rapid development of smart grid technology, the distribution networks become more active, and the coordination between transmission and distribution grids becomes more significant. To achieve an accurate analysis for distribution grids considering the impact of transmission grids, this paper presents a practical security evaluation process under N-1 for active distribution networks (ADNs) coordinated with transmission grids. A linearized ADNs load restoration model is given to calculate the restored load after N-1. In order to consider the coordinated operation of transmission and distribution networks, the distributed global power flow (GPF) based on the master-slave-splitting method is used to calculate the power flow. The index for security evaluation of ADNs is established in power-lost load and voltage deviation aspects. The proposed evaluation process was tested in an integrated transmission and distribution test system. Results of numerical simulation showed the rationality of load restoration model and the validity of the proposed evaluation method.

articleTitle: Research on the Model of CVT Operation Performance Based on the PHM System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: This paper researches on the operation performance of capacitive voltage transformer(CVT) in the operation of the network. Firstly, the structural principle and application technology of PHM system are expounded. Then the fuzzy comprehensive evaluation model is introduced. Combined with the CVT operating characteristic parameters monitored by the CVT online monitoring device, the CVT operating performance model based on PHM system is proposed. Finally, the CVT of 220kV Shuping Station in Zigong City is taken as an example for analysis. Through the analysis of the field experimental data, the correctness and practical engineering feasibility of the model are proved.

articleTitle: Research on Pricing Segmentation Method of Electric Vehicle Charging Service Fee
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: This paper studies the current status and price mechanism of electric vehicle charging service fee, proposes a segmentation service pricing mechanism, and a pricing method of electric vehicle charging service fee in regular period based on AP clustering algorithm, and simulates the algorithm of the division period. The clustering performance index, the AP clustering method and the performance index analysis of the k-means algorithm under the given K value are used to verify the segmentation rationality and select the optimal clustering value to determine the specific time period scheme. Through the genetic algorithm this paper develops the segment service fee price strategy, and through the analysis of the service fee case in different time periods, this paper compares the pre- and post-partition load curve comparison, and establishes the segment service fee price, which guides the user to charge at off-peak period, and can alleviate the peak-valley pressure of charging load and improve the utilization rate of charging facilities, thereby improving the comprehensive income and market competitiveness of operators. This method provides a reference for the flexible pricing of service fees for operators of electric vehicle charging stations.

articleTitle: Frequency Control Strategy of Grid-connected PV System Using Virtual Synchronous Generator
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Photovoltaic (PV) power generation has broad prospects as one of the renewable generations, and its penetration in the power grid keeps increasing. However, PV system does not have the advantages of large inertia and output impedance as synchronous generators, and cannot realize active frequency regulation in real time. Some scholars have proposed a droop control algorithm based on the self-droop characteristics of synchronous generators, which makes the PV system have the primary frequency regulation capability, but it still lacks inertia and damping links in the control process. To solve this problem, in this paper, a frequency control strategy for PV system using virtual synchronous generator (VSG) control is proposed. Based on droop control, the swing equation is added to improve the dynamic characteristics of PV system during frequency control. Simulation results verified that the proposed algorithm can achieve the same primary frequency regulation capability as the droop control, and also effectively improve the dynamic characteristics of frequency change.

articleTitle: A Value-of-Service based Model for Resilient Distribution System Restoration with Microgrids
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Large-scale blackouts and extreme weather events in recent years have drawn increasing concerns for improving the resilience of electric power systems. Distribution networks contributes majority of customer-outage minutes among utility infrastructure sectors. Following the faults location and isolation, distribution system restoration (DSR) is invoked to restore the out-of-service load as soon as possible. The increasing penetration of controllable devices, such as distributed generators, microgrids, and automatic switches, leverage the resilience of distribution system by involving the connected distributed energy resources (DERs) in the DSR. However, due to the limited power resources during restoration and repair process, the choice of load priorities still needs to be made. To mitigate the aforementioned challenges, in this paper we introduce a novel value-of-service (VOS) based model for DSR with microgrid. The model is formulated as a MILP model, and the effectiveness is validated via the IEEE 123 node test feeder.

articleTitle: Multi-objective Optimal Strategy for the Coordination Control between Distributed Energy Storage System and Flexible Load
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Considering the time-space relationship between energy storage and flexible load together with the influence of network power flow, an optimal operation model of active distribution network is established, with the but of maximizing renewable energy utilization, minimizing network loss and maximizing user satisfaction. At the same time, the coordination among the units of active distribution network is quantified by setting the scheduling priorities of controllable distributed generation units, energy storage systems and flexible loads. Finally, an example is analyzed.

articleTitle: A Two Stage AC-DC Converter for Speed Control of a DC Motor
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: In this paper a AC-DC converter has been proposed for the application of speed control of a DC motor. The converter comprises two stages. The first stage is the diode bridge rectifier and the second stage is DC-DC buck converter. The two stages are coupled by a dc-link capacitor which also eliminate the ripple present in the output of the rectifier. For DC-DC buck converter, a feedback control system, based on PWM technique, has been designed which regulates its output to control the speed of dc motor. The prototype model has been designed and results obtained with it have a closed resemblance with the simulation results which has been done in LTspice software. The results of the simulation and prototype demonstrate that the output voltage of DC-DC converter and hence the speed of the dc motor can be controlled by controlling the duty cycle of DC-DC converter. The results also demonstrate the faster dynamic response of the converters.

articleTitle: Similarity Calculation Considering the Impact of Voltage Regulation
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Voltage curves similarity can be used to verify distribution network topology. However, the voltage curves may be affected by voltage regulation which will result in the inaccuracy of similarity calculation. A method which can be used to calculate the similarity of voltage curves when considering the impact of voltage regulation has been proposed in this paper. Kolmogorov-Smirnov test is used to detect the outliers between the voltage curves of two distribution transformer. Two case studies have been carried out to show the correctness of the method. Discussions have also been made. The results show that the method proposed in this paper will not be affected by voltage loss. The results also show that even if there are extreme outliers, whether the voltage curves of the two transformers are similar is still should be decided by the results of the subsections.

articleTitle: Noncontact Current Source Reconstruction Based on Independent Component Analysis-A Simulation Study
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: This paper implemented a current reconstruction system based on independent component analysis and magnetic field sensors. In this paper both the normal approximation and interfered approximation of magnetic flux density generated by current carrying conductors and sensed by four magnetic sensors are presented and discussed. The output voltage of the sensor array with and without interference was calculated based on the comprehensive independent component analysis algorithm. The relative reconstruction error based on the algorithm for array output voltage are within acceptable levels for protective devices proving the feasibility of the algorithm for source reconstruction.

articleTitle: The Study of Mechanism and Limit Measures for 500kV Single Phase Short Circuit Current Exceeding Limit in UHVDC Converter Station
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: With the rapid development of UHVDC(Ultra High Voltage Direct Current) project, the problem that 500kV single phase short circuit current exceeding limit in UHVDC converter station become more and more serious. In this paper, the influence of UHVDC converter transformer winding connection on 500kV single phase short circuit current is derived, then the measures by adding small reactance to the neutral point of Y<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">N</inf>d connection converter transformer to limit the short circuit current is proposed for the first time, and the selection method of small reactance is given at the same time. Finally, the proposed strategy is validated in a real UHVDC case, results show that the proposed adding small reactance to the Y<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">N</inf>d connection converter transformer can effectively limit the 500kV single phase short circuit current, and the proposed small reactance selection method has good adaptability in limiting the power frequency over-voltage of the converter transformer neutral point.

articleTitle: Power System Text Information Matehing Researeh Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: An information matching technique based on deep learning is proposed: The word sequence of the text is obtained by Chinese text segmentation model using word formation. Then, keyword extraction model is employed to classify large-scale textual information (the texts with the same keyword are treated as in the same group). Finally, the matching degree is given by the two-tier deep learning model, in which the fìrst tier is used to judge whether the texts belong to the same group, and the second tier to calculate the matching degree. The examples indicate that the technique can provide effective results in dispatching/control information matching and operating instruction matching.

articleTitle: Research Concept of Pattern Features of Generalized Load Curves in Future Power Systems
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Due to the influence of the "generation-grid-charge-storage" end on the power system load, it is important to study the generalized load (GL) under the influence of various nonlinear coupling factors. In this paper, the definition and classification of GL in power system are given and the influencing factors of GL are analyzed. The main research contents of GL (GL characteristic analysis and GL forecasting) are expounded. The GL is discussed and studied in combination with the charging load of electric vehicles in this paper. The research results show that there are obvious differences between the GL curve and the traditional load curve, and the GL curves shows new characteristics in future power systems. The work of this paper provides important ideas and directions for the study of GL in future power systems, which can serve as a guideline for further relevant researches.

articleTitle: Optimization of Black-Start Scheme for Mitigating Overvoltage
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: This paper presents an optimization model of black-start schemes. In the current black-start optimization process, overvoltage is not considered reasonably. Therefore this paper considers the factors such as transformer inrush current amplitude and line overvoltage amplitude in the process of black-start. The best reliability and the maximum power generation are considered simultaneously as the optimization objectives. For the sake of obtaining Pareto optimal solution set of optimization model, Group Search Optimizer (GSO) algorithm and Dijkstra algorithm are adopted. The GSO algorithm is faster and the convergence of the solution set is better. Evidence Reasoning (ER), which reasonably considers the preference factors of decision makers, is to rank Pareto optimal solution set to determine the final solution. The results validated on the 24-bus power system demonstrate that the reliability and power generation of the proposed model is much better than the traditional models.

articleTitle: Day-Ahead Security Constrained Unit Commitment with controllable risk
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Wind power, as a clean and renewable energy, has attracted more and more attentions in recent years. But, at the same time, its intermittence and volatility nature brings risks to the reliable operation of power systems. In this paper, we propose a new framework of day-ahead security constrained unit commitment (SCUC) to integrate wind power under a certain risk level. This framework consists of two stages. In the first stage, the on/off statues of units and the upper bound of the wind integration are determined by solving a chance constraint optimization problem. The probability of discarding wind power is calculated by the upper bound. In the second stage, the risk of power imbalance can be calculated by determining the lower bound of the wind integration. The effectiveness of the proposed method is testified using the simulation results on the actual system of a province in China.

articleTitle: Research and Development of Advanced Applications for Relay Protection Fault Information System Adaptable to Smart Dispatch
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: In this paper, based on the detailed research and analysis of relay protection fault information system in power network, considering the real applications, a new and systematic reconstruct and design scheme is proposed for advanced application function of relay protection fault information system in power network, and some key technologies and realization methods are also presented. The proposed scheme is expected to provide some supports for the technicians dealing with the problems of fault analysis and processing.

articleTitle: Construction and Enlightenment of Japan’s New Electricity Market
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: As an Asian country adjacent to China, the path of Japan's electricity market reform is similar to China's. Since the Fukushima nuclear leak, Japan has promoted the fifth round of market reform, and initiated the construction of new electricity market mechanism, such as the base-load market, capacity market and non-fossil energy trading market, with the aim of improving power system's stability and providing users with more reasonable electricity prices. Based on the current situation of China's electricity market reform, the design ideas of Japan's new electricity market mechanism and regulation system are analysized to provide important reference for the future direction of China's electricity market construction, which can help China's market reform out of its dilemma.

articleTitle: An Integrated Operation Strategy of Energy Storage System in ADN Planning
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: This paper proposes an operation strategy of energy storage system, considering the effect of gaining profit and peak load shifting. In the strategy, the charging-discharging periods are divided based on the TOU price and the charging or discharging power in each period is determined by the actual operation of distribution network. This paper applies the strategy to Active Distribution Network (ADN) planning and establishes a bi-level programming model that includes investment layer and operation layer. Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) is selected as the research object and improved particle swarm optimization algorithm is used to solve the problem. The simulation results of an improved IEEE 33-bus distribution system and the comparison with an existing BESS operation strategy verify that the proposed strategy obtains better economic benefits and the effect of peak load shifting, and it is conducive to improving DG permeability.

articleTitle: Integration of Electric Vehicles into Power Grid based on Probabilistic Simulation
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Electric Vehicles (EVs) are quickly becoming the latest environment-friendly technology. With green features that allows these vehicles to run as regular gasoline powered cars, electric vehicles have smart features that are becoming more desirable. Probabilistic simulation methods based on load duration curves have been the focus of academic literature for a long time. The objective of this paper is to investigate the integration of Electrical Vehicles into grid with different probabilistic simulation methods considering the relative computational speed and solution quality. With technology advancing at the pace, newer and better electric vehicle technologies are expected to hit the market.

articleTitle: Experimental Analysis of Equilibrium of Long-term Market Clearing Mechanism in China
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: In order to study the impact of average marginal electricity price clearing mode on the China's electricity market, this paper first constructs the unified clearing model of current China's market. Then based on co-evolution and experimental economics, a simulation platform is built. The current clearing method of long-term electricity market is simulated, and the equilibrium point in the market environment is analyzed, including the convergence and the clearing process under the monopolistic behavior of each subject and the connection between experimental economics and behavioral economics. The results show that the Nash equilibrium point of the power market can be found by co-evolutionary algorithm, and the price of the equilibrium point is slightly higher than the intersection of the market supply and demand marginal curve. Experimental economics results show that the experiment convergence point is neither same as the Nash equilibrium solution nor the monopoly point because of the different endowments.

articleTitle: Short Circuit Analysis and Coordination of Overcurrent Relays for a Realistic Substation Located in Upper Egypt
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Protective relays and circuit breakers are major components of the large interconnected power system. Protection system is used to isolate only faulted parts from the power system network in shortest possible time leaving healthy parts in service causing a minimum disturbance to the power system. The protective system should be able to discriminate between normal or abnormal or fault conditions which called the discrimination. Protection coordination is the important task in protection system. Without good protection coordination, the protection system will lose its features i.e. selectivity, dependability, and sensitivity. The protection mis-coordination is the main problem in the power system. This paper presents short circuit analysis and relay coordination between overcurrent relays of a 132/33/11kV substation which located in Upper Egypt. The short circuit analysis, and relays coordination are performed by ETAP 12.6 simulation program.

articleTitle: Fault Processing Algorithm of Power backbone Communication networks Based on Artificial Intelligence and State Perception
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: With the expansion of power backbone communication network, the topology structure is increasing complex, and the network operation and maintenance data are increasing exponentially. In order to effectively ensure that the large number of deep-level operation data which reflecting the essence of production and operation could be analysed, a fault recovery method for power backbone communication network based on artificial intelligence and state perception is proposed. Firstly, based on the state awareness technology, a fault management model of power backbone communication networks(PBCN) in virtualized network environment is established. Then a reinforcement learning algorithm for PBCN fault recovery is proposed, and a risk value evaluation model for service failure of PBCN is established with the aim at ensuring the quality of service (QoS) of PBCN. The goal of minimizing network loss caused by link failure is achieved. The simulation results show that the algorithm can recovery as much power communication services as possible and performance better in fault recovery of power communication services networks and the revenue of power backbone communication basic networks.

articleTitle: Simulation of PV Grid-connected Inverter Based on PSCAD
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: In order to study the supraharmonic transmission and propagation characteristics of photovoltaic grid-connected inverter, a more accurate model of photovoltaic grid-connected inverter was proposed based on PSCAD simulation software. Firstly, the model of the photovoltaic system is built. Secondly, the inverter control method suitable for dynamic analysis of grid connection is modeled, and the voltage and current double loop control strategy is adopted to realize the decoupling control of active and reactive power. Finally, a simulation model was built and the influence of the main parameters of the photovoltaic system, such as illumination, temperature and switching frequency, on the level of the supraharmonic emitted by it was analyzed. And then the correctness of the model is verified by comparison with the field measured data. The model provides an effective simulation platform for verifying the superaharmonic current and voltage emissions of photovoltaic grid-connected inverters under working conditions.

articleTitle: Optimal Capacity Allocation of Renewable Energy Generation Base for Small Signal Stability Improvement
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: The large-scale integration of renewable energy resources such as wind and solar is challenging the operation of AC power girds due to the dynamic characteristics of power electronic devices (PEDs). Especially when AC grids are weak, improper capacity planning in a renewable energy generation base, which is by nature a multi-infeed power electronic system (MIPES), may lead to potential dynamic stability issues such as small signal instability. Therefore, the allocation of the total grid-connected renewable generation capacity among feeding points in a MIPES plays a significant role in managing the risk of instability issues. In this paper, a method is proposed to optimally allocate the given total grid-connected renewable capacity at each feeding point in a MIPES in order to maximize the small signal stability margin. The proposed method is finally validated via both eigenvalue analysis and time-domain simulations.

articleTitle: Interaction Characteristics of Ports of PET in AC/DC Hybrid System under Large Disturbances
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Power electronic transformer (PET) will plays a key role in the development of smart grids in the future for its flexible control and operation modes. Based on PET topology and control strategy, this paper analyzes the interaction characteristics between the PET ports and discusses the stability of a typical AC/DC hybrid system with the PET in the case of short-circuit faults at different ports. The simulation results show that the short-circuit fault of 750V DC port has the greatest impact on the stability of the system. Based on the result, the solution to install the fault current limiter (FCL) on the 750V port of PET is presented. The simulation results show that the installation of the fault current limiter can effectively improve the stability of the system.

articleTitle: Mathematical Model of Four-Winding Inductive Filtering Converter Transformer and Its Application
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: In this paper, a new inductive filtering scheme with a four-winding inductive filtering converter transformer (FWIFCT) and its filtering system is proposed to solve the harmonic pollution problems generally existing in the high voltage direct current (HVDC) transmission system. The main circuit topology by series combining the fully tuned filters with the filtering winding of the FWIFCT are described. Based on the inductive filtering method, the voltage transfer mathematical model is established, and then the operation characteristics of the FWIFCT in HVDC system are analyzed in detail. The simulation model in the PSCAD/EMTDC simulator and prototype experiment of the FWIFCT and its filtering system for HVDC transmission system are built. The simulation and experiment results show that the filtering effect of the new inductive filtering scheme is better than that of the traditional filtering scheme, and it can effectively improve the power quality of ac grid-side, which verifies the effectiveness of the proposed theory.

articleTitle: Integrated operation mode of grid-connected microgrid considering double-layer demand response
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: The market-oriented operation mode of grid-connected microgrid is crucial to improve the operator's revenue and promote the large-scale development of grid-connected microgrid. An integrated operation mode considering double-layer demand response is proposed in this paper. In this mode, the microgrid operator is sole and can carry out multi-type purchase and sale of electricity, self-declaration of maximum demand and double-layer demand response, and achieve the goal of economic optimization by internal "source-load-storage" unified coordination and optimal operation. Day-ahead optimal scheduling models of grid-connected microgrid under the proposed operation mode and decentralized operation mode are established and solved by CPLEX. The annual revenue of the operator is calculated considering the multiple scenes of distributed generator output and electricity price. An actual microgrid system containing wind turbine, photovoltaic generator and energy storage system is taken as an example to verify the superiority of the proposed operation mode.

articleTitle: Abrupt Change Detection of Home Electrical Appliance Signals Using Mathematical Morphology Gradient
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: This paper presents an Abrupt Change Detection (ACD) algorithm based on Mathematical Morphology Gradient (MMG) for Non-Intrusive Load Monitoring (NILM). In the present research of MMG, it is focused on filtering the original signals rather than locating change points. Therefore, this paper considers this approach to detect abrupt changes. For the purpose of evaluating the performance of different algorithms, the True Positive Rate (TPR) and the F-score are employed in this paper. The simulation studies have been carried out on low-frequency signals and high-frequency signals from the Reference Energy Disaggregation Data Set (REDD) respectively. The MMG algorithm, which has the advantages of high accuracy and fast calculation speed, is superior for both two types of signals. In addition, it can provide not only the information of the position of a change but also the direction of a change. The results demonstrate that the MMG algorithm shows better performance than the CUmulative SUM (CUSUM), the Bayesian Information Criterion (BIC) and the Generalized Likelihood Ratio (GLR) algorithms.

articleTitle: Research and Application of Waste Heat Recovery and Cascade Utilization for Low-grade Flue Gas in Industrial Field
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: To satisfy the actual demands of industrial enterprises, a comprehensive and high-efficient system based on the principle of thermodynamics, and applicable to recovery and cascade utilization of waste heat for low-grade flue gas in industrial field, has been researched and developed within modern sensor technology, automatic measurement and control technology, and high-efficient heat exchange technology. It has been applied to practical production in the industrial enterprise. Modular design has been adopted, which can better adapt to the highly-variable working conditions during the productive process and then achieve automatic dynamic control for the amount of recovery and utilization. It has gotten rid of the low efficiency of recovery and utilization for low-grade waste heat below 250 °C in the industrial enterprises. Moreover, it overcame the defects of analogous system, such as narrow range of application, low efficiency of recovery and utilization, poor level of automation, and complexity and poor precision for operation. The practical application in the industrial enterprise has demonstrated that the system can only save the energy cost beyond 300,000 ¥/a, but also decrease energy waste and thermal pollution caused by direct emission of waste heat. Therefore benefit society and economy were significantly.

articleTitle: Active Power Sharing Performance Analysis of Consensus-Based Control Considering Continuous Disturbances in AC Microgrids
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Consensus-based control methods have been widely applied in microgrids, where disturbances are often unavoidable. The existence of continuous disturbances in the control system will influence the accuracy of the control systems, leading to deviations of active power sharing among distributed generators. This paper focuses on the deviations of active power sharing in consensus-based AC microgrid control caused by continuous disturbances. By decomposing the disturbances into signals with different frequencies, the steady-state deviations of distributed generators’ active power are carried out. A cut-off frequency of disturbances is calculated from the communication topology. It is proved that when the dominant frequency of the disturbance is larger than the cut-off frequency, the deviations are mainly determined by the local disturbances and independent of the communication network. Results of this paper provide guidance for the design of consensus-based control systems. The effectiveness of the theoretical results is verified by simulation based on MATLAB/Simulink.

articleTitle: Research on Reactive Power and Voltage Coordination Control Strategy for Multi-wind Farm Connecting to Power Grid
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: In view of the impact of large-scale wind power access on the safe and stable operation of power grid and economic dispatch, a coordinated control strategy for reactive power and voltage optimization of regional power grid with multi-wind farms connected to the grid is proposed. The control strategy considers the optimization of system voltage quality and network loss comprehensively, and uses genetic algorithm to solve the optimization problem. The genetic algorithm based on power flow calculation is improved by utilizing the information of reactive power and voltage sensitivity and reactive power loss sensitivity of regional power grid, which improves the calculation speed of the optimization algorithm and further enhances the real-time performance of reactive power coordination control. Taking a regional power grid in Hami, Xinjiang as an example, the simulation results show that the proposed strategy can effectively improve the voltage quality and network loss of the regional power grid.

articleTitle: Dynamic Analysis of Operating Reserve Demand Curve in Energy-Only Electricity Markets
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: This paper studies the performance of operating reserve demand curve (ORDC) used in energy-only electricity markets in terms of the installed reserve margin (IRM) and the generator's profitability, both of which are critical to ensuring system reliability and resource adequacy. For this, a dynamic simulation framework is developed to evaluate the impacts of different scenarios on the indices. The analysis confirms that the ORDC can serve as a mechanism to maintain IRM at certain levels and produce the expected response and evolution of IRM under conditions such as cost shocks.
