In the simulations, it is found that the generator's gross margin, usually negatively correlated with IRM, can stabilize IRM when the capacity addition decisions are made based on the average of prior years' gross margins. Finally, by varying the downward slope of the ORDC using different methods to construct it, IRM can be more efficiently steered toward a targeted value. It is demonstrated that the simulation framework and these observations would be helpful to the design of ORDC in energy-only markets.

articleTitle: Optimal Operation of AC/DC Hybrid Micro Grid Considering Night Energy Storage Constraints
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: With the development of micro grid technology, micro grid energy management system (EMS) has become one of the hot topics. This paper is studied in the Alternating Current/ Direct Current (AC/DC) side operation mode and energy management system of AC / DC hybrid micro grid. On the basement of that the micro grid can be implemented on a variety of control strategies, this paper proposes the operating modes of AC side and DC side of micro grid in different states and the mode interaction of AC/DC side. The energy management system also be discussed in paper, which took the minimization of operate costs as objective function and consider the night constraints of energy storage. An AC / DC hybrid micro grid simulation platform is built in Matlab/Simulink, the validity of seamless handover between micro grid operating modes and the feasibility of micro grid energy management system to ensure optimal operation of micro grid is verified by simulation.

articleTitle: The Full Frequency-domain Transient Recorder and the Analysis System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: This paper proposes a full frequency domain transient recorder and the analysis system. The system uses the new type instrument transformer based on the tunnel magnetoresistance effect (TMR), of which the frequency band is 10Hz to 5MHz. The transient recorder is researched and development. The sampling rate is up to 10MHz, and the effective frequency band is 2MHz. This system provides an effective way to identify the complex transient process in the modern power system. The potential risk of the developing fault can be forewarned and prevented, promoting the safety and stability of the power grid.

articleTitle: Combined Use of Support Vector Machine and Extreme Gradient Boosting System for Cost Prediction of Ultra High Voltage Transmission Projects
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: The cost prediction of an ultra-high voltage (UHV) power transmission project represents an important part of management and control of the project. In order to improve the prediction accuracy of an UHV transmission project, a combinational forecasting method is applied. An UHV power transmission project could be decomposed into several subprojects depending on the characteristics of the project, and the cost prediction could be made first for each subproject and then integrated. The principal component analysis and expertise of domain experts are first combined to get the key factors of the subprojects. Then the genetic algorithm based support vector machine and extreme gradient boosting system are used for cost prediction respectively. The Shapley value theory in game theory is next employed to determine the weights of combinatorial forecasting so as to attain an appropriate combinatorial forecasting model. Finally, an actual UHV project is employed to demonstrate the prediction accuracy of the presented combinatorial forecasting model.

Author Keywords: genetic algorithm based support vector machine

articleTitle: Explicit Formula Based Reliability Estimation Method for Distribution Feeder
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: regarding the reliability assessment in the planning process of the medium-voltage distribution system, a novel reliability indices estimation method is proposed in this paper. It makes reliability indices can be expressed by explicit formula and considers different network topology. First, typical feeder structures are extracted in the candidate area using tree edit distance and hierarchical clustering algorithm. For each typical network structure, the reliability evaluation model is established. Influences of various factors on reliability indices including fault isolation, load restoration and reliability enhancement equipment are formulated by regressive analysis respectively. The feasibility and effectiveness of the reliability assessment algorithm are verified by the test cases. The results indicate that little data would be required to realize fast reliability indices calculation by the proposed algorithm. Besides, it can guarantee a high calculation accuracy dealing with various topology.

articleTitle: A novel zero-residual-current arc suppression method using single-phase voltage source inverter
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: In the distribution network, single-phase-ground fault occurs frequently. Theoretically, the fault current can be suppressed to nearly zero by using single-phase voltage source inverter to inject current into the neutral point. Normally, it is necessary to know the line-to-earth parameters of each phase to calculate the injected current. However, usually we can only obtain the global equivalent parameters, and use average parameters to calculate the injected current. It may cause errors and the residual current will still be too large to extinguish. In this paper, the injected current can be calculated precisely by the unbalanced voltage and the equivalent line-to-earth parameter, and these parameters can be obtained by adjusting the gears of Petersen-coil with multi-tap when there is no single-phase-ground fault. The reference value of current can be controlled by double closed loop to suppress the fault point current to zero more quickly and accurately.

articleTitle: Research on overspeed protection control strategies of PWR nuclear power units
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Compared to a conventional thermal power unit, a Pressurized Water Reactor (PWR) nuclear power unit is more prone to overspeed for its lower steam parameters. Disturbance from the grid may cause a significant rise of the rotor speed and even damage the nuclear reactor. Therefore, the installation of Overspeed Protection Control (OPC) is necessary, which functions by shutting the valve fast and decreasing the amount of the steam to limit the speed rise. Further researches on nuclear power units with OPC are important to the protection of nuclear power units. Practically, different OPC strategies can be obtained by switching the trigger signals or by controlling the valves selectively. Based on User Defined Model (UDM) in Power System Analysis Software Package (PSASP), a PWR nuclear power unit model with OPC is established. Different OPC strategies are analyzed when a fault occurs in the main grid. The simulation result verifies the protective effect of OPC, and it performs more effectively when the high/medium pressure valves and the trigger signals of power deviation and frequency deviation work complimentarily in a certain order.

articleTitle: A Three-Phase Four-Level Rectifier with Reduced Component Count
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: This paper proposes a three-phase four-level rectifier with a simple configuration, which can be used as one interface for DC microgrids. Compared to the existing three-phase four-level rectifiers, the quantity of components and the voltage stresses across them are both reduced. A level-shifted carrier modulation scheme and voltage-balance circuit are also introduced. The proposed three-phase four-level rectifier could be a great candidate for low voltage applications (<; 1kV) where high power density and high efficiency are both desirable.

articleTitle: Energy Storage-Transmission Line Planning Based on Complete Information Static Game Model
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Wind energy is developed intensively and is distributed in reverse with load in China. One of the key reasons for high curtailment rate is the shortage of transmission lines. Moreover, the configuration of energy storage in wind farms can suppress power fluctuation and reduce the capacity demand of transmission lines. Therefore, a complete information static game model of energy storage and line planning between a wind farm and a grid company is established. In the model, the government affects the result by setting different penalty coefficients of wind abandoning to achieve the target of wind abandoning rate. This model can reflect the conflict of interest between the two rational players. The result of case study partly explains why abandoned wind energy rate is high and shows the necessity of the government's interference in the game. In addition, the sensitivity of the equilibrium to the parameters is analyzed.

articleTitle: Short-Term Load Forecasting of Microgrid Based on Grey Correlation Analysis and Neural Network Optimized by Mind Evolutionary Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Aiming at solving the accuracy problem of short-term load forecasting in microgrid, a short-term load forecasting method based on grey correlation analysis and back-propagation neural network optimized by mind evolutionary algorithm (GCA-MEABP) is proposed. The factors such as meteorological characteristics and date types that affect the load of microgrid are used to select similar day sets with higher similarity by grey correlation analysis. In order to reduce the deviation of training samples and improve the forecasting accuracy, the neural network optimized by mind evolution algorithm for load forecasting is trained by samples of the similar day sets. Taking the historical data of a region in southern China as an example, the short-term load forecasting results based on GCA-MEABP are compared with the forecasting results of conventional back-propagation neural network (BPNN) and radial basis function neural network (RBFNN). The results proves that GCA-MEABP has a better forecasting accuracy.

articleTitle: Optimized Operation of Photovoltaic and Pumped Hydro Storage Hybrid Energy System in the Electricity Market
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: At present, the electricity market is relatively free and open for investors. With the development of the renewable energy technology, investing in a hybrid renewable energy system, such as photovoltaic-pumped hydro storage (PV-PHS) and wind-battery hybrid energy system, in the electricity market may be a promising choice for investors to obtain the profits. Therefore, in this paper, the optimal operation strategy of the PV-PHS hybrid energy system in the electricity market is proposed. The sequential quadratic programming (SQP) method is used to find the optimal operation strategy with maximum income. Moreover, the influence of various rated power of the reversible pump and capacity of the upper reservoir on the daily income is investigated. The results show the PHS have a significant improvement on the daily income, especially when the fluctuation of the electricity price is high.

articleTitle: Research on Quick Distributed Feeder Automation for Fast Fault Isolation/Self-healing in Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: The traditional centralized feeder automation must rely on the master station. It takes a long time to deal with the fault, and there is a short power outage in the non-fault area of the distribution network. Thus this paper researches the quick distributed feeder automation (QDFA) for fast fault isolation and self-healing in distribution network and analyses the constraint of the distribution network reliability. It is considered that the QDFA is one of the important ways to improve the reliability of distribution network. This paper proposes the definition, technical condition and implementation principle of the QDFA and builds a distribution network model in the Real Time Digital Simulator(RTDS).The examples are verified by experiments and there has been successful fault isolation and self-healing case in distribution network by QDFA in JiangBei new area, NanJing, China. It shows that the QDFA has the characteristic of fast fault treatment and can effectively improve the reliability of distribution network.

articleTitle: A Novel Sliding Mode Control of Doubly-fed Induction Generator for Optimal Power Extraction
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Aiming at overcoming the complexity of the doubly- fed induction (DFIG) generator in traditional vector control, a novel sliding mode control (SMC) strategy is proposed to apply to the direct power control (DPC) of DFIG in this paper. To track maximum power point quickly and weaken the chatter of the sliding mode control, the sliding mode controllers using a novel approach law are designed in the rotor side converter (RSC). Both active power and reactive power are directly controlled by DFIG rotor sides voltages and voltage space vector pulse width modulation (SVPWM) technology is used to make the switch frequency remain stable. The stability of the system is proved by theoretical analysis, and a simulation presents that the controllers designed have an excellent performance of accuracy and robustness.

articleTitle: A Coordinated Charging Strategy on Battery Swapping Station in Microgrid Considering Battery to Grid
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: After the electric vehicle battery swapping station (BSS) is connected to microgrid, the battery in the BSS can provide auxiliary services through the battery to grid(B2G) technology. It is not only able to reduce the configuration capacity of the energy storage system and the construction cost of the microgrid, but also can improve the operating profit of BSS. In this context, this paper proposes a method for full battery to participate in B2G service. Secondly, we propose a coordinated charging strategy for BSS in the microgrid with the goal of minimum daily charging cost. Finally, an example is given to analyze the effectiveness of the proposed B2G method and the coordinated charging strategy.

articleTitle: Research on the Impact of Wind Power Integration on Power System Voltage Stability
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: The impact of wind power integration on power system voltage stability has received extensive attention recently. This paper analyzes the impact of wind power interconnected location and penetration rate on power system static voltage stability by static voltage stability indices. Besides, the impact of the increase of wind power penetration rate on power system transient voltage stability is analyzed through time domain simulation. The weak node of voltage stability is identified and its shunt capacitors capacity for reactive compensation is determined considering the minimum constraint of active power loss. This paper offers a certain guiding significance for the analysis of power system voltage stability with wind power integration and rational allocation of shunt capacitors at weak node for optimal reactive compensation.

articleTitle: A gossip-based asynchronous distributed algorithm for economic dispatch problem with transmission losses
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Considering the transmission losses of power, this paper proposes a gossip-based distributed algorithm to solve the economic dispatch problem in smart grids. Unlike the existing works, two contributions are introduced. The supply-demand constraint of the economic dispatch problem includes transmission losses. The amount of transmission losses induced by each generator can be represented as a quadratic function, which introduces nonlinear constraints in the economic dispatch problem. However, the existing algorithms do not handle this issue. On the other hand, the proposed algorithm is based on gossip algorithm, which implies that only two nodes are activated randomly to exchange their information at each time slot. Therefore, the algorithm does not need to simultaneously delivery information between all nodes, which will increase the risk of information congestion and the computing burden of controllers. Simulation results illustrate that the convergence of the algorithm and compared with the centralized algorithm, the effectiveness of the algorithm is shown.

articleTitle: Supplementary Damping Control of STATCOM to Mitigate SSCI
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: In this paper, a supplementary damping control scheme for static synchronous compensator (STATCOM) is proposed to stabilize the oscillation caused by subsynchronous control interactions (SSCI) phenomenon in a series-compensated doubly fed induction generator (DFIG) based wind farm. Various system conditions determine the oscillation frequency, which is usually different for different SSCI events. Therefore, it is a great challenge to design an efficient and reliable damping controller to stabilize the SSCI. A damping controller based on combination of filters, gain, and phase-shifts is designed for STATCOM controller. With the proposed scheme, the STATCOM is able to provide positive damping for a wide range of system conditions, and thus covering a wide band of oscillation frequencies. The performance of the proposed scheme is validated on an aggregated model of an actual wind power system using Simulink environment. The time-domain simulations have demonstrated the effectiveness of the proposed scheme for mitigating the SSCI at various oscillation frequencies.

articleTitle: Capacity Optimization of Battery Energy Storage System in Multi-energy Complementary System Based on Time Series Simulation Method
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Constructing multi-energy complementary system is a promising way to promote the utilization of renewable energy. This paper proposes a novel method based on time series simulation technology to optimize capacity of battery energy storage system in the multi-energy complementary system with wind power, photovoltaic and concentrating solar power. An optimization model is established to maximize the equivalent uniform annual profit of the system with considering operation constraints of power plants and renewable energy curtailment rate. To make full use of complementary characteristics of the renewable energy, the power rating and battery storage capacity are then optimized coordinately based on hourly wind and solar power outputs in a year. Case studies are conducted on a multi-energy complementary system of China with wind power, photovoltaic, concentrating solar power and battery. Optimization results indicate that the proposed method can fully utilize the complementary characteristics and provide the optimal battery capacities. Sensitivity analyses also show that the proposed method can obtain the threshold of generation price for the project. Overall, the testing results verify the effectiveness and applicability of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Multiobjective Sizing Optimization for Combined Heat and Power Microgrids Using a Triangular Evaluation Model and the Self-Adaptive Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: This paper is focused on solving the sizing optimization problem for the combined heat and power (CHP) microgrid systems. Firstly, multiple optimization objectives are selected in terms of reliability, economy and renewable energy usage to comprehensively assess the system performances. A triangular evaluation model is adopted to combine the chosen objectives and calculate the system fitness. Then, the compulsory constraints are given to ensure the reliable system operation, and the self-adaptive genetic algorithm is developed to implement the optimization process. Finally, a sample system of the CHP microgrid is simulated, which have validated the feasibility of the proposed multiobjective sizing optimization method.

articleTitle: Research on Cooperative Scheduling Model of Wind-Solar-Thermal Virtual Power Plant Based on Thermal Load Demand Response
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: The cogeneration power plant is developed according to the needs of winter heating in the northern region, and gradually develop to non-fossil energy biomass power plant in line with the national green development concept. During the heating period, a large number of cogeneration power plants operate under the mode of "heat-fixing", which results in insufficient peaking capacity of the power grid, and the phenomenon of abandoning wind and light is widespread<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">[1]</sup>. In view of the above problems, this paper takes the wind farm, distributed photovoltaic power station and cogeneration power plant in a certain area of Heilongjiang Province as the research object, analyzes the feasibility of cooperation between power grid companies and virtual power plants. Based on the scene analysis method to deal with the uncertainty of wind and light output, three models of virtual power plant single dispatch, virtual power plant coordinated dispatch and virtual power plant-grid company joint optimization scheduling were constructed, and the cooperative space and benefit allocation scheme of virtual power plant-grid company based on cooperative game theory was established. Through the analysis of examples, the rationality and effectiveness of the established model and the economic advantages of the virtual power plant as a whole benefit are verified.

articleTitle: Smart Street Lighting System with Networking Communication
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: This paper presents LoRaWAN based smart street lighting control system which allows to control night time street light autonomously with minimum energy consumption. The power saving system is done by using motion detection and illuminance sensor to measure the traffic congestion and illumination level. Every street light has been equipped with LoRaWAN communication modules that sends and receives data with the main server to control LED street light which has illuminance level calculated by DIALux. When autonomously controlling street lighting system, the server system decides which street light should be dimmed according to motion sensors. If no vehicle passes the area for adjusted amount of time, the street light will dim. If any of the vehicle passes the area, the closest street to that area will raise the illumination level to normal level.

articleTitle: Cooperative Energy Management for Enterprise Microgrid Using Electrical Energy Router
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: With the multiple functions such as power conversion and information exchange, the electrical energy router (EER) has the potential to effectively manage the energy flow of the microgrid. In this paper, an extendable AC/DC hybrid microgrid topology regulated by EER is constructed for large industrial enterprise. Considering the policy background of the two-part electricity price, this paper carries out a dual gradient division of the whole-day control period, and presents a flexible strategy with multi-mode switches to help the enterprise alleviate energy consumption pressure. Finally, the simulation platform of AC/DC hybrid microgrid is designed and built in DIgSILENT/PowerFactory. The simulation results demonstrate feasibility and economic efficiency in utilizing the proposed cooperative energy management strategy.

articleTitle: Energy Management for Standalone DC Microgrid Using Artificial Bee Colony
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: This paper presents an optimized energy management system for small-scale standalone DC microgrid that consists of solar photovoltaic, wind, and fuel cell coupled with a battery energy storage system. The energy management system has been designed based on low complexity fuzzy logic controller of only 25-rules to manage the power flow that supplies a house load during 24 hours and to maintain state of charge of the battery energy storage system. The fuzzy logic controller is optimized using one of the efficient optimization techniques, artificial bee colony to enhance the system efficiency. As a case study, real data for solar irradiation, ambient temperature, wind speed and house load profile were collected in a hot summer day from Dhahran city in Saudi Arabia and applied to the proposed system. Energy analysis of the microgrid operation during day hours and comparison of the system before and after optimization are presented.

articleTitle: DC Bus Voltage Regulation for Distributed Energy Sources through Buck-Boost Converter in a Direct Current Micro Grid
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Direct current micro-grid (DCMG) based on renewable energy sources (RES) is facing an issue of maintaining standard voltage at DC bus under variable power generation and utilization. This paper proposes the DCMG based on distributed energy sources (DES) and buck-boost converter to maintain standard voltage at DC bus. Photovoltaic panel (PV), wind turbine (WT) and battery are utilized as DES. PV, battery and WT are linked to DC bus through buck-boost converter. The simulation model of PV and WT has been developed using MULTISIM simulation tool. To measure the performance of the designed system, the DC load of 500 watt has been organized for DCMG system. The protection from reverse current flow and over voltage is also provided. The simulation outcomes verified that, at DC bus standard voltage has been maintained for both utilization and generation.

Author Keywords: buck-boost converter and energy storage system

articleTitle: Optimal Siting and Sizing of Energy Storage System in Distribution Grid Considering Power Supply Reliability
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Energy storage system (ESS) can provide emergency power support to improving the reliability of the distribution grid. Aiming at multi-point grid connection ESS running on peak regulation as long-term scenario, the dynamic control method based on load prediction is proposed to maximize the peaking ability. By researching the calculation method on expected SOC of energy storage system, the emergency support capability index of ESS and the line fault loss rate index are established to evaluate the improvement effect of ESS on the power supply reliability of the distribution grid in the planning stage. Through analysis power output characteristic of ESS, the emergency support path planning scheme is given. Based on the site constraints and grid stability constraints, the economy and emergency support capacity of ESS are balanced as the objective function, and the siting/sizing model of ESS is constructed and solved by genetic algorithm. Finally, through the simulation of the example, the multi-point grid-connected ESS siting/sizing plan is given, and the impact of different distribution network reliability requirements on ESS planning is analyzed, which provides reference for the design and planning of ESS.

articleTitle: The Reaserch of Users-transformer Relationship Verification Method Based on Data-driven
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: With the continuous development of urbanization in China, the number of residents in the transformer area has continuously increased, which has led to many problems in the management of the transformer area. Among them, the problem of the user relationship between the user meter and the transformer caused by the change of the transformer area and the change of the resident address is particularly serious, which directly affects the line loss assessment of the transformer area. The development of power big data provides new solutions and solutions for the above problems. Based on the power system big data, this paper takes the optimization algorithm as the core and establishes the household change relationship verification model through the data-driven method. The model can provide theoretical support and data support for the refined management of the line loss of the transformer area, realize the online verification of the users-transformer relationship verification and automatically analyze the abnormal data.

articleTitle: Research and Application Based on Network Security Monitoring Platform and Device
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: In the operation of power system, Cyber-security is becoming an critical factor for dispatching communication gradually. In order to eradicate various network negative effects and crimes, the network security monitoring platform with vertical encryption and monitoring devices for electric power monitoring system are used with restrict flexible and adaptable. Based on the new generation development, safer electric secondary system environment was built, some detection and monitoring mechanisms were created and passed as actions according to the destructions intentionally or not. Wider sniffing and capture were integrated to support monitoring. Comparing with the previous systems, the practicality and application present in this paper is much more flexible and practicable, and can improve the whole security of power monitoring system network.

articleTitle: Optimal Expansion Planning of AC/DC Hybrid System Integrated with VSC Control Strategy
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: The studies of the conventional optimal planning of AC/DC hybrid power system are barely concentrated on the VSC control strategies which can be very meaningful for system expansion. A load flow calculation of hybrid system integrated with VSC control strategy is proposed in this paper. Then based on the flow calculation, an optimal expansion planning with the key objective of economic efficiency is designed. The model of power flow for AC/DC power system is calculated by alternative algorithm and the objective function of the expansion planning is according to the cost minimization with the constraints of the costs for generation and the transmission lines. Solved by the calculation model and planning model, an example is presented in the final part of this paper to illustrate the influence of the control strategy of VSC on the power flow calculation as well as the optimal planning and indicate the value of the consideration of the converter control strategy in the optimal planning.

articleTitle: Research on Operation Optimization Method of Regional Integrated Energy System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: To solve the energy optimization scheduling problem of regional integrated energy system, the distributed generation output characteristics and the system optimization operation strategy are analyzed. Constraints of the distributed energy operation, electric-heat-cold load demand and the energy daily storage balance are fully considered. Then the optimal scheduling model of integrated energy microgrid is established and solved by linear programming method. Finally, a typical scenario is constructed referring a university campus, the CCHP optimal operation mode is carried out and compared with the operation mode of "CCHP full power". The results show that the optimal scheduling model can meet the scenario requirements, and can provide a unified optimization scheme for regional integrated energy system.

articleTitle: Wide-band Phasor Measurement Unit: Design and Test
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: This paper presents the design of a wide-band phasor measurement unit (WPMU) that can capture both the fundamental component and each sub-/super- synchronous harmonic component of node current and node voltage. The work is concentrated on adopting the adaptive detection method to dynamically capture and filter harmonic wave within the frequency of 0-1550Hz. The proposed WPMU can be adopted in the monitoring, analyzing, controlling, and protecting of renewable highly integrated power systems where sub-synchronous resonance (SSR) occurs frequently. The adaptive detection principles are illustrated in detail and the accuracy, as well as the efficiency of the proposed equipment are tested and presented.

articleTitle: Effect of Different Activation Function on Short Term Load Forecasting Using Neural Network- A Comparative Study
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Now a day’s variation and complexity in the electrical load is increasing day by day due to a sudden change in the weather condition, temperature, humidity, rainfall, etc. Forecasting of electric load become important for maintaining a proper balance between supply and demand in order to meet the needs of the customer. Short Term Load Forecasting (STLF) is the technique used to predict the future electrical load by proper evaluation of historical load data. Artificial Neural Network (ANN) using Backpropagation learning algorithm with gradient descent optimization technique have been employed in the present work. Past load data is taken as input to the network and output is selected as a load forecast for a given hour. The network consists of seven inputs, one hidden layer and output. Different Activation function have been used for both hidden as well as output layer for better forecasting result. Parameters that have been used for comparison is Mean Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE), Minimum error, Maximum error, Average error and standard deviation. After simulation it is concluded that the sigmoid activation function for hidden layer as well as for output layer is found best for the network with Average error of 9.4%, MAPE OF 2.08, the minimum error of 0.4051 %, maximum error of 18.93% and standard deviation of 0.0795.

articleTitle: Microgrids as Electrification Alternatives for the Amazon Region in Ecuador
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Several remote communities have restricted access to electricity, and depend especially from fossil fuels, which are environmentally negative. Currently, this issue is being addressed with the implementation of microgrids with renewable energy. Thus, this paper discusses the renewable energy alternatives for the Amazon region in Ecuador. Two scenarios are evaluated considering different types of generation. A search space is performed, and for each scenario, the optimal configuration in terms of costs is obtained.

articleTitle: A Robust Control Strategy for Air Conditioner Group to Participate in Power System Frequency Regulation
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: With the increasing penetration of renewable energy, the stability of power system faces the challenge. Controlling the air conditioning loads based on the demand response strategy would improve the stability of power system and the renewable energy absorption ability. Firstly, the transfer function model of aggregated air conditioner group is developed in this paper. Then the H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</sub> robust controller is designed based on the theory of linear matrix inequalities to improve the robustness of the power system. Finally, a comprehensive case study of frequency response model considering DR is performed to verify the effectiveness of the H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</sub> robust controller.

articleTitle: A power flow tracing based load curtailment technique
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: A reasonable and efficient load curtailment method enables to restore the system quickly as well as reduce the economic losses both for the power providers and customers when the electrical power system is under contingency. This paper proposes a power flow tracing based load curtailment technique. When the outage occurs, the proposed method determines the load curtailment of each bus according to the power flow tracing results. The technical requirements can be satisfied by just curtailing these loads. It takes the distribution in power transfers between units, transmission lines and loads into account. An extended incidence matrix based power flow tracing scheme is developed for efficient load curtailment. Results in the load curtailment and reliability analysis of the RBTS system demonstrate the correctness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Mitigating Multi-Stage Cascading Failure by Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: This paper proposes a cascading failure mitigation strategy based on Reinforcement Learning (RL) method. Firstly, the principles of RL are introduced. Then, the Multi-Stage Cascading Failure (MSCF) problem is presented and its challenges are investigated. The problem is then tackled by the RL based on DC-OPF (Optimal Power Flow). Designs of the key elements of the RL framework (rewards, states, etc.) are also discussed in detail. Experiments on the IEEE 118-bus system by both shallow and deep neural networks demonstrate promising results in terms of reduced system collapse rates.

articleTitle: Optimal Charging Strategy of an Electric Vehicle Aggregator in Ancillary Service Market
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: With the development of vehicle to grid (V2G) technology, electric vehicles (EV) batteries can be a useful resource of flexibility in an ancillary service market. But the simultaneity of charging to fulfill the daily usage energy requirement and providing ancillary service requires power charging strategy coordination and reserve evaluation. In this paper, we develop an optimization model to determine charging power and ancillary reserve sizing at same time. From aggregator's perspective, we analyze the influence under different reserve and signal follow benchmark to examine the maximum possible ability and charging strategy to provide flexibility with best income and least degradation of battery.

articleTitle: Frequency Regulation Strategy for DFIG Combining Over-speed Control and Adaptive Virtual Inertia
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: The doubly-fed synchronous generator (DFIG) with traditional visual inertia control has fast dynamic response speed but is lacked of refinement control under load fluctuation. In order to improve the dynamic stability of system frequency, a control strategy for DFIG based on over-speed control and adaptive virtual inertia is proposed in this letter. This method simulates the behavior of synchronous generator, constructs the relationship between frequency change rate and virtual inertia, and adaptively changes the inertia of virtual synchronous generator (VSG), thus improving the anti-interference capability of system. Compared with the traditional virtual inertia method, the algorithm has strong robustness. Simulation and experimental results show that the proposed method improves the dynamic stability of system frequency, verifying the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed control strategy.

articleTitle: Microgrid Adaptive Current Instantaneous Trip Protection
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Due to the differences between microgrid and traditional grid in operation mode and network topology, a new protection principle adapted to the characteristics of the microgrid is necessary to be proposed. Adaptive protection can effectively solve the above problems because of the real-time characteristics. The real-time nature of adaptive protection is suitable for this problem. Firstly, analyze the problems existing in the original adaptive current fast-break protection principle, and improve the principle. Second, according to the improved principle of improvement, discuss the setting of protection in case of three-phase short circuit and two-phase short circuit faults. Then, PSCAD is used to model and simulate the typical micro-grid. The results of the example verify that the protection can correct the errors of the original principle under certain circumstances more stably and accurately.

articleTitle: Dynamic Pricing for Microgrids Energy Transaction in Blockchain-based Ecosystem
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Microgrid (MG) is an efficient platform to integrate distributed energy resources in distribution networks. The operation of MG is also expected to take advantage of emerging smart grid technologies to improve operation and robustness. Among these emerging technologies, blockchain technology provide a big potential to rule the energy transaction in an innovative way. In this paper, a physical architecture of the ecosystem with MGs is firstly presented. Moreover, as the main parts of the blockchain technology, the operation of distributed ledger and smart contracts are introduced in the transaction process. Considering dynamic pricing scheme in the process of energy transaction in the ecosystem, we model the energy transaction between MGs and distribution system operator (DSO) to decide the trading amount and price of the energy. The welfare maximization mathematical model is established accordingly, and the formulated dual problem will be used to find the shadow price of selling renewable energy to grid and real-time retailer price from DSO. Finally, with the deployment of distribution ledger, the energy transaction process can be fully recorded, and transaction execution can be achieved with the help of smart contracts. In light of the mentioned perspective, beside demonstrated benefit brought to both MGs and DSO, the energy transaction and management based on the blockchain will result in higher reliability and improved auditability in the ecosystem.

articleTitle: Analysis on Oscillation Propagation Characteristics based on Impedance Model
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: In July 2015, a wind-electricity cluster in the Hami area of Xinjiang induced sub-synchronous oscillations in the area, and it caused three thermal power plants to trip nearby. The field measured data shows that the sub-synchronous oscillation propagates along a specific oscillation path in a complex AC/DC grid with wide-area propagation characteristics. In this paper, the frequency response characteristics of each component in a complex power grid are analyzed based on the impedance model. Secondly, the propagation characteristics of the equivalent oscillation signal in the impedance network are studied. The description method of the propagation of the sub-synchronous oscillation is proposed. Validity and accuracy of the proposed method is verified with the first benchmark model of IEEE sub-synchronous oscillation and simulation analysis of a simplified AC grid.

articleTitle: Equivalent Modeling of Power Electronic Transformer in AC-DC hybrid system
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: With the rapid development of the smart grid and the energy Internet, the application of power electronic transformer (PET) is more and more extensive, and the operation characteristics of the system based on PET are also greatly concerned. However, the electromagnetic transient model of PET including the high-frequency devices is limited to be used in the simulation of the AC-DC hybrid distribution network for the huge computation. In order to improve the simulation speed of the model of PET, the dynamic equivalent model of PET is proposed in this paper, which simplifies the high-frequency switch devices and reserves the dynamic characteristics of all the control part. Finally, the effect of the equivalent model of PET is compared with the effect of the electromagnetic transient model of PET on the accuracy and rapidity of the simulation. The results show that the proposed equivalent model of PET could be applied in the simulation of the AC-DC hybrid system.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent and Auxiliary Formulating Dispatching Plan Method for Large-scale Power Grids
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: The power system dispatching plan directly serves the power system and provides necessary means for the safe and economic operation of the power system. Practice has proved that the design and formulation of daily dispatching plan of power system is an important part of power system design, which must be paid attention to and done well. With the increasing scale and complexity of Chinese power grid, the formulation of power grid dispatching plans is inefficient and inaccurate, sometimes blindly. In this paper, the problem is studied, and a quasi-steady-state simulation intelligent assistant method for Power Grid Dispatching Planning is proposed. The dispatching plan makers can first make a rough dispatching schedule, and then use this method to track the trend from the first dispatching plan point to the next plan point one by one, and the operation information of each component can be displayed in the power grid in real time. The dispatching and operating personnel of the power grid can fully understand the characteristics of the corresponding dispatching plan point as well as transition between points and points, so as to help makers to perfect power network dispatching plan in an all-round way and develop a shorter time scale scheduling plan. This method can approximately simulate the real power flow fluctuation. The effectiveness of the proposed method is verified by the simulation calculation of some year national interconnection data. Based on Power System Analysis Synthesis Program (PSASP), the method proposed in this paper is implemented, and the detailed design of intelligent checking power grid dispatching plan using this method is presented.

articleTitle: An Interoperable Building Energy Management System with IEEE1888 Open Protocol for Peak-Load Shaving
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: A peak-load shaving is implemented for a Building Energy Management System (BEMS). The IEEE1888 open protocol is adopted to facilitate the interoperability capability through the TCP/IP network. The data structure is determined by the Facility Information Access Protocol (FIAP). The operation of equipped Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) is optimized from the analytical load-forecast model. The peak-load-shaving application is developed with a 15-minute on-line processing. The real-world BEMS is demonstrated by a test-bed building at Chulalongkorn University, Thailand; where the significant loads are the distributed air-conditioning systems. Experimental results are gathered; the work-day load forecast is conducted for two weeks and the optimized operation of a 5.76 kW/ 14.4 kWh BESS is examined accordingly, and up to 4 kW of peak load is successfully shaved out of 50-kW peak demand.

articleTitle: Status Evaluation of Power Secondary Equipment Based on Big Data of Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: The stability and reliability of Electric power secondary equipments operating is very important to the safety and stability of power grid. But nowadays, status evaluation of electric power operation equipments mainly concentrated in primary equipments. Electric power secondary equipments are lack of practical and feasible evaluation methods, can't comprehensive and scientific reflect the operating, all of these are the disadvantages of status evaluation. To solve these problems, in this paper, we build evaluation model based on mining the big data of monitoring signal and equipment ledger information, and then, the weights of each index value of evaluation model is got by Analytic Hierarchy Process(AHP) method, then, to modify the weights by relative entropy, the evaluation result is output by fuzzy algorithm. Electric power secondary equipment status evaluation method of calculation procedure is given in this paper, the effectiveness of the method is verified by numerical examples, the method is relatively simple and have good performance.

articleTitle: Cost-Effective Energy Management of Grid-Connected PV and BESS: A Case Study
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: In this paper, a linear programming based energy management algorithm is formulated for grid-connected solar PV and BESS. The aim is to minimize the cost of energy purchased from the utility grid and to maximize the utilization of solar photovoltaic generation while optimally scheduling the battery energy storage system subjected to the constraints - state of charge limits, charging and discharging rates of BESS. This algorithm utilizes different scenarios generated from the forecasted quantities to incorporate the uncertainty associated with them. Practical data collected from the testbed at Gujarat International Finance Tec city is used as the input parameters of the presented algorithm. The simulation results are compared with the base case scenario which does not use optimization. In comparison, it was confirmed that the presented algorithm minimizes the cost of energy purchased from the grid by optimally dispatching the BESS.

articleTitle: Optimal Power Transfer Limit Planning for Energy-intensive Industry Microgrid Considering Economic Accommodation of Wind Power
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Security and reliability of power supply are very important for the energy-intensive industry (EII) since insufficient power supply will cause great economic loss. Thus, the microgrid of EII usually has grid-connected structure to guarantee the power supply quality. However, the transfer power between the EII microgrid and the main grid must be limited in an interval, which is called as the power transfer limit (PTL). On the one hand, the EII must pay for the PTL (capacity cost); on the other hand, the operation cost of EII's microgrid is closely related to the PTL. Therefore, the optimal PTL needs to be determined to minimize the total cost (capacity cost and operation cost). In this paper, a bi-level PTL planning method is established in an EII microgrid with wind power and uncertain load. The optimal operation cost is obtained at the low level for the trial planning decision and the planning decision is updated at the high level to reduce the total cost. What's more, the robustness and nonanticipativity are guaranteed in the low level. Numerical testing is performed for a real system and the results show that the method is effective.

articleTitle: Analysis of charging demand of household electric vehicles based on travel characteristics
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Based on the users' daily driving trips, a method for the charging demand of household electric vehicles is proposed. This paper studies the distribution of spatial and temporal characteristics of household electric vehicles firstly. Then describe the space transfer process of electric vehicles by Markov chain. Based on the study of travel characteristics, a charging load model considering the user's travel demand and parking margin is established. Finally, the charging requirements of electric vehicles in different regions are aggregated to obtain the spatial and temporal distribution of charging load in different regions.

articleTitle: Network Connectivity Identification Method based on Incidence Matrix and Branch Pointer Vector
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Network connectivity identification is an important issue of topology analysis. Regarding how to identify the connected components in large-scale power systems, a new network connectivity identification method based on incidence matrix and branch pointer vector is proposed in this paper. By compressing the incidence matrix and updating the branch pointer vector, the method realizes connected component identification without massive calculation of graph search and logical operation. Details of the method are presented and a simplified nine node case is used for further illustration. Comparison tests between the proposed method and the traditional method based on graph search are carried out on several large-scale test cases with hundreds to tens of thousands nodes. Simulation results demonstrate good performance of the proposed method in dealing with large-scale network especially that with multi-connected components.

articleTitle: Probabilistic Load Flow Using An Improved Point Estimate Method Considering Wind Generation
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: The higher order moments of input random variables are need to calculate when the number of estimate points are increased to improve the accuracy of Point Estimation Methods (PEMs). The use of higher order moments may cause non-real or negative values for the location of random variables and corresponding weight. A new PEM scheme based on 3PEM is proposed in this paper to improve the higher accuracy of Probabilistic load flow (PLF) calculation by adding a new pair of estimate points with uniform probability for additional calculation. There is no need to perform normal transformation and estimate higher order moments considering the loads that obey the non-normal distribution in the grid. By comparing with the results of Monte Carlo simulation (MCS), the accuracy of the proposed method is verified by the IEEE 14-bus system with normal and non-normal distributed loads and wind distributed generation (DG).

articleTitle: Dual Grid Voltage Modulated Direct Power Control of Grid-Connected Voltage Source Converter under Unbalanced Network Condition
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: The Grid voltage Modulated Direct Power Control (GVM-DPC) for Voltage Source Converter (VSC) is a recently proposed superior control strategies which features several advantages such as fast power reference tracking, simple structure, no need to use synchronizing techniques, strong robustness and so on. In this paper, an improved Dual Grid Voltage Modulated Direct Power Control (D-GVM-DPC) strategies for unbalanced grid voltage condition is proposed and compared with regular voltage oriented dual PI control techniques. The idea of this improvement is to separately control the positive and negative sequence power components based on the original GVM-DPC controller. The simulation results shows that the proposed strategy is superior to the dual current control schemes been used with voltage oriented control strategy.

articleTitle: AC Side Impedance Modeling of Grid-Tied Modular Multilevel Converter Using Double Closed Loop Control Strategy
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Impedance based criterion is proved to be efficient for stability analysis of interconnected system, yet few existing impedance models of grid-tied modular multilevel converter (MMC) take outer control loop and internal dynamics into consideration simultaneously, which may lead to wrong analysis results. After analyzing the relations between inner and outer loop, this paper establishes the AC side impedance model with DC voltage/power control as outer loop through multi-harmonic linearization. The simulation results indicate that the outer loop has significant impacts on the impedance. The established impedance model can precisely reflect the characteristics of internal dynamics and outer loop, which provides basis for accurate analysis and effective improvement of the stability of MMC.

articleTitle: Active-Adaptive Control System of the Thyristor Voltage Regulator
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: The article considers the issues about an active-adaptive control system (AACS) of the thyristor voltage regulator (TVR) development and its operability. TVR is purposed for voltage regulation in power distribution networks (PDN) of 6-20 kV. Modern automation and control systems of PDN have been analyzed and the main functions have been described. Options for the organization of data transmission channels, communication systems and information processing have been considered. The principle of AACS construction has been worked out. To study the operability of TVR AACS a simulation model has been created. The simulation of normal, pre-emergency and emergency network modes of the TVR AACS has been performed. It has been established that the developed two-level control system allows providing the PDN optimal operation mode.

articleTitle: Model Predictive Control for Cascaded Multilevel Inverter Based on Lyapunov Function
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Due to the large number of voltage vectors in cascaded multilevel inverters, model prediction control algorithm is computationally intensive. Based on the Lyapunov function, this paper proposes a modified model predictive control algorithm for cascaded multilevel inverters by using system's discrete-time model to derive the control equation that satisfies the system's stable convergence and redefine the cost function then choose the switching state that minimizes the cost function and the common-mode voltage of the inverter to achieve current tracking. The novel control strategy proposed in this paper can significantly reduce the amount of computation required in model predictive control algorithm without affecting system performance. This method can not only ensure better tracking effect of the reference current, but also make the system common mode voltage lower than 2/3V<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">DC</sub>. The simulation results validate the proposed control algorithm.

articleTitle: A Novel Key-value based Real-time Data Management Framework for Ship Integrated Power Cyber-Physical System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: The new generation ship integrated power system (IPS) realizes high level informatization for various physical equipments, and gradually develops to a cyber-physical system (CPS). The future trend is collecting ship big data to achieve data-driven intelligence for IPS. However, traditional relational data management framework becomes inefficient to handle the real-time data processing in ship integrated power cyber-physics system. In order to process the large-scale real-time data that collected from numerous sensors by field bus of IPS devices within acceptable latency, especially for handling the semi-structured and non-structured data. This paper proposes a novel key-value data model based real-time data management framework, which enables batch processing and distributed deployment to acquire time-efficiency as well as system scalable. We implement a real-time data management prototype system based on an open source in-memory key-value store. Finally, the evaluation results from the prototype verify the advantages of novel framework compared with traditional solution.

articleTitle: Research on the Transformer Area Recognition Method Based on Improved K-Means Clustering Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: During the operation of power grid companies for many years, due to various technical reasons, non-standard management or power and responsibility adjustment, the end-user meter files do not conform to the actual situation, and it is difficult to determine the location of the ground cable power users. Further, the disordered accounts cause that the analysis of line loss rate, distribution network fault location, emergency repair work list issuance and three-phase imbalance analysis and some other advanced applications cannot be effectively carried out. Seriously affected the process of building smart grid by Power Grid Corp. For this reason, this paper proposes a transformer area recognition method based on improved k-Means clustering algorithm. Based on the high correlation of voltage data of the same electrical energy acquisition equipment, the voltage data of users are clustered to realize the users in the same transformer area. Examples show that the proposed transformer area recognition method can accurately and effectively identify the user transformer area and phase information and reduce the labor and hardware costs. It is of great significance to guide the operation, maintenance, emergency repair, technical renovation and planning of low-voltage distribution network.

articleTitle: An MILP Model for Annual Power Balance Based on Monthly Multiple Typical Daily Load Scenarios
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: The annual power balance calculation is of great significance for planning and future dispatching of power system. With the promotion of energy conservation and environmental protection, annual power balance research has became more important because it can effectively optimize resources on the annual time scale. Based on the previous research on the annual power balance of hydrothermal system, this paper proposes an mixed integer linear programming (MILP) model for annual power balance. In this model, the monthly load is represented by multiple typical daily load scenarios in that month. On the one hand, the calculation scale is reduced, as well as the calculation efficiency improved. On the other hand, the actual load is more realistically reflected. In addition, the model considers the temporal coupling between typical load scenarios. Finally, the results of the example verify the validity of the model.

articleTitle: Research of Fault Diagnosis and Location of Power Transformer Based on Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: When power transformer failure occurs, it can often be considered in two parts, which are electrical accident and mechanical breakdown. Researches usually classify the faults by dissolved gas analysis (DGA) and locate the trouble position by analyze mechanical vibration. However, under the background of power big data, the raw data with multi-source and heterogeneous characteristics bring difficulties to diagnosis. Deep learning (DL) provides an effective way to extract the features of raw data automatically. Convolutional neural network (CNN) is an effective DL method. In this paper, characteristic gas and vibration sensor locations are selected by analyzing fault evolution mechanism. Then, to improve diagnosis accuracy and efficiency as well as reduce noise interference, fault classification and location on line are realized by using LeNet-5 and proposed Fault Detection and Location CNN (FDL-CNN) respectively. At last, the method effectiveness is validated in the experiment.

articleTitle: Research on Dynamic Voltage Characteristics of AC/DC Hybrid System Based on PET
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Since power electronic transformers (PET) can effectively control the power quality of the system while enabling AC and DC equipment to be flexibly connected to the grid, the dynamic voltage characteristics of PET system under large disturbances is of great significance for improving the stability of the system operation and designing protection devices in such system. This paper analyzed the dynamic voltage characteristics of the ports under two typical large disturbance faults, based on the typical three-stage topology of PET and its control strategies. The results show that the state of 1900V voltage of the rectification stage output could be the key index of stability state of the AC/DC hybrid system based on PET. Finally, the Prony method is used to quantitatively evaluate the severity of the fault in the AC/DC hybrid system based on PET. The results could be the reference to the design of PET protection devices and the study of the stability of PET systems.

articleTitle: Life Cycle Cost Analysis of Distribution Transformers Considering High Overload Capacity and Vegetable Insulating Oil
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Compared with conventional distribution transformers, the new distribution transformers represented by vegetable insulating oil distribution transformers and high overload distribution transformers, have obvious advantages in technical performance, which influences the selections of distribution transformers. In this paper, a life cycle cost analysis method of distribution transformers considering high overload capacity and vegetable insulating oil was proposed, which can be used to compare the economic benefits of different distribution transformers and obtain the optimal selections according to the load during planning period. Finally, based on the load data of 10 kV feeders, the schemes of distribution transformers under four typical load curves are optimized by this method. The results show that the method proposed in this paper has strong feasibility and can guide the reasonable selections of distribution transformers.

articleTitle: Impact of Network Structure on Short-Term Voltage Stability Using Data-Driven Method
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Short-term voltage stability (STVS) is a growing concern with the increasing penetration of induction motors, power electronic loads and renewables in power systems. In this study, we investigate the impact of network structures on STVS using data-driven methods. An integrated graph metric set (IGMS) is proposed to characterize the network structures. The transient voltage severity index (TVSI) is used to quantify the STVS performance. Then based on artificial neural networks (ANNs), a two-stage ANN-based probabilistic prediction (TSAPP) method is proposed to establish the mapping between the system STVS and network structures. The simulation results on the Guangdong power grid verify that this method has very high reliability in comparing the system STVS with different network structures. The proposed TSAPP method in this paper can provide guidance for network planning.

articleTitle: Topology Modeling Method for Distribution Network via Power Line Communication
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Topology model is extraordinarily important for the construction of intelligent distribution network. A distribution network topology modeling method based on Power Line Communication (PLC) is proposed in order to further improve the reliability of distribution network topology model, realize lightweight operation and maintenance of topology model in this paper. A distribution network topology model with distance identification is established as a reference for many intelligent applications such as topology check and fault self-healing by means of power line communication. The experimental application of the project shows that the proposed method can improve the efficiency of topology modeling, reduce the workload of model maintenance, and has good practicability.

articleTitle: Coordinated Primary Frequency Control for Virtual Power Plant Based on Distributed Subgradient-Projection Method
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Interconnected together in an autonomous manner, a cluster of distributed energy resources can be coordinated as a virtual power plant and integrated to the power grid friendly. In this way, the power supply reliability can be improved, and the operational cost will be lower. This paper proposes a fully distributed method for primary frequency control for VPP comprised of distributed energy resources. The proposed method only requires limited information exchange between neighboring resources, which can optimize the generation cost in at the same time with frequency control. By case studies, we can find that the presented method is insensitive to communication delay. Besides, compared with droop-based frequency control methods, the method has prominent dynamic control performance and lower generation cost.

articleTitle: Two-Stage Topology Identification Method for Distribution Network Via Clustering Correction
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: The accurate topology of distribution network has a significant impact on power flow calculation, reliability evaluation and system operation. However, due to frequently reconfiguration and modification of switches, the topology is hard to maintain. In this paper, a novel two-stage method is proposed to identify the connection relationships between distribution transformers and feeders. In stage 1, a new correlation indicator is adopted to screen out the unsure distribution transformers which are doubted of being incorrectly connected. In stage 2, unsure distribution transformers are assigned to the most likely feeders, and then incorrectly connected distribution transformers are found out by clustering correction. The proposed two-stage method can help operators to correct the topology errors. Cases studies in actual distribution network verified the effectiveness of the proposed method and correlation indicator.

articleTitle: Security Constrained Unit Commitment Model for AC/DC Interconnected System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: An efficient physical platform is provided by AC/DC interconnected system for large-scale resources allocation. When there is a coupling relationship between AC and DC tie lines in multi-provincial power grids, traditional security constrained unit commitment (SCUC) technology, which is mainly oriented to single control area, cannot solve the problem of embedded high-voltage direct current (HVDC) transmission lines in multiprovincial AC interconnected power grid. This paper introduces an efficient SCUC model for AC/DC interconnected system. With provincial load balance and unified optimization, the SCUC model is established through the equivalent modeling of sending and receiving terminals of HVDC transmission and the equivalent modeling of power gateway of cross-provincial AC transmission. Case studies are conducted based on the actual operational data of a cross-provincial AC/DC interconnected power grid in China. The results have validated the effectiveness of the proposed model.

articleTitle: An Improved Scenario Reduction Technique and Its Application in Dynamic Economic Dispatch Incorporating Wind Power
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: The scenario-based approach has been widely used to describe the uncertainty of wind power output in optimal operation of power system. This paper introduces the typicality degree inspired from cognitive science and psychology to propose an improved scenario reduction technique for solution of dynamic economic dispatch (DED) problem with uncertain wind power output. Two key issues including initial scenarios clustering and typical scenarios selecting are elaborately discussed in the process of implementing the proposed improved scenario reduction technique. In order to demonstrate the validity and effectiveness of the proposed model and method, the comparative analysis between the proposed method and other three existed scenario reduction methods is conducted on the IEEE 30-bus system under the framework of scenario-based DED problem. Some preliminary findings and interesting results are obtained and discussed.

articleTitle: Analysis on Impact of Baihetan Inverter Connection Modes on Stability of Zhejiang Power Grid
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: The Baihetan HVDC system is under construction, and the Zhejiang power grid is at the receiving end. There are three different inverter connection modes for consideration, including the LCC inverter mode, the MMC inverter mode with the constant AC bus voltage control and the MMC inverter mode with the constant reactive power control. Firstly, four indexes are proposed to provide reference for the mode selection. Then, the stability calculation is carried out under the three connection modes respectively. Finally, the impact of the Baihetan inverter connection modes on the stability of the Zhejiang power grid is analyzed and summarized. The results show that the MMC inverter mode with the constant reactive power control will deteriorate the stability of the Zhejiang power grid compared with the LCC inverter mode, while MMC inverter mode with the constant AC bus voltage control will improve the stability of the Zhejiang power grid.

articleTitle: Stability Analysis of A DC Distribution System for Power System Integration of Plug-In Electric Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: DC power distribution system is an important development direction of future urban power distribution system, while the charging and discharging requirements of electric vehicles have a great impact on the stability of the DC power distribution system. Firstly, a stability model of DC power distribution system integration of electric vehicles under different charging and discharging modes is established, and the stability of DC power distribution system is compared according to Nyquist stability criterion, when electric vehicles are charged and discharged in different ways. Finally, a DC power distribution system time domain example with electric vehicle is made in DIgSILENT simulation software, and simulation results verify the correctness of theoretical analysis.

articleTitle: A Short Term Integrated Forecasting Model for The Active Power of Photovoltaic Generation Based on Support Vector Machine Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: In order to reduce photovoltaic generation's active power short-term forecast error, an integrated forecasting model is proposed in this paper. Based on the minimization of the maximum error, the proposed integrated forecasting model combined the mathematical model and Support Vector Machine model. The integrated forecasting model is tested on the basis of the historical database containing the photovoltaic active power of different weather and compared with the mathematical model and SVM model. Test results show that integrated forecasting model results in better forecasting.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of the ELIS system for UHVDC Grounding Electrode Line under Line Break Faults
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Electrode line impedance supervision (ELIS) is an important device which can monitor the operation state of grounding electrode line of UHVDC. The performance of ELIS directly affects the real-time perception of grounding electrode line. In this paper, the measurement impedance of the ELIS is deduced theoretically when single-line break faults or double-line break faults occur on the electrode line. By calculating the measurement impedance of different fault position, the performance of ELIS under different types of line break faults are analyzed. The results show that the ELIS will mal-operate when single-line break fault in some special length of grounding electrode line.

articleTitle: Ultra-Short Term Load Forecasting Based on Elman Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: The paper puts forward an ultra-short term load forecasting method based on the Elman neural network (ENN) to deal with such problems as low forecasting accuracy, poor timeliness and failures to take weather factors into account in current ultra-short term load forecasting algorithm. This method makes the best of dynamic recursion of the Elman neural network as well as arbitrary precision approximating of nonlinear mapping, with full consideration of the influence of real-time temperature, real-time rainfall, the type of working days and the historical load on current load. The prediction simulation calculation of Guangdong electric power grid’s actual data shows that the method is of high accuracy, strong robustness and adaptability, which creates conditions for the forthcoming electric spot market.

articleTitle: Optimization of Micro-grid Dispatching Based on Adaptive Chaos Particle Swarm Optimization
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: As one of the important components of the smart grid, the micro-grid has been widely used. During the operation, it is crucial to optimize dispatching. This paper presents an economic dispatching model for micro-grid containing photovoltaic, wind turbine, micro-turbine, diesel generator, fuel cell and battery under grid-connected condition, and proposes an optimization method based on adaptive chaotic particle swarm optimization. Considering operation and maintenance costs and environmental costs, the optimal dispatch of distributed power sources within the 24 hours of the micro-grid is obtained. In comparison with the optimization results of the basic particle swarm algorithm, the proposed method has the advantages of high search accuracy, fast convergence rate, and not easy to fall into local optimum, and can be more effectively used for micro-grid optimization dispatching.

articleTitle: Transformer Apparent Age Estimation Based on Probabilistic Health Index
