publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: This paper proposes a new solution for estimating the apparent age of a transformer from its probabilistic health index results. The apparent age can not only reflect the overall health condition of a transformer, but also helps to rank a single transformer among a fleet depending on its real performance. It provides references for utility managers to prior transformers and focus on those units which apparent age beyond the average and help them to pick up the transformer with the poorest health condition, thus helps to schedule unit replacement or retirement more scientifically.

articleTitle: Stochastic Planning Model for Incremental Distributio Network Considering CVaR and Wind Power Penetration
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Renewable energy penetration and load increments exacerbate the uncertainty of power generation dispatch for distribution network systems. Different from the medium- and long-term incremental load planning, this paper defines the load increment in the short-term, and introduces the conditional risk value (CVaR) to help the distribution system operator (DSO) to balance the condition risk and the power generation dispatch cost in the power generation dispatch for the lowest total cost. Among them, power generation dispatch considers both the day-ahead stage and the real-time stage. The DSO determines the power generation output of the micro gas turbine (MT), the up and down spinning reserve, and the wind power output. The DSO achieves system balance by adjusting the spinning reserve, reducing the wind power output and shedding the load in the real-time stage. Finally, the feasibility of the model are verified by the example of IEEE 33 node system, and some suggestions for DSO on power generation dispatch are provided.

articleTitle: Dynamic Performance of a High Accuracy Generator Model for Stability Analysis
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: The accuracy of generator dynamic models is critical to the economic planning and secure operation of today's power grid with increasing stochastic and dynamic behavior. This paper proves a novel method of improving generator dynamic models used in stability studies, with higher accuracy and better dynamic performance. The basic structure of the new model is based on the well-established standard second-order generator equivalent circuits, with the innovative method of modeling the loaded generator field current. In-depth theoretical comparison is made between the proposed new model and the state-of-the-art GENTPJ model recently approved by North American Electric Reliability Corporation (NERC). The performance and accuracy of this new model is demonstrated using field measurement results collected from in-service generator, which outperforms existing stability models implemented in major vendors' software packages.

articleTitle: Capacity Determination of the DC-side Battery for Hybrid Batteries in PV Generation System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Lots of studies are published to mitigate the photovoltaic (PV) power output fluctuation by using batteries. Especially, under the islanding operation of the microgrid, the PV output fluctuation causes the instability of the system. Although batteries are installed to mitigate the instability, a control delay of the batteries affects the frequency and voltage of the micro-grid extensively. Generally, a control delay inevitably exists since the PV output is measured at every designated discrete time period and the control signal is sent to the batteries after calculating the difference between load and PV power output. Therefore, so as to reduce this time delay influences, the authors have proposed so called "PV system with hybrid batteries" which has two types of the batteries (AC side battery and DC side battery). In this system, since the DC side battery absorbs only the power fluctuation caused by the control delay of the AC side battery, the size of the DC side battery seems to be very small. The purpose of this paper is to develop a method to estimate the size of the DC side battery. Through the qualitative discussions, the maximum necessary capacity can be estimated from the amount of charge or discharge of the DC side battery when the PV output fluctuation cycle is the same as the one of the PV output measurement. The size of the DC side battery calculated by the developed method is verified through the real system applications.

articleTitle: Semi-fragile watermarking for color image authentication in power internet of things
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: How to protect acquired images plays a significant role in power internet of things (PIoT). The semi-fragile watermark can be introduced into PIoT to authenticate the integrity of PIoT color images. A semi-fragile restorable watermarking technology based on weight-function on modulo operations is presented. First, the watermarking embedding is implemented at the end-device of PIoT. The 11-bit recovery watermark of each block in YUV components is generated by the significant coefficients. Using this weight-function on modulo operations, the recovery watermark is embedded by modulating 7 quantized coefficients. The steps of authentication and recovery requiring large computation resource are implemented in the cloud data center of PIoT. The tampered blocks are localized and restored by the interpolation and inpainting methods with the extracted recovery watermark. Experimental results on actual PIoT color images prove that higher invisibility can be achieved and this method detects tampered regions with a better performance.

articleTitle: An Optimal Operational Strategy for Vanadium Redox Flow Battery Based on Particle Swarm Optimization
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Vanadium redox flow battery (VRB) is a promising technology for storing energy in smart grid applications and the establishment of the battery systems are growing rapidly worldwide. Operational characteristics of VRB is affected by multi variables such as electrolyte temperature, flow rate, and charge/discharge current. Existing problems like premature voltage cut-off and high concentration overpotential are mainly caused by inappropriate settings of electrolyte flow rate, charge/discharge current and temperature, eventually reducing battery energy efficiency. Previous optimization strategies usually focus on single variable and few articles discussed about the coupled effects among multi variables. In this paper, an optimal strategy using particle swarm optimization method is proposed to improve the overall energy efficiency and available capacity. Based on an electrochemical model, the experiment is conducted with a 5kW/3kWh VRB in the lab of Wuhan University of Technology. The results show that the instantaneous energy efficiency reaches up to 93.65% as the SOCs increases whereas the applied current decreases. The optimal flow rate increases drastically with regard to the flow factor. Among three variables, instantaneous energy efficiency is much more sensitive to the applied current.

articleTitle: Temporal and Spatial Pricing for Optimal Electric Vehicle Charging and Discharging Management
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: With the accelerated development of electric vehicles, the impact of charging loads on distribution network can no longer be ignored. It is very important to dispatch the charging and discharging loads of electric vehicles reasonably. In this paper, a pricing model has been proposed to guide the orderly charging and discharging behavior of electric vehicles. The state of charge of electric vehicle are considered, and the time-of-use price is determined by price sensitivity coefficient to optimize the load curve of distribution network. Then considering the spatial distribution of electric vehicles, the problem of distribution network reconfiguration is solved by the second-order conic relaxation to obtain the locational prices. So that the spatial distribution of charging and discharging loads can be optimized. Based on an IEEE 33-bus distribution network model, simulation results show that the proposed electricity price can improve peak-valley difference and reduce charging cost.

articleTitle: Stochastic Geometry-based Model for Spatio-temporal Expanding Smart Grids
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Advanced functionalities of the smart grids are possible thanks to a tight integration between power systems and communication networks. Such an integration allows for a more efficient utilization of the grid assists via enhanced control strategies. Towards this objective, optimal allocation of metering and control devices with advanced communication capabilities is a necessity. However, in order to ensure optimal allocation and coverage for such communication devices, spatial information about the smart grid entities must be available. This is mainly due to the fact that the electric loads within the grid exhibit substantial spatial correlations. Unfortunately, the existing grid models such as the IEEE-bus test systems do not reflect such a spatial dimension. The problem is further complicated as the smart grid infrastructure is continuously expanding with time. To address this limitation, we propose in this paper a stochastic geometry based spatio-temporal expanding power grid model that is constructed in a Poissonian city. Such a model can be used as a tool for strategic deployment of communication devices within the smart grid. A thorough comparison with a real power grid shows that our model provides accurate spatial approximation in terms of node degree distribution, betweenness centrality, grid diameter, node clustering, and eigenvalues spread.

articleTitle: A Small-signal Sub-synchronous Oscillation Analysis Caused by SVC in Weak-link Power Grid
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: In several substations of the Central Tibet Linking Project, SVC is used to improve the voltage control features in weak-link power grid. According to electromagnetic transient simulation, improper control parameters of SVC may lead to a novel sub-synchronous oscillation in weak-link power grid. In this work, firstly, a linearized electromagnetic transient model of SVC and power grid is proposed. Secondly, using eigenvalue analysis, this novel sub-synchronous oscillation is proved to be caused by the resonance between SVC and power grids with long transmission lines. Improper control parameter of SVC will decrease damping of the grids’ leading mode. Thirdly, system with 2 SVCs is analyzed by proposed method, showing that multiple SVCs can make the system to be more unstable. Finally, several suggestions are given to suppress the oscillation caused by SVC.

articleTitle: A Peer-To-Peer Market Mechanism for Distributed Energy Resourses
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Current power market establishes a balance between supply and demand but the reliability and flexibility is not considered. The uncertainty of distributed energy resources (DERs) and the flexibility of demand should be reflected in price. This letter proposes a novel peer-to-peer (P2P) trading local energy market (LEM) framework in the distribution-level networks. In LEM, prosumers determine the offering prices based on their own supply reliability. A credit factor is proposed to ensure the minimum electricity which must be provided by prosumers. Based on P2P trading mechanism, the consumers could take advantage of their flexible loads to choose energy products with proper price and supply reliability. The LEM extends the market trading into four dimensions from price and quantity to reliability and flexibility. The case study has shown that the LEM could not only reflect the real value of DERs with different uncertainty but also give an economic signal for flexible demand to counteract the uncertainty of DERs.

articleTitle: The Application of Equipment Overheating and Arcing Fault Warning and Protection Systems of Switchgear in Power Systems
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: In electric power system, because there is no stability problems of the bus of 35kV and below the voltage level, usually not installed bus bar protection. The generated arc when short circuit fault take place caused great harm to equipment and personnel, and some may trigger a chain of accidents. For the current situation, the main work of this paper is as follows: detailed analysis of the reasons for switchgear short circuit, and generated harms. Switchgear equipment overheating, composition of arc fault warning and protection systems and the function of every section. Analysis and research the reasons and influencing factors of the malfunction of the bus caused by switchgear short circuit failure, and then take effective protective measures. It has a very important practical significance. Discussed the configuration application of the new switchgear equipment arc warning and protection equipment in electric power system, seek the minimum cost and easiest connection for maximum claimed for protected distribution equipment to safely operate.

articleTitle: Identifying Correlation between Planning Strategy and Reliability of Distribution Networks Based on Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Considering the complexity of the influence of the reconstruction measures for distribution network on the precision investment decision-making scheme, this paper adopts a method of data mining to establish the correlation model between the reconstruction measures and reliability evaluation indexes. In this paper, based on the sample data, the correlation mining methods of the reconstruction measures and performance indexes, including multiple linear, back propagation neural networks(BP) and recurrent neural network (RNN) methods, are applied to analyze the relationship between different types of reconstruction measures and performance indexes. Experimental result shows that the BP algorithm is more effective than the correlation model established by multiple linear regression and RNN. Meanwhile, with the increase of sample data, the accuracy of the correlation model established by BP always fluctuates within a small range. Finally, it is found that the selection of different activation functions will also have a greater impact on the accuracy of the BP correlation model.

articleTitle: Correlation-based Investment Decision-Making for Distribution Network Reconstruction
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: With high penetration of large-scale clean energy integration and deepening of power interaction between supply and demand, the traditional extensive investment can no longer meet the delicacy investment decision-making for distribution network reconstruction. Aiming at improving the efficiency decision-making, a fast data mining correlation model for the investment of distribution network reconstruction is proposed in the paper. Neural network method is utilized to mine the relationship between reliability indexes and reconstruction strategies, as well as replace the complex physical analysis process in the traditional model, in order to establish a "fast channel" for the investment decision-making for the distribution network reconstruction. Based on the relationship between reliability indexes and reconstruction strategies, an investment model is established, which aims at optimizing the index when the total investment cost is minimized. Then, the benefits of different strategies can be analyzed to realize the optimization of investment planning. Finally, an example is given to verify the feasibility and effectiveness of the investment model.

articleTitle: Research on Minimum Schedulable Power Optimization of CCHP System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: In this paper, a dynamic optimal setting method of schedulable minimum power for combined cooling, heating and power (CCHP) system is proposed, which aims at maximizing the energy utilization of gas engine in CCHP microgrid. Firstly, according to the short-term energy supply demand of cold/heat/electricity load under isolated grid, a hierarchical scheduling strategy is developed for the CCHP microgrid. Based on the dispatching strategy, the method of setting the minimum dispatching power of the CCHP microgrid is improved. The minimum dispatching power of the CCHP microgrid is dynamically adjusted according to the energy supply situation in different periods to ensure that the gas engine always operates in the most efficient state, making full use of the energy of the gas engine to supply electric load, while maximizing the output of cold/heat energy. Through the example analysis, the method proposed in this paper realizes the maximum utilization of electric/cold/heat of gas engine, and verifies the effectiveness of the method.

articleTitle: Collaborative Control of Integrated Generation and Storage for Offshore Wind Turbines
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: The development of offshore wind power has become an attractive option in the zone with developed economy and large electric loads along the coast. Nevertheless, the fluctuation and intermittence of wind power have exerted adverse impacts on the power grid and restricted the capacity of wind power integrated into the grid. Moreover, the typhoon also has a detrimental effect on the safety of wind energy conversion system, especially when the offshore wind farm is disconnected from the main grid before the typhoon is comming. This paper proposes a collaborative control scheme of integrated generation and battery energy storage for an offshore semi-direct drive wind turbine based wind energy conversion system. The battery energy storage system serves to maxmize the utilization of wind power under nomal conditions, and as a backup power source for the auxiliary system of wind turbines in typhoon period. The effectiveness of the proposed approach is validated through digital simulations.

articleTitle: Study of the Hierarchical Control System for DC Micro-grid
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: In order to better realize the plug and play function of various distributed energy sources (photovoltaic, storage batteries, etc.) in the DC micro-grid, improve energy conversion efficiency and improve DC side bus voltage performance. The layered control strategy introduced contains two layers: the new energy in the inner layer of the micro-grid is maximized by the maximum power tracking control, and the energy storage unit uses the voltage leveling control to ensure the stability of the DC side bus voltage; The bidirectional vector decoupling control includes voltage and current double closed loop control, and uses d-q coordinate axis transformation to control DC voltage and power factor to solve the problem of bidirectional flow of power during grid connection. This paper gives a detailed theoretical analysis and design method for each layer control. Simulation results demonstrate the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: A Control Strategy for Islanded Three-Phase Inverter with Nonlinear and Unbalanced Loads
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: The output power quality of an islanded three-phase inverter will be deteriorated with the presence of nonlinear and asymmetric loads. In this way, a control strategy is adopted in the three-phase inverter system to solve this problem. Compared with the conventional harmonics suppression strategy, the faster harmonics suppression performance is achieved with balanced three-phase output voltage under nonlinear and unbalanced loads conditions. Furthermore, the impacts of control parameters on the system stability are also investigated. Finally, the simulation analysis implemented in the PLECS software shows that this strategy is effective to improve the power quality without harmonics and unbalanced output voltage in the case of different loads.

articleTitle: Peak shaving of an EV Aggregator Using Quadratic Programming
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: The paper proposes a method of peak shaving through control of EV Aggregator in industrial buildings. Peak shaving based on a heuristic algorithm which is not suitable in real field is expressed in a convex form to generate an EV optimum charge/discharge schedule, and a minimum peak is achieved by a linear search. It is implemented in quadratic programming in MATLAB Tool box to express peak shaving problem in convex form and binary search tree is used to minimize the peak. For validation of performance of the proposed method. Various load patterns of industrial buildings are considered. Simulation results show that it is possible to reduce electricity cost about 10% compared to EV.

articleTitle: Optimal allocation of distributed generation based on multi-objective ant lion algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Renewable energy access to the distribution network in the form of distributed power is an important means of absorbing renewable energy. In order to further improve the utilization rate of renewable energy, this paper considers the allocation of reactive power compensation equipment and energy storage system in the process of distributed power optimization configuration, establishing a multi-objective optimization model with minimum construction cost in distributed generation, energy storage system and reactive power compensation equipment, minimum system transmission losses and optimal system voltage stability index, applying multi-objective ant lion algorithm for solving the optimization model. Finally, taking the IEEE-33 node distribution network system as an example, it shows that the allocation method proposed in this paper can optimize the impact of the fluctuation of distributed generation on the distribution network, and further improve the utilization rate of renewable energy under the premise of ensuring system stability.

articleTitle: Wind Power Fluctuation Smoothing with BESS Considering Ultra-short-term Prediction
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Nowadays, power system often faces the intractable problem of power fluctuation due to the intermittency and stochasticity of renewable energy, such as wind and photovoltaics, generation system. The energy storage system, such as the battery energy storage system (BESS) is an effective way to smooth the power fluctuation so as to increase the allowed penetration level of renewable energy generation in power grid. However, the cost of the energy storage system is still very high and the efficient control strategies are needed to improve the benefit of per unit energy storage as high as possible. In view of that, this paper proposed a novel control strategy for BESS based on the common moving average filter (MAF) and ultra-short-term wind power forecast. By adding future wind power data predicted into inputs of the filter, the MAF could possess the characteristic of nearly zero phase delay, which almost eliminates the low-frequency components in the load of BESS. The control strategy proposed enables BESS to focus on the compensation of the high-frequency components of the wind power, therefore obtaining better smoothing results for given BESS and improving its economic efficiency. Simulation results in various scenarios verify the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Reliability Evaluation of Offshore Oil Platform Power System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: This paper presents a method for reliability assessment of offshore oil platform power systems. Firstly, according to the environment and fault factors of the components on the platform, the reliability model of each offshore component is established. In order to evaluate the reliability of different types of platforms, a multi-state equivalent generator set model is established. Secondly, the breadth-first algorithm and Dijkstra algorithm are combined to calculate the power loss under the current state of the system in the state evaluation. Based on the reality of offshore platform, the Preferential trip sequence in EMS system is used to replace the load shedding result, which improves the accuracy and practicability of evaluation of offshore platform project. Finally, a platform in an oil field group in China is taken as an example to verify the accuracy and validity of the proposed method.

articleTitle: A robust and resilient voltage control strategy for smart grids using distributed measurements
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: The significant increase of renewable energy sources (RES) into the distribution grids has caused the system operators to expeditiously plan for countermeasures due to the multitude of problems that come along. Distribution level voltage regulation is one such issue. While traditionally distribution level voltage control has been done at the transformer or using supplementary devices in the grid, this paper suggests a novel method of implementing a robust control strategy using distributed measurements. The voltage control strategy is implemented following a tree structure involving multiple actors. Based on these distributed measurements, multiple flexibility potentials are considered as possible countermeasures. This paper considers both centralized and decentralized control approaches and also concerns with communication failures in a coordinated voltage control algorithm and corresponding actions thereafter. The implementation is done in a way to make the system fail-safe to communication failures. The coordinated voltage control algorithm is implemented on measurement devices and validated using hardware-in-the-loop simulations on a real-time simulator.

articleTitle: Hybrid Energy Storage System in Naval Vessel with 2-Stage Power-sharing Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Short duration and power intensive load such as pulse load weapon system can result in severe voltage and frequency variation in the naval vessel if it is handled alone by the generators. Hence, it is meaningful to design a hybrid energy storage system (HESS) with a lithium-ion battery (LiBatt) and an ultracapacitor (UC) which can handle both high energy and power density events while mitigating the impacts of pulse load. In this paper, the impact on the system frequency and voltage by the pulse load with and without HESS are investigated. 2-stage power-sharing algorithm for HESS with frequency decoupling and the fuzzy logic controller (FLC) is designed. State of charge (SOC) observer is incorporated to ensure that the HESS SOC is within the user-defined limits. The proposed strategy resulted in lower voltage and frequency variation of the system and it is verified using MATLAB/Simulink model for various scenarios.

Author Keywords: Fuzzy-logic Controller Hybrid Energy Storage System

articleTitle: Volt/VAR Control with DERs, LTCs, and Switched Capacitors: Case Study with a Commercial Distribution System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: This paper studies the involvement of solar inverters in voltage and reactive power (Volt-VAR) control, and its effect in voltage profile and energy efficiency improvement. A practical distribution system in the Southern California area containing two solar plants was modeled in the OpenDSS environment. Time-series studies were performed to include 24-hour load and generation profiles. The intermittency of solar generation brings extra stress to transformer load tap changers, which cannot be relieved by switched capacitors due to their slow response and discrete switching nature. With fast response speed, solar inverters have the potential to counteract the effect of intermittency. As verified by the comparative case studies, voltage profiles can be significantly flattened, and consequently, the stress of transformer tap changers can be relieved. Furthermore, simulation studies show that without increasing the power rating, solar inverters can work together with switched capacitors to reduce power losses throughout the system.

articleTitle: Operation of an ICE/PM/TTRB APU in a Range Extender Electric Vehicle Power-Train
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Range Extender Electric Vehicle (REEV) is an interesting and promising concept in automotive field due to it provides a simple and effective way to solve the problem of limited driving distance in EVs. Firstly, an ICE/PM/TTRB APU is developed in this paper, in which the three-phase thyristor rectification bridge is utilized, thus it is more economic and easier to control than the traditional ICE/PM/ISG APU. Then, the speed switching-power following APU cooperative control strategy is presented, in which the engine speed and APU power control system are designed independently. Through adjusting the engine speed and the output power of the TTRB, the proposed control strategy forces the engine runs along the optimal Brake Specific Fuel Consumption (BSFC) curve. Finally, the joint simulation model based on AVL Cruise and Matlab/Simulink is developed. The simulation results show that the proposed APU control strategy is excellent in aspects of power following and speed controlling accuracy, SOC fluctuation range and operating points distribution. The experimental tests based on a prototype vehicle are also presented in which the effectiveness of the proposed APU structure and the associated control strategy are validated experimentally.

articleTitle: Development of Incentive Model for Photovoltaic Generators to Participate in a Day-ahead Electricity Market in South Korea
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: This paper presents the incentive model when Photovoltaic (PV) generator participates in a day-ahead market in South Korea. For this, the current supporting policy for PV generation and rules of a day-ahead market are analyzed. Because of the lack of the incentive model for PV supplier in a day-ahead market, Independent System Operation (ISO) can't consider PV generation when they plan the short-term supply of the system. Therefore, the proposed incentive model is developed to provide the additional profit to encourage PV supplier to participate in the market based on the accuracy of PV generation bidding. To verify incentive model, the actual data including PV generation, System Marginal Price (SMP) and Renewable Energy Certificate (REC) price are used.

articleTitle: Research and Application of Rapid Frequency Response Technology for New Energy Power Station
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: The power supply structure has been changed greatly, and the available rapid frequency response resources of the grid have reduced gradually, with the grid-connecting of large-capacity and high proportion of new energy sources. Meanwhile, the external transmission scale of large-scale new energy bases through UHV DC is continuously expanded. A serious threat to grid frequency security will be posed by high power UHV DC blocking. The frequency regulation pressure and safe operation risk of the power grid are increasing. The participation of new energy for the rapid frequency response of the power grid is urgent, in order to improve the frequency risk prevention and control level of the large power grid. The rapid frequency response performance requirements of new energy power stations were introduced, and a typical scheme of rapid frequency response was proposed for existing or newly built wind farms and photovoltaic power stations. A new energy power station integrated control system was developed and a demonstration application was carried out in a photovoltaic power station. The integration function of AGC/AVC and rapid frequency response for new energy power station was realized, which achieved the purpose of active support for power grid frequency and voltage by new energy power station.

articleTitle: Research on wind-hydro-thermal Power System Multi-time Scale Coordinated Optimal Dispatch
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: To deal with the global climate change and serious energy crisis, the renewable energy, especially wind power has been developed rapidly in power system. Since the conventional power dispatch technology cannot effectively respond to the intermittent and volatility of significant wind power penetration, this paper established a multi-time scale coordinated optimal dispatching framework, which divided the dispatch process into 4 stages in time dimension: day-ahead schedule, rolling schedule, coordinated schedule and automatic generation control (AGC) adjustment process. In addition, the hydropower flexibility is suit to cope with the rapid fluctuation of system. Based on the multi-time scale coordinated optimal scheduling mechanism, the example of a composite wind-hydro-thermal power system is simulated, as the illustrated test results, the feasibility of the proposed multi-time scale power dispatch model is verified.

articleTitle: Simulation modeling of high impedance transformer based on PSCAD with deep correlation of winding structure
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: High short-circuit impedance transformer is widely used because of its advantage in limiting short-circuit current. Among the two types of high short-circuit impedance transformers commonly used, high-voltage winding built-in type frequently occurs zero-sequence over-current protection maloperation during no-load closing, while another type of low-voltage series reactance transformer is rarely reported. The main difference between them lies in the winding structure. However, the existing transformer simulation models can hardly reflect the difference. Through research, the equivalent circuit model which can reflect the difference of winding structure through flux linkage analysis is established, the method of building simulation model of high impedance transformer based on EMTDC/PSCAD is put forward, and the accuracy of the model is verified through dynamic simulation test, which provided a powerful tool for the research of high impedance transformer. Finally, the difference in inrush current characteristics of different high-impedance transformers are compared, and the reasons why the built-in transformer is easy to malfunction is explained.

articleTitle: Interval state estimation with Limited PMU against False Data Injection Attack
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: According to the development of smart grid, we propose a multi-dimensional protection mechanism based on PMU (phasor measurement unit) in this paper. In order to narrow down the variation range of state variables against false data injection attack, we propose a new dynamic network protection method, in which the local measurement with PMU used. Meanwhile we propose a detected strategy of interval state estimation, which could effectively identify dynamic network attacks and protect the smart grid. Finally, through numerical simulations on the standard IEEE14-node system, it is verified that the proposed model can alleviate the smearing effect from the perspective of attack, and improve the accuracy of the defense mechanism. In this paper, through the fusion of PMU data, the smart grid can be protected from the two dimensions included attack and defense, which effectively ensures the safe and stable operation of the smart grid.

articleTitle: An optimal operation method for cascade hydro-photovoltaic-pumped storage hybrid generation system
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: Since photovoltaic power stations and cascade hydropower stations have complementary characteristics, while pumped storage power stations have energy storage and rapid regulation characteristics, it is of great significant to combine cascade hydropower, photovoltaic, pumped storage to increase the absorption of photovoltaic. To improve the stability of the system operation and the economic benefits, this paper proposes a cascade hydro-photovoltaic-pumped storage hybrid generation system. Considering the actual conditions such as uncertainty of photovoltaic output, the reservoir capacity of pumped storage power station and real time electricity price, an objective function and related constraint conditions are established. In addition, a particle swarm optimization algorithm with linear decreasing of inertia weight is used to find the optimum results of the model. Finally, actual power station parameters are selected for simulation test and the results show that the hybrid generation system has good economic benefits and water-light complementary ability, which guarantee the system to operate more safely and economically.

articleTitle: A New Method for HVDC Grounding Electrode Line Protection Based on Multi-Band Voltage Amplitude Integration
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: In order to improve the fault monitoring performance of grounding electrode lines in high voltage DC (HVDC) transmission systems, a new grounding electrode line protection based on multi-band voltage amplitude integration is proposed in this paper. Firstly, the voltage spectrum under normal operation and fault were analyzed. It was found that the voltage under different frequency bands will change greatly after fault occurred in grounding electrode line. Based on this, a new fault identification criterion using the voltage amplitude integration is proposed in this paper. A large number of simulation experiments based on PSCAD/EMTDC show that this method can effectively identify various faults on the grounding electrode line, which is less affected by the fault resistance and has a good application prospect.

articleTitle: A Coordinated Voltage Control Strategy for Coordination of Wind Turbines Variable Mode control and OLTC in Distribution Grid
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: For distribution networks with dispersed wind power access, due to their limited voltage regulation resources and flexible and diverse access methods for dispersed wind power, voltages are more likely to be exceeded in the network. If the reactive power compensation device is installed, it will lead to poor economy. In this regard, this paper proposes a coordinated control strategy to improve the reactive power regulation capability of wind turbines and the voltage regulation using on-load tap-changer (OLTC). Firstly, the overall scheme of the coordinated control strategy is introduced: when the voltage of the distribution network exceeds the limit, the reactive power output under the maximum wind energy tracking (MPPT) control of the wind turbine is used for rapid voltage regulation; when the reactive power reaches the limit, it is temporarily sacrificed maximum wind energy tracking, using the reactive power maximization control strategy to increase the reactive power output of the unit; if the voltage is still not restored, adjust the tap of OLTC. Then, the reactive power and voltage control strategy of the dispersed wind turbine is given. Finally, the PSCAD simulation results show that the coordinated control strategy proposed in this paper has better played the advantage of coordinated control of dispersed wind turbines and OLTC, and enhanced the voltage regulation capability of the distribution network.

articleTitle: Isolated Microgrid Capacity Configuration Considering Economic Risk of Customer Interruption
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: In this paper, an optimal capacity configuration method for isolated microgrid considering the economic risk of customer interruption is proposed. Firstly, the output model of wind turbine, photovoltaic generation system and energy storage system in microgrid is established. Secondly, the loads in the microgrid are classified into three categories according to their importance, and Conditional Value at Risk (CVAR) is used to evaluate the economic risk of interruption caused by intermittent and volatility of renewable energy sources in isolated microgrid. Thirdly, the economic risk of customer interruption is considered based on the initial investment cost and maintenance cost of the microgrid. Finally, particle swarm optimization is used to solve the capacity configuration problem of microgrid. The results show that the model is correct and can provide quantitative basis for the planning and construction of microgrid in power companies.

articleTitle: Optimized Capacity Configuration of Photovoltaic Generation and Energy Storage for Residential Microgrid
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: With the energy crisis and environmental protection problems, residential photovoltaic generation technology has developed rapidly. This paper studies the optimized capacity configuration of photovoltaic generation and energy storage for residential microgrids containing photovoltaic generation and energy storage systems. An energy management strategy based on energy storage is proposed. Considering the electricity cost, electricity income and the cost of photovoltaic generation and energy storage system, the optimized capacity configuration model of photovoltaic generation and energy storage with the largest investment benefit/cost ratio is established. The genetic algorithm is used to solve the problem. Finally, the validity of the model and the solution method is verified in the specific residential microgrid.

articleTitle: Analysis of Coordinated Control Strategy for Large-scale Renewable Energy VSCHVDC Integration
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: When a large-scale renewable energy source is connected to a VSC-HVDC grid and the VSC-HVDC system is used for long-distance transmission, the operational characteristics of the renewable energy and the VSC-HVDC grid will affect each other. The adaptability of the renewable energy to the VSC-HVDC grid will become an important factor affecting the operation of the grid. China has built the Nanao three-terminal VSC-HVDC project, the Zhoushan five-terminal VSC-HVDC project, and the two- terminal of the Xiamen VSC-HVDC project. Breakthroughs have been made in the impact of AC/DC system interconnection and key equipment technologies for VSC-HVDC transmission systems, especially VSC-HVDC converters and control protection technology. This paper focuses on the two main problems with renewable energy island integration. The first problem is how the VSC-HVDC grid provides a stable AC voltage to the renewable energy source without AC grid support. The second issue is how to maintain the energy balance of the VSC-HVDC system in the event of a fault. When the receiving end fails, the power energy cannot be sent out. When the sending end fails, the energy will accumulate in the VSC-HVDC grid. The resulting overvoltage and overcurrent problems require new control protection technology to will be introduced in this paper.

articleTitle: Design of Information System Cyber Security Range Test System for Power Industry
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: As an important national infrastructure, the power grid is one of the primary targets in cyber warfare. It is extremely urgent to build information system cyber security range test system for power industry. This paper has a top-level design for cyber security range test system which covers the entire process of production and management in power industry, and provides an approximate real production environment. The platform provides support for researching of network security technology and offensive and defensive means, and it also provides a credible, controllable, and operational experimental environment for assessing the security of important power information systems.

articleTitle: Wind Turbine Generator Fault Detection Based on Multi-Layer Neural Network and Random Forest Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)
abstract: In order to achieve fast and accurate fault diagnosis of wind turbine generators, a fault diagnosis algorithm based on multi-layer neural network (MNN) and random forest algorithm (RF) is designed based on the data of supervisory control and data acquisition (SCADA). The algorithm consists of two parts: The first part is the fault detection algorithm based on MNN. The reconstructed value of SCADA data is obtained by MNN, and the change trend of the reconstruction error and it exceeding the threshold are analyzed to predict the Wind Turbine (WT) fault and extract the fault sample. The second part is based on the random forest fault identification algorithm to establish an RF fault identification algorithm. The example verification proves that the MNN algorithm can detect the fault of the wind turbine generator earlier, and the RF identifies the fault type more accurately than other basic algorithms. It is concluded that the proposed diagnostic method based on multilayer neural network and random forest algorithm has good performance.
